    if(existingIndex>=0) target.faultBindings[existingIndex]=binding;
    else target.faultBindings.push(binding);
    if(targetKind==='node'&&Array.isArray(S.faultedBlks)&&!S.faultedBlks.includes(target.id)) S.faultedBlks.push(target.id);
    refreshFaultUiAfterChange(target);
    return {ok:true,instance,model,slot};
  }

  function showPropertyPanelFaultParameters(box,target,model,slot,slotId){
    box.querySelector('[data-target-fault-parameters]')?.remove();
    box.querySelectorAll('.target-fault-choice.is-selected').forEach(choice=>choice.classList.remove('is-selected'));
    box.querySelector(`[data-activate-compatible-fault="${jsString(model.id)}"][data-activate-fault-slot="${jsString(slotId)}"]`)?.classList.add('is-selected');
    const entries=Object.entries(model.defaultParameters||{});
    const faultParameterSchema=window.__GZ_FAULT_PARAMETER_PANEL_SCHEMA__;
    const parameterRows=faultParameterSchema?.renderFaultParameterRows
      ?faultParameterSchema.renderFaultParameterRows(model.defaultParameters||{},{
        dataAttributeName:'data-target-fault-param',
        rowClassName:'target-fault-param-row',
        emptyHtml:'<div class="target-fault-param-empty">No parameters</div>'
      })
      :entries.length?entries.map(([key,value])=>`
          <label class="target-fault-param-row">
            <span>${text(getFaultParameterLabel(key))}</span>
            ${renderFaultParameterControl(key,value,'data-target-fault-param')}
          </label>`).join(''):'<div class="target-fault-param-empty">No parameters</div>';
    const panel=document.createElement('form');
    panel.className='target-fault-parameters';
    panel.dataset.targetFaultParameters='true';
    panel.innerHTML=`
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__head">
        <span>参数确认</span>
        <strong>${text(model.displayName||model.name||model.id)}</strong>
        <small>${text(slot?.slotName||slot?.name||slotId)} · ${text(slot?.bindingObject||slot?.targetVariable||slot?.variableKey||slotId)}</small>
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__grid">
        ${parameterRows}
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__actions">
        <button type="button" data-cancel-target-fault>取消</button>
        <button type="submit" data-confirm-target-fault>确认注入</button>
      </div>`;
    panel.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      createPropertyPanelFallbackFault(target,model,slot,readPropertyPanelFaultParameterDraft(panel));
      box.remove();
    });
    panel.querySelector('[data-cancel-target-fault]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>panel.remove());
    box.querySelector('.target-fault-dialog__body')?.appendChild(panel);
  }

  function openPropertyPanelFallbackFaultDialog(target){
    document.querySelector('[data-target-fault-dialog]')?.remove();
    const options=getPropertyPanelFaultOptions(target);
    const box=document.createElement('div');
    box.className='target-fault-dialog';
    box.dataset.targetFaultDialog='true';
    box.innerHTML=`
      <div class="target-fault-dialog__head">
        <strong>${text(target?.props?.name||target?.label||target?.id||'Target')}</strong>
        <button type="button" data-close-target-fault-dialog>关闭</button>
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-dialog__body">
        ${options.length?options.map(({model,slot,slotId})=>`
          <button type="button" class="target-fault-choice" data-activate-compatible-fault="${text(model.id)}" data-activate-fault-slot="${text(slotId)}">
            <span>${text(model.displayName||model.name||model.id)}</span>
            <small class="target-fault-choice__slot">${text(slot?.slotName||slot?.name||slotId)} · ${text(slot?.bindingObject||slot?.targetVariable||slot?.variableKey||slotId)}</small>
            <small>${text(model.layer||'electrical')} · ${text(model.runtimeBehavior||model.modelClass||'fault')}</small>
          </button>`).join(''):'<div class="target-fault-empty">该对象没有可添加的故障</div>'}
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.querySelector('[data-close-target-fault-dialog]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>box.remove());
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-activate-compatible-fault]').forEach(button=>{
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        const faultId=button.dataset.activateCompatibleFault||'';
        const slotId=button.dataset.activateFaultSlot||'';
        const option=options.find(item=>item.model.id===faultId&&item.slotId===slotId);
        if(option) showPropertyPanelFaultParameters(box,target,option.model,option.slot,option.slotId);
      });
    });
    return box;
  }

  function openPropertyPanelTargetFaultDialog(){
    if(typeof window.openTargetFaultActivationDialog==='function') return window.openTargetFaultActivationDialog();
    const target=getSelectedPropertyTarget();
    if(!target) return false;
    openPropertyPanelFallbackFaultDialog(target);
    return true;
  }
  window.openPropertyPanelTargetFaultDialog=openPropertyPanelTargetFaultDialog;

  function renderFaults(target){
    const targetKind=isEdgeTarget(target)?'edge':'node';
    const bindings=activeFaultBindingsForPanel(target);
    const injectButton=isEdgeTarget(target)
      ?(isProtocolInjectableEdge(target)?'<button type="button" class="props-secondary props-protocol-action" onclick="openProtocolFaultImport()">注入协议故障</button>':'')
      :(!target.type?.startsWith('instrument_')?'<button type="button" class="props-secondary props-fault-action" data-open-property-fault-dialog>注入故障</button>':'');
    const body=bindings.length
      ?bindings.map((binding,index)=>renderFaultBinding(binding,target,targetKind,index)).join('')
      :'<div class="props-empty-state">No active faults</div>';
    window.savePropertyPanelFaultSlots=savePropertyPanelFaultSlots;
    return `
      <div class="props-fault-panel">
        ${renderTargetHeader(target)}
        ${renderFaultSlotEditor(target)}
        <div class="pgroup props-fault-section">
          <div class="props-section-head">
            <div>
              <div class="pglbl">故障实例</div>
              <p>当前目标上已经绑定的故障模型。</p>
            </div>
            <span class="props-section-count">${text(bindings.length)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="props-fault-stack">${body}</div>
          <div class="props-help">一个组件或一条 CAN 边可以挂载多个故障实例；取消后会清除红色故障态，并重新渲染多信号流图。</div>
        </div>
        <div class="props-actions props-fault-actions">
          ${!isEdgeTarget(target)?'<button type="button" class="props-save" data-save-fault-slots>保存槽位</button>':''}
          ${injectButton}
          ${bindings.length?`<button type="button" class="props-secondary props-fault-clear" data-fault-clear onclick="clearFaultBindings('${targetKind}','${jsString(target.id)}')">清空故障</button>`:''}
          ${isEdgeTarget(target)?'<button type="button" class="props-danger" onclick="deleteSelectedEdge()">删除连线</button>':'<button type="button" class="props-danger" onclick="deleteSelectedNode()">删除模块</button>'}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderNodeOutputs(node){
    const ports=getNodePorts(node);
    const rows=[
      ...ports.inputs.map((port,index)=>['输入 '+(index+1),getPortDisplayName(port)||port.label||port.varName||port.key||'input']),
      ...ports.outputs.map((port,index)=>['输出 '+(index+1),getPortDisplayName(port)||port.label||port.varName||port.key||'output'])
    ];
    return `
      ${renderTargetHeader(node)}
      <div class="pgroup">
        <div class="pglbl">端口与变量</div>
        ${rows.length?renderRows(rows):'<div class="props-empty-state">No ports</div>'}
      </div>
      <div class="pgroup">
        <div class="pglbl">运行时输出</div>
        ${renderRows([
          ['Scope samples',SIM?.actual?.scopeSamples?.[node.id]?Object.keys(SIM.actual.scopeSamples[node.id]).length:0],
          ['Node state',SIM?.actual?.nodeStates?.[node.id]?'已采样':'未采样']
        ])}
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderEdgeOutputs(edge){
    const source=getNode(edge.sourceNodeId);
    const dest=getNode(edge.targetNodeId);
    const signals=edgeSignals(edge);
    const signal=signals[0]||{};
    const metrics=(typeof window.collectDataflowEdges==='function'
      ?window.collectDataflowEdges().find((item)=>item.edge?.id===edge.id)?.metrics
      :null)||((typeof getDataflowEdgeMetrics==='function')?getDataflowEdgeMetrics(edge):{})||{};
    const activeFault=activeFaultBindingsForPanel(edge)[0]||edge.injectedFault||{};
    const faultName=metrics.faultName||activeFault.name||'';
    const runtimeBehavior=metrics.runtimeBehavior||activeFault.runtimeBehavior||'';
    const faultParams=activeFault.parameters||{};
    const formatEdgeOutputNumber=(value,digits=3)=>{
      if(value===null||value===undefined||value===''){return '--';}
      const numeric=Number(value);
      if(!Number.isFinite(numeric)){return String(value);}
      if(Math.abs(numeric)>=100){return numeric.toFixed(1);}
      if(Math.abs(numeric)>=10){return numeric.toFixed(2);}
      return numeric.toFixed(digits);
    };
    const diagnosticRows=[
      ['当前值 currentValue',formatEdgeOutputNumber(metrics.currentValue)],
      ['残差 residual',formatEdgeOutputNumber(metrics.residualValue)],
      ['延迟 latency',metrics.latency||faultParams.latency||faultParams.base_delay||faultParams.delay_seconds||'--'],
      ['丢包率 dropRate',metrics.dropRate||faultParams.dropRate||faultParams.drop_rate||faultParams.loss_rate||'--'],
      ['突发长度 burstLength',metrics.burstLength||faultParams.burstLength||faultParams.burst_length||'--'],
      ['状态 status',metrics.status||'normal'],
      faultName?['故障名称 faultName',faultName]:null,
      runtimeBehavior?['运行行为 runtimeBehavior',runtimeBehavior]:null
    ].filter(Boolean);
    const signalCards=signals.map((item,index)=>`
      <div class="props-channel-card" data-edge-output-channel="${text(item.signalRole||index)}">
        ${renderRows([
          ['信号ID signalId',item.signalId||'--'],
          ['通道ID channelId',item.channelId||'--'],
          ['CAN报文 messageId',item.messageId||'--'],
          ['信号角色 role',item.signalRole||'--'],
          ['单位 signalUnit',item.signalUnit||'--'],
          ['采样率 sampleRate',item.sampleRate||'--'],
          ['载荷类型 payloadKind',item.payloadKind||'--'],
          ['传播策略 faultPropagationPolicy',item.faultPropagationPolicy||'inherit']
        ])}
      </div>`).join('');
    return `
      ${renderTargetHeader(edge)}
      <div class="pgroup">
        <div class="pglbl">多信号流载荷</div>
        ${renderRows([
          ['信号ID Signal ID',signal.signalId||metrics.signalId||'未设置'],
          ['通道ID Channel',signal.channelId||metrics.channelId||'未设置'],
          ['CAN报文 Message',signal.messageId||metrics.messageId||'未设置'],
          ['信号角色 Role',signal.signalRole||metrics.signalRole||'未设置'],
          ['单位 Unit',signal.signalUnit||metrics.signalUnit||'未设置'],
          ['载荷类型 Payload',signal.payloadKind||metrics.payloadKind||'未设置'],
          ['传播策略 Policy',signal.faultPropagationPolicy||metrics.faultPropagationPolicy||'inherit']
        ])}
      </div>
      <div class="pgroup">
        <div class="pglbl">传递路径</div>
        ${renderRows([
          ['源端口',`${source?.props?.name||edge.sourceNodeId}:${getPortLabelForPanel(source,'output',edge.sourcePortIndex||0)}`],
          ['目标端口',`${dest?.props?.name||edge.targetNodeId}:${getPortLabelForPanel(dest,'input',edge.targetPortIndex||0)}`],
          ['数据流状态',metrics.status||'normal'],
          ['故障传递',metrics.faultActive?'active':'inactive']
        ])}
      </div>
      <div class="pgroup" data-edge-output-channels>
        <div class="pglbl">通道载荷</div>
        ${signalCards||'<div class="props-empty-state">暂无信号通道</div>'}
      </div>
      <div class="pgroup" data-edge-diagnostics>
        <div class="pglbl">诊断指标</div>
        ${renderRows(diagnosticRows)}
      </div>`;
  }

  function getEdgeConfiguredTestPoints(edge){
    const state=S;
    const matchesEdge=point=>(point?.edgeId||point?.edgeID||point?.targetEdgeId||'')===edge?.id;
    const seen=new Set();
    const collect=(points,prefix)=>list(points).filter(matchesEdge).map((point,index)=>{
      const pointId=point.pointId||point.id||`${prefix}-${edge?.id||'edge'}-${index+1}`;
      return {
        ...point,
        pointId,
        id:point.id||pointId,
        edgeId:edge?.id||point.edgeId||point.targetEdgeId||'',
        detects:list(point.detects)
      };
    }).filter(point=>{
      const key=point.pointId||point.id;
      if(!key||seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
    return [
      ...collect(state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints,'tp-manual-edge'),
      ...collect(state.diagnosticTestPoints,'tp-config-edge'),
      ...collect(state.testPoints,'tp-config-edge')
    ];
  }

  function getDiagnosticRowsForEdgeTestPointOptions(){
    const diagnosticModel=S.activeModelPackage?.diagnosticModel||S.diagnosticModel||{};
    return list(diagnosticModel.dMatrix?.rows);
  }

  function getDiagnosticRowFaultId(row){
    return row?.faultId||row?.faultTypeId||row?.caseId||row?.id||'';
  }

  function getEdgeDiagnosticPointCodes(edge){
    const edgeId=edge?.id||'';
    const codes=[];
    const append=point=>{
      if((point?.edgeId||point?.edgeID||point?.targetEdgeId||'')!==edgeId) return;
      [point.shortName,point.code,point.pointCode,point.pointId,point.id]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .forEach(code=>codes.push(String(code)));
    };
    list(S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints).forEach(append);
    list(S.diagnosticTestPoints).forEach(append);
    list(S.testPoints).forEach(append);
    return Array.from(new Set(codes));
  }

  function isDiagnosticMatrixValueDetectable(value){
    if(value&&typeof value==='object'){
      return Boolean(value.detectable??value.detect??value.d??value.value);
    }
    if(typeof value==='string'){
      return ['1','true','yes','detectable','可检测'].includes(value.trim().toLowerCase());
    }
    return Boolean(value);
  }

  function diagnosticRowDetectsEdge(row,edge){
    const codes=getEdgeDiagnosticPointCodes(edge);
    return codes.some(code=>{
      const value=row?.points?.[code]??row?.cells?.[code]??row?.[code];
      return isDiagnosticMatrixValueDetectable(value);
    });
  }

  function getInjectedFaultModelsForEdgeTestPoint(edge){
    const rows=getDiagnosticRowsForEdgeTestPointOptions();
    const rowByFaultId=new Map(rows.map(row=>[getDiagnosticRowFaultId(row),row]).filter(([id])=>id));
    const models=new Map();
    const append=(model,idOverride='',options={})=>{
      const id=idOverride||model?.id||model?.faultModelId||model?.faultTypeId||model?.modelId||model?.faultId;
      if(!id) return;
      const catalog=typeof getFaultCatalogModel==='function'?getFaultCatalogModel(id):null;
      const row=rowByFaultId.get(id)||{};
      const merged={...catalog,...row,...model,id};
      const targetKind=merged.targetKind||merged.target?.kind||merged.visualInjection?.targetKind||'';
      const targetId=merged.targetId||merged.target?.id||merged.visualInjection?.targetId||'';
      const targetNodeId=merged.targetNodeId||(targetKind==='node'?targetId:'')||merged.hostNodeId||merged.visualInjection?.targetNodeId;
      const targetEdgeId=merged.targetEdgeId||(targetKind==='edge'?targetId:'')||merged.edgeId||merged.visualInjection?.targetEdgeId;
      const affectedEdges=new Set([
        ...list(merged.affectedEdges),
        ...list(merged.injectedFault?.affectedEdges),
        ...list(merged.visualInjection?.affectedEdges),
        targetEdgeId
      ].filter(Boolean));
      const applies=options.force===true
        ||targetEdgeId===edge?.id
        ||affectedEdges.has(edge?.id)
        ||targetNodeId===edge?.sourceNodeId
        ||targetNodeId===edge?.targetNodeId
        ||diagnosticRowDetectsEdge(row,edge);
      if(!applies) return;
      const existing=models.get(id);
      models.set(id,existing?{...existing,...merged,id}:{...merged,id});
    };
    list(S.faultTags).filter(tag=>tag?.active!==false&&tag?.enabled!==false).forEach(tag=>{
      append(tag,tag.faultModelId||tag.faultTypeId||tag.modelId||tag.faultId||tag.id,{force:true});
    });
    list(S.faultInstances).forEach(instance=>{
      append(instance,instance.faultTypeId||instance.faultModelId||instance.modelId||instance.id,{force:true});
    });
    return Array.from(models.values());
  }

  function getEdgeTestPointSourceFaultOptions(edge){
    const options=getInjectedFaultModelsForEdgeTestPoint(edge);
    const seen=new Set();
    return options.filter(model=>{
      const id=model?.id||model?.faultTypeId||'';
      if(!id||seen.has(id)) return false;
      seen.add(id);
      return true;
    });
  }

  function getEdgeTestPointFaultComponentId(model){
    const targetKind=model?.targetKind||model?.target?.kind||'';
    const targetId=model?.targetId||model?.target?.id||'';
    return targetId||model?.targetNodeId||model?.targetEdgeId||model?.hostNodeId||model?.edgeId||`${targetKind||'target'}:unbound`;
  }

  function getEdgeTestPointFaultComponentLabel(model){
    const componentId=getEdgeTestPointFaultComponentId(model);
    const targetKind=model?.targetKind||model?.target?.kind||'';
    if((targetKind==='edge'||model?.targetEdgeId===componentId)&&componentId){
      const edge=list(S.modelEdges).concat(list(S.edges)).find(item=>item?.id===componentId);
      return edge?.label||edge?.signalLabel||edge?.name||edge?.signalId||componentId;
    }
    const node=list(S.modelNodes).concat(list(S.nodes)).find(item=>item?.id===componentId);
    return node?.props?.name||node?.name||node?.label||componentId||'未绑定组件';
  }

  function getEdgeTestPointFaultGroups(edge){
    const groups=new Map();
    getInjectedFaultModelsForEdgeTestPoint(edge).forEach(model=>{
      const id=model?.id||model?.faultTypeId||'';
      if(!id) return;
      const componentId=getEdgeTestPointFaultComponentId(model);
      if(!groups.has(componentId)){
        groups.set(componentId,{
          componentId,
          componentName:getEdgeTestPointFaultComponentLabel(model),
          faults:[],
          faultIds:new Set()
        });
      }
      const group=groups.get(componentId);
      if(group.faultIds.has(id)) return;
      group.faultIds.add(id);
      group.faults.push(model);
    });
    return Array.from(groups.values()).map(group=>({
      componentId:group.componentId,
      componentName:group.componentName,
      faults:group.faults
    }));
  }

  function getEdgeTestPointDefaultName(edge){
    const source=getNode(edge?.sourceNodeId);
    const target=getNode(edge?.targetNodeId);
    return edge?.label
      || edge?.signalName
      || edge?.name
      || edge?.signalId
      || `${source?.props?.name||source?.name||edge?.sourceNodeId||'Source'} -> ${target?.props?.name||target?.name||edge?.targetNodeId||'Target'}`;
  }

  function createEdgeTestPointDraft(edge){
    const state=S;
    const pointCount=list(state.diagnosticTestPoints).length+list(state.testPoints).length+list(state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints).length;
    const existingIds=new Set([
      ...list(state.diagnosticTestPoints),
      ...list(state.testPoints),
      ...list(state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints)
    ].map(point=>point?.pointId||point?.id).filter(Boolean));
    let index=1;
    let pointId=`tp-${edge.id}-${index}`;
    while(existingIds.has(pointId)){
      index+=1;
      pointId=`tp-${edge.id}-${index}`;
    }
    return {
      pointId,
      id:pointId,
      shortName:`M${pointCount+1}`,
      name:getEdgeTestPointDefaultName(edge),
      edgeId:edge.id,
      signalId:edge.signalId||'',
      channelId:edge.channelId||'',
      sourceName:getNode(edge.sourceNodeId)?.props?.name||edge.sourceNodeId||'',
      targetName:getNode(edge.targetNodeId)?.props?.name||edge.targetNodeId||'',
      detects:[],
      manuallyAdded:true
    };
  }

  function addEdgeManualTestPoint(edge){
    if(!edge?.id) return null;
    const state=S;
    if(!Array.isArray(state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints)) state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints=[];
    const manualPoint=createEdgeTestPointDraft(edge);
    state.manualDiagnosticTestPoints.push(manualPoint);
    state.diagnosticTestPointManualCleared=false;
    delete state.compactDiagnosticFixedPoints;
    delete state.compactDiagnosticFixedPointSignature;
    delete state.compactDiagnosticPointSignature;
    return manualPoint;
  }

  function findManualEdgeTestPoint(edge,pointId){
    return list(S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints).find(point=>
      (point.pointId||point.id)===pointId
      && (point.edgeId||point.edgeID||point.targetEdgeId||'')===edge?.id
    )||null;
  }

  function renderEdgeTestPointFaultOptions(edge,point){
    const selected=new Set(list(point?.detects));
    const groups=getEdgeTestPointFaultGroups(edge);
    if(!groups.length){
      return '<div class="props-empty-state">源节点暂无可注入故障类型</div>';
    }
    return groups.map((group,index)=>{
      const open=group.faults.some(model=>selected.has(model.id||model.faultTypeId))||index===0?'open':'';
      return `
        <details class="edge-testpoint-fault-component" data-edge-testpoint-component="${text(group.componentId)}" ${open}>
          <summary>${text(group.componentName)}</summary>
          <div class="edge-testpoint-fault-component__list">
            ${group.faults.map(model=>{
        const id=model.id||model.faultTypeId;
        const checked=selected.has(id)?'checked':'';
        return `
              <label class="props-layer-toggle edge-testpoint-fault-option">
                <input type="checkbox" data-edge-testpoint-fault="${text(id)}" ${checked}>
                <span>${text(model.displayName||model.name||id)}</span>
              </label>`;
      }).join('')}
          </div>
        </details>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function normalizeDiagnosticTestPointType(value){
    return value === 'virtual' ? 'virtual' : 'physical';
  }

  function diagnosticPointTypeLabel(value){
    return normalizeDiagnosticTestPointType(value)==='virtual'?'虚拟测点':'物理测点';
  }

  function renderEdgeTestPointCard(edge,point,index){
    const pointId=point.pointId||point.id||`tp-${edge.id}-${index+1}`;
    return `
      <div class="edge-testpoint-card" data-edge-testpoint-card="${text(pointId)}">
        <div class="edge-testpoint-card-head">
          <span>${text(point.shortName||`M${index+1}`)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="props-field">
          <label>测点名称</label>
          <input data-edge-testpoint-name value="${text(point.name||getEdgeTestPointDefaultName(edge))}">
        </div>
        <div class="props-field">
          <label>测点类型</label>
          <select data-edge-testpoint-type>
            <option value="physical" ${normalizeDiagnosticTestPointType(point.pointType)==='physical'?'selected':''}>物理测点</option>
            <option value="virtual" ${normalizeDiagnosticTestPointType(point.pointType)==='virtual'?'selected':''}>虚拟测点</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="pgroup edge-testpoint-fault-group">
          <div class="pglbl">可检测故障</div>
          <div class="props-fault-slot-layers edge-testpoint-fault-list" data-edge-testpoint-fault-list>
            ${renderEdgeTestPointFaultOptions(edge,point)}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="props-actions edge-testpoint-actions">
          <button type="button" class="props-save" data-save-edge-testpoint="${text(pointId)}">保存测点</button>
          <button type="button" class="props-danger" data-delete-edge-testpoint="${text(pointId)}">删除测点</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderEdgeTestPoints(edge){
    const points=getEdgeConfiguredTestPoints(edge);
    return `
      <div class="props-form" data-edge-testpoint-panel>
        <div class="pgroup">
          <div class="pglbl">测点设置</div>
          <div class="props-help">测点绑定到当前连线，可检测故障来自源节点可注入的故障类型。</div>
          <div class="edge-testpoint-list">
            ${points.length
              ?points.map((point,index)=>renderEdgeTestPointCard(edge,point,index)).join('')
              :'<div class="props-empty-state">当前连线尚未配置测点。</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="props-actions">
          <button type="button" class="props-save" data-add-edge-testpoint>新增测点</button>
          <button type="button" class="props-danger" onclick="deleteSelectedEdge()">删除连线</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function saveEdgeTestPointFromPanel(edge,pointId){
    if(!edge?.id||!pointId) return false;
    if(!Array.isArray(S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints)) S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints=[];
    let point=findManualEdgeTestPoint(edge,pointId);
    if(!point){
      const configured=getEdgeConfiguredTestPoints(edge).find(item=>(item.pointId||item.id)===pointId);
      if(!configured) return false;
      point={
        ...configured,
        pointId,
        id:pointId,
        edgeId:edge.id,
        manuallyAdded:true,
        detects:list(configured.detects)
      };
      S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints.push(point);
    }
    if(!point) return false;
    const card=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-edge-testpoint-card]'))
      .find(item=>item.dataset.edgeTestpointCard===pointId);
    if(!card) return false;
    const nameInput=card.querySelector('[data-edge-testpoint-name]');
    point.name=nameInput?.value?.trim()||point.name||getEdgeTestPointDefaultName(edge);
    const typeInput=card.querySelector('[data-edge-testpoint-type]');
    point.pointType=normalizeDiagnosticTestPointType(typeInput?.value||point.pointType);
    point.detects=Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('[data-edge-testpoint-fault]:checked'))
      .map(input=>input.dataset.edgeTestpointFault)
      .filter(Boolean);
    point.signalId=edge.signalId||point.signalId||'';
    point.channelId=edge.channelId||point.channelId||'';
    point.sourceName=getNode(edge.sourceNodeId)?.props?.name||point.sourceName||edge.sourceNodeId||'';
    point.targetName=getNode(edge.targetNodeId)?.props?.name||point.targetName||edge.targetNodeId||'';
    S.selectedDiagnosticTestPointId=point.pointId;
    delete S.compactDiagnosticFixedPoints;
    delete S.compactDiagnosticFixedPointSignature;
    delete S.compactDiagnosticPointSignature;
    S.diagnosticScanResults=[];
    S.lastDiagnosticTestPointResult=null;
    S.testPointDiagnosis=null;
    markTopologyDirty('diagnostic');
    renderPropertyPanel(edge);
    if(typeof refreshDiagnosisViews==='function') refreshDiagnosisViews();
    toast('测点已保存','s');
    return true;
  }

  function deleteEdgeTestPointFromPanel(edge,pointId){
    if(!edge?.id||!pointId||!Array.isArray(S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints)) return false;
    const before=S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints.length;
    S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints=S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints.filter(point=>{
      const currentId=point.pointId||point.id;
      const edgeId=point.edgeId||point.edgeID||point.targetEdgeId||'';
      return !(currentId===pointId&&edgeId===edge.id);
    });
    if(S.manualDiagnosticTestPoints.length===before) return false;
    if(S.selectedDiagnosticTestPointId===pointId) S.selectedDiagnosticTestPointId='';
    delete S.compactDiagnosticFixedPoints;
    delete S.compactDiagnosticFixedPointSignature;
    delete S.compactDiagnosticPointSignature;
    S.diagnosticScanResults=[];
    S.lastDiagnosticTestPointResult=null;
    S.testPointDiagnosis=null;
    markTopologyDirty('diagnostic');
    renderPropertyPanel(edge);
    if(typeof refreshDiagnosisViews==='function') refreshDiagnosisViews();
    toast('测点已删除','s');
    return true;
  }

  function bindEdgeTestPointActions(edge,host){
    host?.querySelector?.('[data-add-edge-testpoint]')?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      addEdgeManualTestPoint(edge);
      renderPropertyPanel(edge);
    });
    host?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-save-edge-testpoint]')?.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      saveEdgeTestPointFromPanel(edge,button.dataset.saveEdgeTestpoint);
    }));
    host?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-delete-edge-testpoint]')?.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      deleteEdgeTestPointFromPanel(edge,button.dataset.deleteEdgeTestpoint);
    }));
  }

  function bindLegacyOverviewActions(target,host){
    if(S.propertyPanelTab!=='overview'||!needsLegacyOverviewCompat(target)){return;}
    if(target.type==='instrument_scope'){
      host.querySelector('[data-scope-action="open"]')?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        openScope(target.id);
        renderPropertyPanel(target);
      });
    }
    if(!target.type?.startsWith('instrument_')){return;}
    host.querySelector('[data-instrument-action="export"]')?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      window.__GZ_EXPORT_INSTRUMENT_SAMPLES__?.(target);
    });
    host.querySelector('[data-instrument-action="clear"]')?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      window.__GZ_CLEAR_INSTRUMENT_SAMPLES__?.(target);
    });
  }

  function bindFaultSlotEditorActions(host){
    const saveButton=host?.querySelector?.('[data-save-fault-slots]');
    if(!saveButton||saveButton.dataset.saveFaultSlotsBound){return;}
    saveButton.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      savePropertyPanelFaultSlots();
    });
    saveButton.dataset.saveFaultSlotsBound='true';
    const injectButton=host?.querySelector?.('[data-open-property-fault-dialog]');
    if(injectButton&&!injectButton.dataset.openPropertyFaultDialogBound){
      injectButton.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        openPropertyPanelTargetFaultDialog();
      });
      injectButton.dataset.openPropertyFaultDialogBound='true';
    }
  }

  function bindPropertyPanelNodeActions(host){
    const saveButton=host?.querySelector?.('[data-property-save-node]');
    if(!saveButton||saveButton.dataset.propertySaveNodeBound){return;}
    saveButton.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      saveSelectedNode();
    });
    saveButton.dataset.propertySaveNodeBound='true';
  }

  function renderScopeOverviewCompact(node){
    const incoming=typeof getIncomingEdgesForNode==='function'?getIncomingEdgesForNode(node.id):[];
    const configuredChannelLabel=(index)=>{
      const raw=String(node.props?.signal||'').trim();
      if(!raw){return '';}
      const part=raw.replace(/\|/g,'/').split('/')[index]||'';
      return part.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*CH\\s*${index+1}\\s*[:\\uFF1A_-]?\\s*`,'i'),'').trim();
    };
    const channelCard=(index)=>{
      const edge=incoming[index];
      const channelKey=index===1?'ch2':'ch1';
      const configuredState=typeof getScopePanelChannelState==='function'
        ?getScopePanelChannelState(node,channelKey)
        :null;
      const source=edge&&typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(edge.sourceNodeId):null;
      let label=configuredState?.label||(edge
        ?`${source?.props?.name||edge.sourceNodeId} / ${getPortLabelForPanel(source,'output',edge.sourcePortIndex||0)}`
        :'未接入');
      const configuredLabel=configuredChannelLabel(index);
      if(configuredLabel){label=`${configuredLabel} · ${label}`;}
      return `
        <div class="scope-mini-channel ${edge?'is-connected':''}" data-scope-mini-channel="${index+1}" data-scope-panel-channel="${channelKey}">
          <span>CH${index+1}</span>
          <strong>${text(label)}</strong>
        </div>`;
    };
    return `
      <div class="scope-overview-compact" data-scope-overview-panel="${text(node.id)}" data-scope-panel="oscilloscope">
        <span class="props-visually-hidden">&#x793a;&#x6ce2;&#x5668;&#x914d;&#x7f6e; &#x6a21;&#x5757;&#x540d;&#x79f0; &#x91c7;&#x6837;&#x7387; &#x901a;&#x9053;&#x8bf4;&#x660e;</span>
        <button type="button" class="scope-overview-open" data-scope-action="open">查看波形</button>
        <div class="scope-mini-channel-list">
          ${channelCard(0)}
          ${channelCard(1)}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  const SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS=[
    {key:'ch1',label:'CH1',fallback:'\u901a\u9053 1'},
    {key:'ch2',label:'CH2',fallback:'\u901a\u9053 2'}
  ];
  const SCOPE_EXPORT_FIELDS=[
    {key:'time',label:'\u65f6\u95f4'},
    {key:'actual',label:'\u5f53\u524d\u503c'},
    {key:'reference',label:'\u53c2\u8003\u503c'},
    {key:'residual',label:'\u6b8b\u5dee'}
  ];

  function normalizeScopeExportSettings(node){
    const raw=node?.props?.scopeExport&&typeof node.props.scopeExport==='object'?node.props.scopeExport:{};
    const allowedChannels=new Set(SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS.map(item=>item.key));
    const allowedFields=new Set(SCOPE_EXPORT_FIELDS.map(item=>item.key));
    const channels=Array.isArray(raw.channels)
      ?raw.channels.filter(item=>allowedChannels.has(item))
      :SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS.map(item=>item.key);
    const fields=Array.isArray(raw.fields)
      ?raw.fields.filter(item=>allowedFields.has(item))
      :['time','actual','reference','residual'];
    return {
      format:'csv',
      channels:channels.length?channels:SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS.map(item=>item.key),
      fields:fields.length?fields:['time','actual']
    };
  }

  function getScopeExportBucket(scopeId,mode='actual'){
    const source=mode==='reference'?SIM?.reference:SIM?.actual;
    if(source&&typeof ensureScopeChannelBucket==='function'){
      return ensureScopeChannelBucket(source,scopeId);
    }
    const samples=source?.scopeSamples?.[scopeId];
    if(samples&&!Array.isArray(samples)){return samples;}
    return {ch1:[],ch2:[]};
  }

  function getScopeChannelDisplayLabel(node,channelKey,index){
    const state=typeof getScopePanelChannelState==='function'
      ?getScopePanelChannelState(node,channelKey)
      :null;
    const raw=String(node.props?.signal||'').trim();
    const configured=raw?((raw.replace(/\|/g,'/').split('/')[index]||'').replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*CH\\s*${index+1}\\s*[:\\uFF1A_-]?\\s*`,'i'),'').trim()):'';
    return configured||state?.label||SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS[index]?.fallback||channelKey;
  }

  function renderScopeExportSettings(node){
    const settings=normalizeScopeExportSettings(node);
    const actualBucket=getScopeExportBucket(node.id,'actual');
    const channelOption=(item,index)=>{
      const count=Array.isArray(actualBucket[item.key])?actualBucket[item.key].length:0;
      const checked=settings.channels.includes(item.key)?' checked':'';
      return `
        <label class="scope-export-option">
          <input type="checkbox" data-scope-export-channel="${item.key}"${checked}>
          <span>
            <strong>${text(item.label)}</strong>
            <em>${text(getScopeChannelDisplayLabel(node,item.key,index))} · ${count} ${'\u6761\u6837\u672c'}</em>
          </span>
        </label>`;
    };
    const fieldOption=(item)=>{
      const checked=settings.fields.includes(item.key)?' checked':'';
      return `
        <label class="scope-export-chip">
          <input type="checkbox" data-scope-export-field="${item.key}"${checked}>
          <span>${text(item.label)}</span>
        </label>`;
    };
    return `
      <div class="scope-export-panel" data-scope-export-settings="${text(node.id)}">
        <div class="scope-export-summary">
          <div>
            <div class="scope-export-kicker">\u5bfc\u51fa\u683c\u5f0f</div>
            <strong>CSV</strong>
          </div>
          <span>${text(settings.channels.length)} ${'\u4e2a\u901a\u9053'} · ${text(settings.fields.length)} ${'\u4e2a\u5b57\u6bb5'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pgroup">
          <div class="pglbl">\u5bfc\u51fa\u901a\u9053</div>
          <div class="scope-export-options">
            ${SCOPE_EXPORT_CHANNELS.map(channelOption).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pgroup">
          <div class="pglbl">\u5bfc\u51fa\u5b57\u6bb5</div>
          <div class="scope-export-fields">
            ${SCOPE_EXPORT_FIELDS.map(fieldOption).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="props-help">\u5bfc\u51fa\u65f6\u4f1a\u6309\u901a\u9053\u5206\u884c\u5199\u5165 CSV\uff0c\u9002\u5408\u540e\u7eed\u5bf9\u6bd4\u6545\u969c\u524d\u540e\u6ce2\u5f62\u3002</div>
        </div>
        <div class="props-actions scope-export-actions">
          <button type="button" class="props-secondary" data-scope-export-save>\u4fdd\u5b58\u5bfc\u51fa\u8bbe\u7f6e</button>
          <button type="button" class="props-save" data-scope-export-csv>\u5bfc\u51fa CSV</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function readScopeExportSettings(host,node){
    const channels=[...host.querySelectorAll('[data-scope-export-channel]')]
      .filter(input=>input.checked)
      .map(input=>input.dataset.scopeExportChannel)
      .filter(Boolean);
    const fields=[...host.querySelectorAll('[data-scope-export-field]')]
      .filter(input=>input.checked)
      .map(input=>input.dataset.scopeExportField)
      .filter(Boolean);
    return {
      ...normalizeScopeExportSettings(node),
      channels:channels.length?channels:['ch1'],
      fields:fields.length?fields:['time','actual']
    };
  }

  function formatScopeCsvValue(value){
    const numeric=Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(numeric)?numeric.toFixed(6):'';
  }

  function createScopeExportCsv(node,settings){
    const actualBucket=getScopeExportBucket(node.id,'actual');
    const referenceBucket=getScopeExportBucket(node.id,'reference');
    const lines=[['channel',...settings.fields].join(',')];
    settings.channels.forEach(channelKey=>{
      const actualSamples=Array.isArray(actualBucket[channelKey])?actualBucket[channelKey]:[];
      const referenceSamples=Array.isArray(referenceBucket[channelKey])?referenceBucket[channelKey]:[];
      actualSamples.forEach((sample,index)=>{
        const reference=referenceSamples[index]||{};
        const actualValue=sample?.actual??sample?.v;
        const referenceValue=reference?.reference??reference?.actual??reference?.v;
        const row={time:sample?.t,actual:actualValue,reference:referenceValue,residual:Number(actualValue)-Number(referenceValue)};
        lines.push([channelKey,...settings.fields.map(field=>formatScopeCsvValue(row[field]))].join(','));
      });
    });
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function exportScopeCsv(node,settings){
    const csv=createScopeExportCsv(node,settings);
    const safeName=String(node.props?.name||node.id).replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5-]+/g,'_');
    const filename=`${safeName||node.id}_scope.csv`;
    window.__GZ_LAST_SCOPE_EXPORT__={nodeId:node.id,filename,csv,settings};
    window.__GZ_LAST_INSTRUMENT_EXPORT__={nodeId:node.id,filename,csv};
    const userAgent=String(navigator?.userAgent||'');
    if(typeof Blob!=='undefined'&&typeof URL!=='undefined'&&!/jsdom/i.test(userAgent)){
      const blob=new Blob([`\uFEFF${csv}`],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link=document.createElement('a');
      link.href=url;
      link.download=filename;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();
      setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),200);
    }
    toast('\u793a\u6ce2\u5668\u6570\u636e\u5df2\u5bfc\u51fa','s');
  }

  function bindScopeExportActions(node,host){
    if(!node||node.type!=='instrument_scope'||!host){return;}
    const saveButton=host.querySelector('[data-scope-export-save]');
    const exportButton=host.querySelector('[data-scope-export-csv]');
    saveButton?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      node.props.scopeExport=readScopeExportSettings(host,node);
      renderPropertyPanel(node);
      toast('\u793a\u6ce2\u5668\u5bfc\u51fa\u8bbe\u7f6e\u5df2\u4fdd\u5b58','s');
    });
    exportButton?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      const settings=readScopeExportSettings(host,node);
      node.props.scopeExport=settings;
      exportScopeCsv(node,settings);
    });
  }

  function renderTypedPropertyPanel(target){
    const pe=document.getElementById('pe');
    const pd=document.getElementById('pd');
    if(!pe||!pd){return;}
    syncPropertyTabs();
    setHeaderSub(target);
    if(!target){
      pe.style.display='flex';
      pd.style.display='none';
      pd.innerHTML='';
      return;
    }
    pe.style.display='none';
    pd.style.display='block';
    if(isEdgeTarget(target)){
      if(S.propertyPanelTab==='parameters'){pd.innerHTML=renderEdgeParameters(target);}
      else if(S.propertyPanelTab==='faults'){pd.innerHTML=renderFaults(target);}
      else if(S.propertyPanelTab==='testpoints'){pd.innerHTML=renderEdgeTestPoints(target);}
      else if(S.propertyPanelTab==='outputs'){pd.innerHTML=renderEdgeOutputs(target);}
      else{pd.innerHTML=renderEdgeOverview(target);}
      bindFaultSlotEditorActions(pd);
      bindEdgeTestPointActions(target,pd);
      return;
    }
    if(S.propertyPanelTab==='parameters'){pd.innerHTML=renderNodeParameters(target);}
    else if(S.propertyPanelTab==='faults'){pd.innerHTML=renderFaults(target);}
    else if(target.type==='instrument_scope'&&S.propertyPanelTab==='outputs'){pd.innerHTML=renderScopeExportSettings(target);}
    else if(S.propertyPanelTab==='outputs'){pd.innerHTML=renderNodeOutputs(target);}
    else if(target.type==='instrument_scope'){pd.innerHTML=renderScopeOverviewCompact(target);}
    else{pd.innerHTML=renderNodeOverview(target);}
    bindFaultSlotEditorActions(pd);
    bindPropertyPanelNodeActions(pd);
    bindScopeExportActions(target,pd);
    bindLegacyOverviewActions(target,pd);
    if(target.type==='simulation_block'){
      updateModelPackageStatus(target);
    }
  }

  const __typedPropertyPanelRender=renderPropertyPanel;
  renderPropertyPanel=function(target){
    legacyOverviewSnapshot='';
    const result=__typedPropertyPanelRender(target);
    if(S.propertyPanelTab==='overview'&&needsLegacyOverviewCompat(target)){
      legacyOverviewSnapshot=document.getElementById('pd')?.innerHTML||'';
    }
    renderTypedPropertyPanel(target);
    return result;
  };

  function setPropertyPanelTab(tab){
    const target=getSelectedPropertyTarget();
    const kind=getCurrentPropertyPanelKind(target);
    const availableTabs=getAvailablePropertyTabs(kind);
    const nextTab=PANEL_TABS.includes(tab)&&availableTabs.includes(tab)
      ?tab
      :(availableTabs[0]||'overview');
    S.propertyPanelTab=nextTab;
    syncPropertyTabs();
    const selectedFaultTag=getSelectedFaultTag();
    if(kind==='fault-tag'&&selectedFaultTag&&typeof window.__GZ_RENDER_FAULT_TAG_PANEL__==='function'){
      window.__GZ_RENDER_FAULT_TAG_PANEL__(selectedFaultTag);
      return;
    }
    if(kind==='fault-injector'&&target&&typeof window.__GZ_RENDER_LAYERED_FAULT_INJECTOR_PANEL__==='function'){
      window.__GZ_RENDER_LAYERED_FAULT_INJECTOR_PANEL__(target);
      return;
    }
    renderPropertyPanel(target);
  }

  function saveSelectedEdgeMetadata(){
    const edge=getEdge(S.selEdge);
    if(!edge){return;}
    const value=(id)=>document.getElementById(id)?.value?.trim()||'';
    edge.lineType=value('prop-edge-line-type')||edge.lineType||'normal';
    edge.signalId=value('prop-edge-signal-id');
    edge.channelId=value('prop-edge-channel-id');
    edge.messageId=value('prop-edge-message-id');
    edge.signalRole=value('prop-edge-signal-role');
    edge.signalUnit=value('prop-edge-signal-unit');
    edge.payloadKind=value('prop-edge-payload-kind');
    edge.sampleRate=value('prop-edge-sample-rate');
    edge.faultPropagationPolicy=value('prop-edge-fault-policy')||'inherit';
    const primaryChannel={
      signalId:edge.signalId,
      channelId:edge.channelId,
      messageId:edge.messageId,
      role:edge.signalRole,
      unit:edge.signalUnit,
      payloadKind:edge.payloadKind,
      sampleRate:edge.sampleRate,
      faultPropagationPolicy:edge.faultPropagationPolicy
    };
    const previousChannels=Array.isArray(edge.signalChannels)
      ?edge.signalChannels.filter(Boolean)
      :[];
    const nextPrimary={...(previousChannels[0]||{}),...primaryChannel};
    edge.signalChannels=[nextPrimary,...previousChannels.slice(1)];
    markTopologyDirty(getMutationScopeForEdge(edge));
    renderEdges();
    renderPropertyPanel(edge);
    updateUI();
    toast('连线信号元数据已保存','s');
  }

  function savePropertyPanelTarget(){
    if(S.selEdge){saveSelectedEdgeMetadata();return;}
    if(S.selBlk){saveSelectedNode();}
  }
  window.savePropertyPanelTarget=savePropertyPanelTarget;

  function syncFaultPayloadFromBindings(target){
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.syncFaultPayloadFromBindings){
      const result=runtimeService.syncFaultPayloadFromBindings(target);
      if(result?.target){
        Object.keys(target||{}).forEach(key=>{
          if(!(key in result.target)){
            delete target[key];
          }
        });
        Object.assign(target,result.target);
      }
      return Boolean(result?.changed);
    }
    const active=Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)
      ?target.faultBindings.filter((binding)=>binding&&binding.active!==false)
      :[];
    if(active.length>0){
      target.injectedFault=active[0].injectedFault||target.injectedFault||{
        modelId:active[0].faultModelId,
        name:active[0].name,
        layer:active[0].layer,
        runtimeBehavior:active[0].runtimeBehavior,
        parameters:active[0].parameters||{}
      };
      return;
    }
    delete target.injectedFault;
  }

  function getFaultRemovalId(value){
    return value?.faultModelId
      || value?.faultTypeId
      || value?.modelId
      || value?.faultId
      || value?.id
      || value?.injectedFault?.faultModelId
      || value?.injectedFault?.faultTypeId
      || value?.injectedFault?.modelId
      || value?.injectedFault?.faultId
      || '';
  }

  function getFaultRemovalInstanceId(value){
    return value?.instanceId||value?.injectedFault?.instanceId||'';
  }

  function getFaultRemovalSlotId(value){
    return value?.slotId||value?.targetSlotId||value?.injectedFault?.slotId||value?.target?.slotId||'';
  }

  function getFaultRemovalTargetKind(value,fallback='node'){
    return value?.targetKind||value?.target?.targetKind||value?.target?.kind||value?.injectedFault?.targetKind||fallback;
  }

  function getFaultRemovalTargetId(value,fallback=''){
    return value?.targetId
      || value?.target?.targetId
      || value?.target?.id
      || value?.injectedFault?.targetId
      || value?.targetNodeId
      || value?.targetEdgeId
      || fallback;
  }

  function makeFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,binding=null,index=0){
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.createFaultRemovalRef){
      return runtimeService.createFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,binding,index);
    }
    const source=binding||target?.injectedFault||{};
    const bindingId=binding?(binding.bindingId||`legacy-${binding.faultModelId||index}`):'';
    return {
      targetKind,
      targetId:target?.id||'',
      bindingId,
      instanceId:getFaultRemovalInstanceId(source),
      faultId:getFaultRemovalId(source),
      slotId:getFaultRemovalSlotId(source)
    };
  }

  function faultRecordMatchesRemovalRef(record,ref){
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.faultRecordMatchesRemovalRef){
      return runtimeService.faultRecordMatchesRemovalRef(record,ref);
    }
    if(!record||!ref) return false;
    const recordTargetKind=getFaultRemovalTargetKind(record,ref.targetKind);
    const recordTargetId=getFaultRemovalTargetId(record,ref.targetId);
    if(recordTargetId&&recordTargetId!==ref.targetId) return false;
    if(recordTargetKind&&recordTargetKind!==ref.targetKind) return false;
    const recordInstanceId=getFaultRemovalInstanceId(record);
    if(ref.instanceId&&recordInstanceId&&recordInstanceId===ref.instanceId) return true;
    const recordFaultId=getFaultRemovalId(record);
    if(ref.faultId&&recordFaultId&&recordFaultId===ref.faultId){
      const recordSlotId=getFaultRemovalSlotId(record);
      return !ref.slotId||!recordSlotId||recordSlotId===ref.slotId;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function faultRecordMatchesAnyRemoval(record,refs){
    return (refs||[]).some(ref=>faultRecordMatchesRemovalRef(record,ref));
  }

  function hasRemainingActiveFaultId(state,faultId){
    if(!faultId) return false;
    return [
      ...(Array.isArray(state.faultInstances)?state.faultInstances:[]),
      ...(Array.isArray(state.activeFaults)?state.activeFaults:[]),
      ...(Array.isArray(state.injectedFaults)?state.injectedFaults:[]),
      ...(Array.isArray(state.appliedFaults)?state.appliedFaults:[])
    ].some(item=>item?.active!==false&&getFaultRemovalId(item)===faultId);
  }

  function removeFaultRuntimeArtifacts(targetKind,target,refs){
    const normalizedRefs=(refs||[]).filter(ref=>ref&&(ref.instanceId||ref.faultId||ref.bindingId));
    if(!normalizedRefs.length) return false;
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.removeFaultRuntimeArtifactsFromState){
      const result=runtimeService.removeFaultRuntimeArtifactsFromState(S,normalizedRefs,{
        target,
        targetKind,
        now:new Date().toISOString(),
        disabledReason:'fault-cleared-from-property-panel'
      });
      if(result?.state){
        Object.assign(S,result.state);
      }
      if(S.activeModelPackage&&Array.isArray(S.faultInstances)){
        S.activeModelPackage.faultInstances=cloneFaultPanelData(S.faultInstances);
      }
      return Boolean(result?.changed);
    }
    let changed=false;
    ['activeFaults','injectedFaults','appliedFaults','selectedFaults','faultInjectionResults'].forEach(key=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(S[key])) return;
      const before=S[key].length;
      S[key]=S[key].filter(item=>!faultRecordMatchesAnyRemoval(item,normalizedRefs));
      changed=changed||before!==S[key].length;
    });
    if(Array.isArray(S.faultInstances)){
      S.faultInstances=S.faultInstances.map(instance=>{
        if(!faultRecordMatchesAnyRemoval(instance,normalizedRefs)||instance.active===false) return instance;
        changed=true;
        return {
          ...instance,
          active:false,
          enabled:false,
          disabledAt:new Date().toISOString(),
          disabledReason:'fault-cleared-from-property-panel'
        };
      });
      if(S.activeModelPackage){
        S.activeModelPackage.faultInstances=cloneFaultPanelData(S.faultInstances);
      }
    }
    if(Array.isArray(S.faultTags)){
      const removedTagIds=new Set(S.faultTags.filter(tag=>faultRecordMatchesAnyRemoval(tag,normalizedRefs)).map(tag=>tag.id).filter(Boolean));
      const before=S.faultTags.length;
      S.faultTags=S.faultTags.filter(tag=>!faultRecordMatchesAnyRemoval(tag,normalizedRefs));
      changed=changed||before!==S.faultTags.length;
      if(removedTagIds.size&&Array.isArray(S.faultInjectionLinks)){
        const beforeLinks=S.faultInjectionLinks.length;
        S.faultInjectionLinks=S.faultInjectionLinks.filter(link=>{
          if(removedTagIds.has(link.sourceTagId)) return false;
          if(link.targetNodeId===target?.id||link.targetEdgeId===target?.id){
            return !normalizedRefs.some(ref=>ref.faultId&&getFaultRemovalId(link)===ref.faultId);
          }
          return true;
        });
        changed=changed||beforeLinks!==S.faultInjectionLinks.length;
      }
    }
    if(S.injectedFaultMap&&typeof S.injectedFaultMap==='object'){
      normalizedRefs.forEach(ref=>{
        if(ref.faultId&&!hasRemainingActiveFaultId(S,ref.faultId)){
          delete S.injectedFaultMap[ref.faultId];
          changed=true;
        }
      });
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function refreshFaultCancellation(targetKind,target){
    if(!target){return;}
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.refreshFaultCancellationState){
      const result=runtimeService.refreshFaultCancellationState(S,SIM,{targetKind,target});
      if(result?.target){
        Object.keys(target).forEach(key=>{
          if(!(key in result.target)){
            delete target[key];
          }
        });
        Object.assign(target,result.target);
      }
      if(result?.state){
        Object.assign(S,result.state);
      }
      if(result?.simulation){
        Object.assign(SIM,result.simulation);
      }
    }else{
      syncFaultPayloadFromBindings(target);
      if(targetKind==='node'&&!hasActiveFaultForPanel(target)){
        S.faultedBlks=(S.faultedBlks||[]).filter((id)=>id!==target.id);
        if(SIM?.actual?.nodeStates?.[target.id]){
          delete SIM.actual.nodeStates[target.id].bindingStates;
        }
      }
      if(targetKind==='edge'&&SIM?.actual?.edgeStates?.[target.id]){
        delete SIM.actual.edgeStates[target.id];
      }
    }
    refreshFaultUiAfterChange(target);
  }

  function resolveFaultTarget(targetKind,targetId){
    return targetKind==='edge'?getEdge(targetId):getNode(targetId);
  }

  function removeFaultBinding(targetKind,targetId,bindingId){
    const target=resolveFaultTarget(targetKind,targetId);
    if(!target){return false;}
    let changed=false;
    const removedRefs=[];
    if(Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)){
      target.faultBindings=target.faultBindings.map((binding,index)=>{
        const id=binding?.bindingId||`legacy-${binding?.faultModelId||index}`;
        if(id===bindingId||binding?.faultModelId===bindingId){
          changed=true;
          removedRefs.push(makeFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,binding,index));
          return {...binding,active:false,disabledAt:new Date().toISOString()};
        }
        return binding;
      });
    }
    if(!changed&&target.injectedFault){
      removedRefs.push(makeFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,target.injectedFault));
      delete target.injectedFault;
      changed=true;
    }
    if(changed) removeFaultRuntimeArtifacts(targetKind,target,removedRefs);
    refreshFaultCancellation(targetKind,target);
    if(changed){toast('已取消故障注入','s');}
    return changed;
  }

  function clearFaultBindings(targetKind,targetId){
    const target=resolveFaultTarget(targetKind,targetId);
    if(!target){return false;}
    const removedRefs=[];
    if(Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)){
      target.faultBindings=target.faultBindings.map((binding,index)=>{
        if(binding&&binding.active!==false){
          removedRefs.push(makeFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,binding,index));
        }
        return {...binding,active:false,disabledAt:new Date().toISOString()};
      });
    }
    if(target.injectedFault){
      removedRefs.push(makeFaultRemovalRef(targetKind,target,target.injectedFault));
    }
    delete target.injectedFault;
    removeFaultRuntimeArtifacts(targetKind,target,removedRefs);
    refreshFaultCancellation(targetKind,target);
    toast('已清空故障注入','s');
    return true;
  }

  const __typedCollectDataflowEdges=window.collectDataflowEdges;
  if(typeof __typedCollectDataflowEdges==='function'){
    window.collectDataflowEdges=function(){
      return (__typedCollectDataflowEdges()||[]).map((item)=>{
        const signal=edgePrimarySignal(item.edge);
        return {
          ...item,
          metrics:{
            ...item.metrics,
            signalName:signal.signalId||item.metrics.signalName,
            signalId:signal.signalId,
            channelId:signal.channelId,
            messageId:signal.messageId,
            signalRole:signal.signalRole,
            signalUnit:signal.signalUnit,
            payloadKind:signal.payloadKind,
            faultPropagationPolicy:signal.faultPropagationPolicy
          }
        };
      });
    };
  }

  syncPropertyTabs();
  Object.assign(window,{
    clearFaultBindings,
    removeFaultBinding,
    renderPropertyPanel,
    savePropertyPanelFaultSlots,
    savePropertyPanelTarget,
    saveSelectedEdgeMetadata,
    setPropertyPanelTab,
    __GZ_SYNC_PROPERTY_TABS__:syncPropertyTabs
  });
})();

// --- 多故障实例的最终视觉标记：兼容 injectedFault，并支持 faultBindings[] ---
(function(){
  function getFaultBindingApi(){
    return window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__||null;
  }

  function activeFaultBindings(target){
    if(!target){return [];}
    const api=getFaultBindingApi();
    if(api?.getFaultBindings){
      return api.getFaultBindings(target,{activeOnly:true})||[];
    }
    if(Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)){
      return target.faultBindings.filter(binding=>binding&&binding.active!==false);
    }
    return target.injectedFault?[{injectedFault:target.injectedFault,name:target.injectedFault.name,layer:target.injectedFault.layer,active:true}]:[];
  }

  function hasActiveFault(target){
    return Boolean(target?.injectedFault)||activeFaultBindings(target).length>0;
  }

  function decorateFaultBindingNodes(){
    if(!S||!Array.isArray(S.modelNodes)){return;}
    S.modelNodes.forEach(node=>{
      const el=document.getElementById(`b-${node.id}`);
      if(!el){return;}
      el.classList.toggle('faulted',Boolean(S.faultedBlks?.includes(node.id))||hasActiveFault(node));
      const badge=el.querySelector('.fbadge');
      const count=activeFaultBindings(node).length;
      if(badge&&count>1){badge.textContent=String(Math.min(count,9));}
    });
  }

  function decorateFaultBindingEdges(){
    if(!S||!Array.isArray(S.modelEdges)){return;}
    S.modelEdges.forEach(edge=>{
      const faulted=hasActiveFault(edge);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-edge-id="${edge.id}"]`).forEach(el=>{
        if(el.classList.contains('edge-path')||el.classList.contains('edge-label')){
          el.classList.toggle('is-faulted',faulted);
        }
        if(faulted&&el.classList.contains('edge-path')){
          el.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#edge-arrow-fault)');
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function renderFaultBindingStack(target){
    const pd=document.getElementById('pd');
    if(!pd||!target){return;}
    pd.querySelector('[data-fault-binding-stack]')?.remove();
    const bindings=activeFaultBindings(target);
    if(bindings.length<=1){return;}
    const rows=bindings.map((binding,index)=>`
      <div class="prow">
        <span class="pk">故障 ${index+1}</span>
        <span class="pv pv-fault">${escapeHtml(binding.name||binding.injectedFault?.name||binding.faultModelId||'故障模型')} · ${escapeHtml(binding.propagationMode||'signalTransform')}</span>
      </div>`).join('');
    const html=`
      <div class="pgroup" data-fault-binding-stack>
        <div class="pglbl">多故障实例</div>
        ${rows}
      </div>`;
    const anchor=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-runtime-summary]')||pd.querySelector('.pgroup');
    if(anchor){anchor.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',html);}
    else{pd.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',html);}
  }

  const __faultBindingRenderEdges=renderEdges;
  renderEdges=function(){
    const result=__faultBindingRenderEdges();
    decorateFaultBindingEdges();
    return result;
  };

  const __faultBindingRenderModelNodes=renderModelNodes;
  renderModelNodes=function(){
    const result=__faultBindingRenderModelNodes();
    decorateFaultBindingNodes();
    decorateFaultBindingEdges();
    return result;
  };

  const __faultBindingRenderPropertyPanel=renderPropertyPanel;
  renderPropertyPanel=function(target){
    const result=__faultBindingRenderPropertyPanel(target);
    renderFaultBindingStack(target);
    return result;
  };

  Object.assign(window,{
    renderEdges,
    renderModelNodes,
    renderPropertyPanel
  });
})();

// --- 多信号流图嵌入：从拓扑边生成可视化指标和右侧诊断 ---
(function(){
  COMPONENT_LIBRARY.instrument_signal_flow={
    label:'多信号流图',
    badge:'仪器',
    className:'b-inst b-signal-flow',
    width:170,
    height:78,
    defaults:{
      name:'多信号流图',
      instrumentType:'多信号流图',
      sampleRate:'随仿真步长',
      signal:'全局拓扑边',
      aggregation:'edge_metrics'
    }
  };

  const DATAFLOW_VALUE_EMPTY='--';
  let preserveDataflowPanelRender=false;

  function formatDataflowNumber(value,digits=3){
    if(value===null||value===undefined||value===''){return DATAFLOW_VALUE_EMPTY;}
    const numeric=Number(value);
    if(!Number.isFinite(numeric)){return String(value);}
    if(Math.abs(numeric)>=100){return numeric.toFixed(1);}
    if(Math.abs(numeric)>=10){return numeric.toFixed(2);}
    return numeric.toFixed(digits);
  }

  function formatDataflowPercent(value){
    if(value===null||value===undefined||value===''){return DATAFLOW_VALUE_EMPTY;}
    const numeric=Number(value);
    if(!Number.isFinite(numeric)){return String(value);}
    return `${Math.round(numeric*100)}%`;
  }

  function getFaultRuntimeApiForDataflow(){
    return window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__||null;
  }

  function getActiveFaultBindingsForDataflow(target){
    if(!target){return [];}
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApiForDataflow();
    if(api?.getFaultBindings){
      return api.getFaultBindings(target,{activeOnly:true})||[];
    }
    if(Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)){
      return target.faultBindings.filter(binding=>binding&&binding.active!==false);
    }
    return target.injectedFault?[{
      faultModelId:target.injectedFault.modelId||'',
      name:target.injectedFault.name||'',
      layer:target.injectedFault.layer||'',
      runtimeBehavior:target.injectedFault.runtimeBehavior||'',
      parameters:target.injectedFault.parameters||{},
      propagationMode:target.injectedFault.layer==='protocol'?'protocolEdge':'signalTransform',
      active:true,
      injectedFault:target.injectedFault
    }]:[];
  }

  function getPrimaryFaultBindingForDataflow(target){
    return getActiveFaultBindingsForDataflow(target)[0]||null;
  }

  function getFaultModelFromBindingForDataflow(binding){
    if(!binding){return null;}
    const model=getImportedFaultModel(binding.faultModelId||binding.injectedFault?.modelId||'')||binding.injectedFault||binding;
    return {
      ...model,
      runtimeBehavior:binding.runtimeBehavior||model.runtimeBehavior||'',
      __faultBinding:binding
    };
  }

  function getFaultModelForEdge(edge){
    const binding=getPrimaryFaultBindingForDataflow(edge);
    if(binding){return getFaultModelFromBindingForDataflow(binding);}
    if(!edge?.injectedFault){return null;}
    return getImportedFaultModel(edge.injectedFault.modelId||'')||edge.injectedFault;
  }

  function getFaultModelForNode(node){
    const binding=getPrimaryFaultBindingForDataflow(node);
    if(binding){return getFaultModelFromBindingForDataflow(binding);}
    if(!node?.injectedFault){return null;}
    return getImportedFaultModel(node.injectedFault.modelId||'')||node.injectedFault;
  }

  function getFaultPropagationModeForDataflow(model){
    const binding=model?.__faultBinding;
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApiForDataflow();
    return binding?.propagationMode
      || model?.propagationMode
      || model?.injectionDesign?.propagationMode
      || api?.inferFaultPropagationMode?.(model,binding?.injectedFault)
      || 'signalTransform';
  }

  function edgeMatchesFaultBindingChannel(binding,edge){
    if(!binding||!edge){return true;}
    const sourcePort=binding.sourcePortIndex??binding.portIndex??binding.channelIndex;
    if(sourcePort!==undefined&&sourcePort!==null&&sourcePort!==''&&Number(sourcePort)!==Number(edge.sourcePortIndex||0)){
      return false;
    }
    const edgeChannel=edge.channelId||edge.signalId||edge.signalChannel||edge.sourcePort?.varName||edge.sourcePortMeta?.varName||'';
    const channels=binding.affectedChannels||binding.signalChannels||binding.channelIds;
    if(Array.isArray(channels)&&channels.length>0&&edgeChannel){
      return channels.map(String).includes(String(edgeChannel));
    }
    return true;
  }

  function canNodeFaultPropagateToEdge(model,edge){
    if(!model){return false;}
    const binding=model.__faultBinding||null;
    const mode=getFaultPropagationModeForDataflow(model);
    if(mode==='localOnly'||mode==='parameterInfluence'||mode==='protocolEdge'){
      return false;
    }
    return edgeMatchesFaultBindingChannel(binding,edge);
  }

  function readFaultParam(model,keys,fallback=null){
    const params=model?.defaultParameters||model?.parameters||{};
    const names=Array.isArray(keys)?keys:[keys];
    for(const key of names){
      const raw=params[key];
      if(raw!==undefined&&raw!==null&&raw!==''){
        const parsed=Number(raw);
        return Number.isFinite(parsed)?parsed:raw;
      }
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  function getRuntimeEdgeValue(edge,sourceNode){
    if(edge?.currentValue!==undefined&&edge.currentValue!==null){return edge.currentValue;}
    const state=SIM?.actual?.nodeStates?.[sourceNode?.id||''];
    if(!state){return null;}
    const outputIndex=edge?.sourcePortIndex||0;
    if(Array.isArray(state.lastOutputs)&&state.lastOutputs[outputIndex]!==undefined){
      return state.lastOutputs[outputIndex];
    }
    if(outputIndex===0&&state.lastOutput!==undefined){return state.lastOutput;}
    if(Array.isArray(state.lastMiddleValues)){
      const mainCount=getNodePorts(sourceNode).outputs.filter(port=>port.kind!=='middle').length;
      const middleIndex=outputIndex-mainCount;
      if(state.lastMiddleValues[middleIndex]!==undefined){return state.lastMiddleValues[middleIndex];}
    }
    return null;
  }

  function getResidualValue(edge,targetNode){
    if(edge?.residualValue!==undefined&&edge.residualValue!==null){return edge.residualValue;}
    const targetState=SIM?.actual?.nodeStates?.[targetNode?.id||''];
    const targetName=String(targetNode?.props?.name||'').toLowerCase();
    const residualLike=targetNode?.type==='sum_block'||targetName.includes('residual')||targetName.includes('残差');
    if(!residualLike){return null;}
    if(targetState?.lastOutput!==undefined){return targetState.lastOutput;}
    if(Array.isArray(targetState?.lastOutputs)&&targetState.lastOutputs.length){return targetState.lastOutputs[0];}
    return null;
  }

  function getPortLabel(node,direction,index){
    const ports=getNodePorts(node)[direction==='input'?'inputs':'outputs']||[];
    const port=ports[index||0];
    if(!port){return `#${(index||0)+1}`;}
    return getPortDisplayName(port)||port.label||`#${(index||0)+1}`;
  }

  function getEdgeSignalName(edge,sourceNode){
    const outputLabel=getPortLabel(sourceNode,'output',edge?.sourcePortIndex||0);
    return `${sourceNode?.props?.name||'上游信号'} · ${outputLabel}`;
  }

  const DATAFLOW_STAGE_DEFS=[
    {id:'command',labelZh:'指令与参考',roles:['command','source']},
    {id:'control',labelZh:'控制与分配',roles:['control','allocation']},
    {id:'plant',labelZh:'执行与机体',roles:['actuation','plant']},
    {id:'measurement',labelZh:'测量与估计',roles:['measurement','estimate','protocol']},
    {id:'diagnostic',labelZh:'诊断与残差',roles:['residual','diagnostic']}
  ];

  const DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES={
    none:{
      labelZh:'正常',
      descriptionZh:'当前没有识别到故障影响，测点作为正常链路观测。'
    },
    propagated:{
      labelZh:'传播型',
      descriptionZh:'传感器、执行器或协议链路故障可沿信号继续影响下游模块。'
    },
    localEffect:{
      labelZh:'本地参数型',
      descriptionZh:'物理参数或控制参数变化主要表现为本地参数影响，再由模块输出间接体现。'
    },
    blocked:{
      labelZh:'阻断型',
      descriptionZh:'链路丢包、断连或保持会阻断当前信号向下游传播。'
    },
    diagnosticOnly:{
      labelZh:'诊断型',
      descriptionZh:'该测点主要用于残差、告警或诊断指标展示，不作为主控制信号传播。'
    }
  };

  const DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_ORDER=['propagated','localEffect','blocked','diagnosticOnly','none'];
  const DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_GROUP_LABELS={
    propagated:'传播型故障',
    localEffect:'本地/参数型故障',
    blocked:'阻断型故障',
    diagnosticOnly:'诊断/残差型',
    none:'正常/未受故障影响'
  };
  const DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_SCOPES_ZH={
    propagated:'沿链路传播到下游测点',
    localEffect:'本地参数影响，不直接沿线传播',
    blocked:'阻断当前链路',
    diagnosticOnly:'只作为诊断观测',
    none:'正常/未受故障影响'
  };

  const SIGNAL_ZH_PATTERNS=[
    {test:/residual|diagnostic|fault_indicator|logger|spectrum/i,name:'残差诊断',role:'residual',path:'残差诊断链路'},
    {test:/imu|gyro|accel|baro|gps|measured|sensor/i,name:'IMU 测量反馈',role:'measurement',path:'IMU 测量反馈链路'},
    {test:/estimate|estimator|state/i,name:'状态估计',role:'estimate',path:'状态估计链路'},
    {test:/command|reference|target|pilot|shaper/i,name:'姿态指令',role:'command',path:'指令输入链路'},
    {test:/alloc|motor_command|throttle|pwm/i,name:'电机指令',role:'allocation',path:'控制分配链路'},
    {test:/motor|actuator|thrust/i,name:'电机/推力响应',role:'actuation',path:'执行机构链路'},
    {test:/vehicle|body|pitch_rate|attitude|dynamics|airframe/i,name:'机体姿态响应',role:'plant',path:'机体动力学链路'},
    {test:/control|controller|error|torque|gain/i,name:'控制误差/控制输出',role:'control',path:'控制计算链路'}
  ];

  function getSemanticTextSeed(edge,metrics,sourceNode,targetNode){
    const channels=Array.isArray(edge?.signalChannels)?edge.signalChannels:[];
    return [
      edge?.id,
      edge?.signalId,
      edge?.channelId,
      edge?.messageId,
      edge?.lineType,
      metrics?.signalId,
      metrics?.signalName,
      metrics?.sourceName,
      metrics?.targetName,
      metrics?.sourcePort,
      metrics?.targetPort,
      sourceNode?.type,
      targetNode?.type,
      sourceNode?.props?.name,
      targetNode?.props?.name,
      sourceNode?.props?.moduleType,
      targetNode?.props?.moduleType,
      sourceNode?.props?.signal,
      targetNode?.props?.signal,
      ...channels.flatMap(channel=>[
        channel.signalId,
        channel.channelId,
        channel.messageId,
        channel.name,
        channel.pythonVariable,
        channel.role,
        channel.signalRole
      ])
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  }

  function getPrimarySignalChannel(edge){
    return Array.isArray(edge?.signalChannels)&&edge.signalChannels.length>0
      ?edge.signalChannels[0]
      :{};
  }

  function buildSemanticMapping(edge,metrics,meta={}){
    const primary=getPrimarySignalChannel(edge);
    const engineeringKey=edge?.signalId||metrics?.signalId||primary.signalId||edge?.id||'';
    return {
      engineeringKey,
      edgeId:edge?.id||'',
      sourceNodeId:edge?.sourceNodeId||'',
      targetNodeId:edge?.targetNodeId||'',
      signalId:edge?.signalId||metrics?.signalId||primary.signalId||'',
      channelId:edge?.channelId||metrics?.channelId||primary.channelId||primary.channel||'',
      messageId:edge?.messageId||metrics?.messageId||primary.messageId||primary.frameId||'',
      pythonVariable:edge?.pythonVariable||primary.pythonVariable||edge?.sourcePortMeta?.varName||edge?.sourcePort?.varName||meta.pythonVariable||''
    };
  }

  function inferSignalChineseMeta(edge,metrics={}){
    const sourceNode=getNode(edge?.sourceNodeId);
    const targetNode=getNode(edge?.targetNodeId);
    const seed=getSemanticTextSeed(edge,metrics,sourceNode,targetNode);
    const sourceHasIncoming=S.modelEdges.some(item=>item.targetNodeId===edge?.sourceNodeId);
    const commandLike=/command|reference|pilot|target|指令|参考/i.test(seed)||sourceNode?.type==='signal_source'||(!sourceHasIncoming&&sourceNode);
    const match=commandLike
      ?SIGNAL_ZH_PATTERNS.find(item=>item.role==='command')
      :SIGNAL_ZH_PATTERNS.find(item=>item.test.test(seed))||SIGNAL_ZH_PATTERNS[SIGNAL_ZH_PATTERNS.length-1];
    const explicitName=edge?.displayNameZh||edge?.signalNameZh||edge?.labelZh||'';
    const explicitPath=edge?.signalPathZh||'';
    const role=edge?.role||edge?.signalRole||metrics?.signalRole||match.role;
    const meta={
      signalNameZh:explicitName||match.name,
      signalPathZh:explicitPath||match.path,
      role,
      engineeringKey:edge?.signalId||metrics?.signalId||edge?.id||'',
      pythonVariable:edge?.pythonVariable||edge?.sourcePortMeta?.varName||edge?.sourcePort?.varName||''
    };
    const mapping=buildSemanticMapping(edge,metrics,meta);
    meta.engineeringKey=mapping.engineeringKey;
    meta.pythonVariable=mapping.pythonVariable;
    meta.mapping=mapping;
    return meta;
  }

  function getDataflowPropagationScopeZh(kind){
    return DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_SCOPES_ZH[kind]||DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_SCOPES_ZH.none;
  }

  function getDataflowPropagationGroupLabelZh(kind){
    return DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_GROUP_LABELS[kind]
      || DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES[kind]?.labelZh
      || DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES.none.labelZh;
  }

  function canDataflowFaultPropagate(kind){
    return kind==='propagated';
  }

  function buildDataflowPropagationGroups(edges=[],measurementPoints=[]){
    return DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_ORDER.reduce((acc,kind)=>{
      const points=measurementPoints.filter(point=>(point.faultInfluence||'none')===kind);
      const groupEdges=edges.filter(edge=>(edge.propagationKind||'none')===kind);
      acc[kind]={
        kind,
        labelZh:getDataflowPropagationGroupLabelZh(kind),
        descriptionZh:getDataflowPropagationScopeZh(kind),
        points,
        edges:groupEdges,
        count:points.length,
        edgeCount:groupEdges.length
      };
      return acc;
    },{});
  }

  function getFaultPropagationPolicyValue(policyOrEdge){
    if(typeof policyOrEdge==='string'){return policyOrEdge;}
    const primary=Array.isArray(policyOrEdge?.signalChannels)&&policyOrEdge.signalChannels.length>0
      ?policyOrEdge.signalChannels[0]
      :{};
    return policyOrEdge?.faultPropagationPolicy
      || policyOrEdge?.metrics?.faultPropagationPolicy
      || primary.faultPropagationPolicy
      || policyOrEdge?.__faultBinding?.faultPropagationPolicy
      || 'inherit';
  }

  function classifyPropagationPolicy(policyOrEdge={}){
    const policy=String(getFaultPropagationPolicyValue(policyOrEdge)||'inherit').trim().toLowerCase();
    if(policy==='propagates'||policy==='propagated'||policy==='propagate'){return 'propagated';}
    if(policy==='blocks'||policy==='blocked'||policy==='block'){return 'blocked';}
    if(policy==='localonly'||policy==='local_only'||policy==='localeffect'||policy==='local'){return 'localEffect';}
    if(policy==='diagnosticonly'||policy==='diagnostic_only'||policy==='diagnostic'){return 'diagnosticOnly';}
    return 'none';
  }

  function hasFaultModelIdentity(faultModel){
    if(!faultModel||typeof faultModel!=='object'){return false;}
    return Boolean(
      faultModel.name||
      faultModel.id||
      faultModel.layer||
      faultModel.runtimeBehavior||
      faultModel.faultCode||
      faultModel.modelClass||
      faultModel.parameter
    );
  }

  function classifyFaultPropagation(faultModel={},target={},edge=null){
    if(!hasFaultModelIdentity(faultModel)){return 'none';}
    const layer=String(faultModel?.layer||'').toLowerCase();
    const behavior=[
      faultModel?.runtimeBehavior,
      faultModel?.faultCode,
      faultModel?.modelClass,
      faultModel?.id,
      faultModel?.name,
      faultModel?.parameter,
      Array.isArray(faultModel?.tags)?faultModel.tags.join(' '):''
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase();
    if(layer.includes('diagnostic')||/residual|diagnostic|fault_indicator/.test(behavior)){return 'diagnosticOnly';}
    if(layer.includes('sensor')||/sensor|measurement|meas|imu|gyro|accel|magnetometer|barometer|noise|freeze|scale/.test(behavior)){return 'propagated';}
    if(layer.includes('protocol')||layer.includes('communication')){
      return /loss|interrupt|block|disconnect|drop/.test(behavior)?'blocked':'propagated';
    }
    if(layer.includes('physical')||layer.includes('control')){return 'localEffect';}
    if(layer.includes('electrical')||layer.includes('actuator')||/actuator|motor|lock|stuck|efficiency|short|open/.test(behavior)){return 'propagated';}
    if(/parameter|mass|inertia|gain|saturation|drift|step|bias/.test(behavior)){return 'localEffect';}
    return faultModel?.name||faultModel?.id?'propagated':'none';
  }

  function getSemanticFaultForEdge(edge){
    const edgeFault=getFaultModelForEdge(edge);
    if(edgeFault){return edgeFault;}
    const sourceNode=getNode(edge?.sourceNodeId);
    const sourceFault=getFaultModelForNode(sourceNode);
    if(sourceFault){return sourceFault;}
    return {};
  }

  function getDataflowStageForRole(role){
    return DATAFLOW_STAGE_DEFS.find(stage=>stage.roles.includes(role))||DATAFLOW_STAGE_DEFS[3];
  }

  function collectMeasurementPoints(rows=collectDataflowEdges()){
    return rows.map((item,index)=>{
      const edge=item?.edge||item;
      const metrics=item?.metrics||getDataflowEdgeMetrics(edge);
      const meta=inferSignalChineseMeta(edge,metrics);
      const mapping=meta.mapping||buildSemanticMapping(edge,metrics,meta);
      const classified=classifyFaultPropagation(getSemanticFaultForEdge(edge),edge,edge);
      const faultInfluence=meta.role==='residual'&&classified==='none'?'diagnosticOnly':classified;
      const policyKind=classifyPropagationPolicy(edge);
      const stage=getDataflowStageForRole(meta.role);
      return {
        id:`mp-${edge.id}`,
        edgeId:edge.id,
        signalId:mapping.signalId||metrics.signalId||edge.signalId||edge.id,
        nodeId:edge.targetNodeId||edge.sourceNodeId||'',
        sourceNodeId:edge.sourceNodeId||'',
        targetNodeId:edge.targetNodeId||'',
        portIndex:Number.isInteger(edge.targetPortIndex)?edge.targetPortIndex:Number(edge.targetPortIndex||0),
        stageId:stage.id,
        stageLabelZh:stage.labelZh,
        labelZh:`测点 M${index+1}：${meta.signalNameZh}`,
        signalNameZh:meta.signalNameZh,
        signalPathZh:meta.signalPathZh,
        bindTarget:meta.role==='residual'?'residual':'edge',
        role:meta.role,
        engineeringKey:mapping.engineeringKey,
        pythonVariable:mapping.pythonVariable,
        mapping,
        advanced:{mapping},
        unit:metrics.signalUnit||edge.signalUnit||'',
        sampleRate:metrics.sampleRate||edge.sampleRate||'',
        currentValue:metrics.currentValue,
        residualValue:metrics.residualValue,
        faultInfluence,
        propagationPolicyKind:policyKind,
        propagationPolicyLabelZh:DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES[policyKind]?.labelZh||DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES.none.labelZh,
        propagationPolicyDescriptionZh:DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES[policyKind]?.descriptionZh||DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES.none.descriptionZh,
        propagationLabelZh:DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES[faultInfluence]?.labelZh||DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES.none.labelZh,
        propagationDescriptionZh:DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES[faultInfluence]?.descriptionZh||DATAFLOW_PROPAGATION_CLASSES.none.descriptionZh,
        propagationScopeZh:getDataflowPropagationScopeZh(faultInfluence),
        canPropagateFault:canDataflowFaultPropagate(faultInfluence)
      };
    });
  }

  function collectAffectedMeasurementPointIds(edge,propagationKind,pointByEdge,outgoingBySource){
    if(propagationKind!=='propagated'&&propagationKind!=='blocked'){return [];}
    const affected=new Set();
    const ownPoint=pointByEdge.get(edge.id);
    if(ownPoint?.id){affected.add(ownPoint.id);}
    const queue=[edge.targetNodeId].filter(Boolean);
    const visitedNodes=new Set();
    const visitedEdges=new Set([edge.id]);
    while(queue.length){
      const nodeId=queue.shift();
      if(!nodeId||visitedNodes.has(nodeId)){continue;}
      visitedNodes.add(nodeId);
      (outgoingBySource.get(nodeId)||[]).forEach(nextEdge=>{
        if(!nextEdge?.id||visitedEdges.has(nextEdge.id)){return;}
        visitedEdges.add(nextEdge.id);
        const point=pointByEdge.get(nextEdge.id);
        if(point?.id){affected.add(point.id);}
        if(nextEdge.targetNodeId&&!visitedNodes.has(nextEdge.targetNodeId)){
          queue.push(nextEdge.targetNodeId);
        }
      });
    }
    return Array.from(affected);
  }

  function buildDataflowSemanticModel(){
    const rows=collectDataflowEdges();
    const measurementPoints=collectMeasurementPoints(rows);
    const pointByEdge=new Map(measurementPoints.map(point=>[point.edgeId,point]));
    const outgoingBySource=rows.reduce((acc,item)=>{
      const sourceId=item.edge?.sourceNodeId||'';
      if(!sourceId){return acc;}
