            <div class="ifm-impl-row"><span>Python 函数</span><strong>${escapeHtml(implementation.pythonFunction||model.pythonFunction||'待实现')}</strong></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="ifm-detail-section">
          <div class="ifm-section-title">观测信号</div>
          <div class="ifm-text-list">${renderChipList(model.observableSignals||[])}</div>
        </section>
        <section class="ifm-detail-section">
          <div class="ifm-section-title">展示方案</div>
          <div class="ifm-detail-desc" style="margin-top:0">${escapeHtml(model.displayPlan||'未记录展示方案')}</div>
        </section>
      </div>`;
  }

  function renderFaultCatalogItem(model,imported){
    const icon=model.layer==='electrical'?'电':model.layer==='physical'?'物':'协';
    const layerClass=`ifm-icon--${model.layer||'physical'}`;
    const chipClass=`ifm-chip--${model.layer||'physical'}`;
    return `
      <div class="ifm-icon ${layerClass}">${icon}</div>
      <div style="min-width:0;flex:1">
        <div class="ifm-name">${escapeHtml(model.name)}</div>
        <div class="ifm-meta">${escapeHtml(buildFaultCatalogMeta(model))}</div>
        <div class="ifm-item-tags">
          <span class="ifm-chip ${chipClass}">${escapeHtml(getLayerLabel(model.layer))}</span>
          <span class="ifm-chip">${escapeHtml(model.modelClass||model.tags?.[0]||'Fault')}</span>
          ${model.recommendedModule?`<span class="ifm-chip">${escapeHtml(model.recommendedModule)}</span>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${imported?`<button type="button" class="ifm-state ifm-state--remove" data-clear-selected-fault-catalog="${escapeHtml(model.id)}">撤销导入</button>`:''}`;
  }

  const __faultTypesInitializeFaultCatalog=initializeFaultCatalog;
  initializeFaultCatalog=function(){
    __faultTypesInitializeFaultCatalog();
    syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable();
  };

  renderFaultCatalogList=function(){
    syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable();
    updateFaultCatalogHeader();
    const container=document.getElementById('ifm-list-container');
    if(!container){return;}
    const visible=getVisibleFaultCatalogModels();
    const selectedVisible=visible.some(model=>model.id===S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(!selectedVisible&&visible.length){
      S.selectedFaultCatalogId=visible[0].id;
    }
    const hint=document.getElementById('ifm-sel-hint');
    const api=window.__GZ_FAULT_CATALOG_RENDER__;
    setText('ifm-visible-count',visible.length);
    if(api?.renderFaultCatalogList){
      api.renderFaultCatalogList(container,hint,{
        models:visible,
        importedModels:S.importedFaultModels,
        selectedId:S.selectedFaultCatalogId,
        renderItem:renderFaultCatalogItem,
        emptyMessage:'没有匹配的故障类型。请调整层级筛选或搜索关键词。',
        getLayerLabel,
        selectIgnoreSelector:'[data-clear-selected-fault-catalog]',
        onSelect:selectFaultCatalogModel
      });
      if(visible.length===0){
        renderFaultTypeDetail(null);
      }else{
        renderFaultTypeDetail(getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId));
      }
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML='';
    if(visible.length===0){
      container.innerHTML='<div class="ifm-empty">没有匹配的故障类型。请调整层级筛选或搜索关键词。</div>';
      renderFaultTypeDetail(null);
    }else{
      visible.forEach(model=>{
        const item=document.createElement('div');
        const imported=S.importedFaultModels.some(entry=>entry.id===model.id);
        item.className=`ifm-item${S.selectedFaultCatalogId===model.id?' on':''}${imported?' is-imported':''}`;
        item.dataset.faultId=model.id;
        item.innerHTML=renderFaultCatalogItem(model,imported);
        item.addEventListener('click',(event)=>{
          if(event.target.closest?.('[data-clear-selected-fault-catalog]')){return;}
          selectFaultCatalogModel(model.id);
        });
        container.appendChild(item);
      });
      renderFaultTypeDetail(getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId));
    }
    const selected=getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(hint){
      hint.textContent=selected
        ?`已选：${selected.name} · ${getLayerLabel(selected.layer)}`
        :'已选：未选择故障模型';
    }
  };

  selectFaultCatalogModel=function(id){
    S.selectedFaultCatalogId=id;
    renderFaultCatalogList();
  };

  window.setFaultCatalogLayerFilter=function(layer='all'){
    S.faultCatalogLayerFilter=layer;
    renderFaultCatalogList();
  };

  window.setFaultCatalogSearch=function(query=''){
    S.faultCatalogSearch=String(query||'');
    renderFaultCatalogList();
  };

  const __faultTypesConfirmImportFault=confirmImportFault;
  confirmImportFault=function(){
    syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable();
    const selected=getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(!selected){
      return __faultTypesConfirmImportFault();
    }
    ensureImportedFaultModel(selected);
    closeOv('ov-ifm');
    renderFaultCatalogList();
    toast(`故障模型“${selected.name}”已导入工作区`,'s');
    updateUI();
  };

  const __faultTypesApplyPackage=window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__;
  window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__=function(pkg,prepared){
    const result=__faultTypesApplyPackage?.(pkg,prepared);
    syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable();
    renderFaultCatalogList();
    updateUI();
    return result;
  };

  function getFaultParam(model,key,fallback){
    const raw=model?.defaultParameters?.[key];
    if(raw===null||raw===undefined||raw===''){return fallback;}
    if(typeof raw==='number'){return raw;}
    if(typeof raw==='boolean'){return raw;}
    const parsed=parseScalar(raw,Number.NaN);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed)?parsed:raw;
  }

  function isFaultTimeActive(model,time){
    const start=Number(getFaultParam(model,'start',0))||0;
    const duration=model?.defaultParameters?.duration;
    if(time<start){return false;}
    if(duration===null||duration===undefined||duration===''){return true;}
    const parsedDuration=Number(duration);
    return !Number.isFinite(parsedDuration)||time<=start+parsedDuration;
  }

  const __faultTypesApplyElectricalFault=applyElectricalFault;
  applyElectricalFault=function(node,inputValue,outputValue,time){
    if(!node.injectedFault){return outputValue;}
    const model=getImportedFaultModel(node.injectedFault.modelId||'');
    if(!model||model.origin!=='fault-types'||!isFaultTimeActive(model,time)){
      return __faultTypesApplyElectricalFault(node,inputValue,outputValue,time);
    }
    const state=SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]||(SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]={});
    const behavior=model.runtimeBehavior||'catalog_only';
    if(behavior==='additive_bias'||behavior==='parameter_bias'){
      return outputValue+Number(getFaultParam(model,'offset',getFaultParam(model,'delta_p',0.15))||0);
    }
    if(behavior==='scale'){
      return outputValue*Number(getFaultParam(model,'scale',1.2)||1.2);
    }
    if(behavior==='noise'){
      return outputValue+noiseAt(getNodeSeed(node.id),SIM.stepIndex,time)*Number(getFaultParam(model,'std',0.08)||0.08);
    }
    if(behavior==='colored_noise'){
      const alpha=Number(getFaultParam(model,'alpha',0.9)||0.9);
      const std=Number(getFaultParam(model,'std',0.03)||0.03);
      state.catalogColoredNoise=alpha*(state.catalogColoredNoise||0)+noiseAt(getNodeSeed(node.id),SIM.stepIndex,time)*std;
      return outputValue+state.catalogColoredNoise;
    }
    if(behavior==='freeze'){
      if(!Number.isFinite(state.catalogFreezeValue)){
        state.catalogFreezeValue=outputValue;
      }
      return state.catalogFreezeValue;
    }
    if(behavior==='jump_or_invert'){
      const inverted=getFaultParam(model,'invert',true);
      const jump=Number(getFaultParam(model,'jump',0.5)||0.5);
      return (inverted===false?outputValue:-outputValue)+jump;
    }
    if(behavior==='intermittent'){
      const period=Math.max(Number(getFaultParam(model,'period',4)||4),SIM.stepSize);
      const duty=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(getFaultParam(model,'duty',0.25)||0.25)));
      const phase=((time-(Number(getFaultParam(model,'start',0))||0))%period)/period;
      return phase<=duty?outputValue+noiseAt(getNodeSeed(node.id),SIM.stepIndex,time)*0.2:outputValue;
    }
    return __faultTypesApplyElectricalFault(node,inputValue,outputValue,time);
  };

  syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable();
  renderFaultCatalogList();
  Object.assign(window,{
    confirmImportFault,
    getFaultTypeCatalogModels,
    initializeFaultCatalog,
    renderFaultCatalogList,
    selectFaultCatalogModel
  });
})();

// --- 故障库参数化注入桥接 ---
(function installFaultInjectionRuntimeBridge(){
  function getFaultRuntimeApi(){
    return window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__||null;
  }

  function collectAllCanvasItems(kind){
    ensureWorkbenchCanvasState();
    const items=[];
    const seen=new Set();
    const key=kind==='edges'?'edges':'nodes';
    const append=(collection)=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(collection)){return;}
      collection.forEach(item=>{
        if(!item||!item.id||seen.has(item.id)){return;}
        seen.add(item.id);
        items.push(item);
      });
    };
    append(kind==='edges'?S.modelEdges:S.modelNodes);
    Object.values(S.canvases||{}).forEach(canvas=>append(canvas?.[key]));
    return items;
  }

  function findNodeEverywhere(nodeId){
    return collectAllCanvasItems('nodes').find(node=>node.id===nodeId)||null;
  }

  function findEdgeEverywhere(edgeId){
    return collectAllCanvasItems('edges').find(edge=>edge.id===edgeId)||null;
  }

  function getFaultModelForInjected(injectedFault){
    if(!injectedFault){return null;}
    return getImportedFaultModel(injectedFault.modelId||'')||injectedFault;
  }

  function formatBridgeValue(value){
    if(value===null||value===undefined||value===''){return '';}
    if(typeof value==='object'){return JSON.stringify(value);}
    return String(value);
  }

  function getFaultParameterDraftKey(scope,modelId,targetId=''){
    return `${scope||'fault'}::${modelId||'unknown'}::${targetId||''}`;
  }

  function ensureFaultParameterDrafts(){
    if(!S.faultParameterDrafts||typeof S.faultParameterDrafts!=='object'){
      S.faultParameterDrafts={};
    }
    return S.faultParameterDrafts;
  }

  function getExistingInjectedParameters(scope,modelId,targetId){
    if(scope==='protocol'){
      const edge=findEdgeEverywhere(targetId);
      return edge?.injectedFault?.modelId===modelId?(edge.injectedFault.parameters||{}):{};
    }
    if(scope==='electrical'||scope==='library'){
      const node=findNodeEverywhere(targetId);
      return node?.injectedFault?.modelId===modelId?(node.injectedFault.parameters||{}):{};
    }
    return {};
  }

  function getFaultParameterDraft(scope,model,targetId=''){
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    const key=getFaultParameterDraftKey(scope,model?.id,targetId);
    const drafts=ensureFaultParameterDrafts();
    if(!drafts[key]){
      drafts[key]={
        ...(api?.resolveFaultParameters?.(model)||model?.defaultParameters||{}),
        ...getExistingInjectedParameters(scope,model?.id,targetId)
      };
    }
    return drafts[key];
  }

  function updateFaultParameterDraft(scope,modelId,targetId,paramKey,value){
    const key=getFaultParameterDraftKey(scope,modelId,targetId);
    const drafts=ensureFaultParameterDrafts();
    drafts[key]={...(drafts[key]||{}),[paramKey]:value};
  }

  function renderFaultParameterEditor(model,scope,targetId=''){
    if(!model){return '';}
    const params=getFaultParameterDraft(scope,model,targetId);
    const entries=Object.entries(params);
    if(entries.length===0){
      return '';
    }
    return `
      <section class="ifm-detail-section fault-param-editor" data-fault-param-scope="${escapeHtml(scope)}" data-fault-param-model="${escapeHtml(model.id||'')}" data-fault-param-target="${escapeHtml(targetId||'')}">
        <div class="ifm-section-title">注入参数</div>
        <div class="ifm-param-grid">
          ${entries.map(([key,value])=>`
            <label class="props-field">
              <span>${escapeHtml(key)}</span>
              <input data-fault-param-key="${escapeHtml(key)}" value="${escapeHtml(formatBridgeValue(value))}">
            </label>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="props-help">这些参数会随 injectedFault 写入节点或 CAN 边，仿真时优先覆盖故障库默认值。</div>
      </section>`;
  }

  function bindFaultParameterEditor(host){
    host?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-fault-param-key]').forEach(input=>{
      const box=input.closest('[data-fault-param-scope]');
      if(!box){return;}
      input.addEventListener('input',()=>{
        updateFaultParameterDraft(
          box.dataset.faultParamScope||'fault',
          box.dataset.faultParamModel||'',
          box.dataset.faultParamTarget||'',
          input.dataset.faultParamKey||'',
          input.value
        );
      });
    });
  }

  function readFaultParameterValues(hostId){
    const host=document.getElementById(hostId);
    const values={};
    host?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-fault-param-key]').forEach(input=>{
      const key=input.dataset.faultParamKey||'';
      const raw=String(input.value??'').trim();
      if(raw===''){
        values[key]='';
        return;
      }
      if(/^(true|false)$/i.test(raw)){
        values[key]=raw.toLowerCase()==='true';
        return;
      }
      const numeric=Number(raw);
      values[key]=Number.isFinite(numeric)&&/^[+-]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?$/i.test(raw)
        ?numeric
        :input.value;
    });
    return values;
  }

  function appendParameterEditor(hostId,model,scope,targetId=''){
    const host=document.getElementById(hostId);
    if(!host||!model){return;}
    host.querySelector('[data-fault-param-scope]')?.remove();
    const html=renderFaultParameterEditor(model,scope,targetId);
    if(html){
      host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
      bindFaultParameterEditor(host);
    }
  }

  function getRuntimePayload(model,parameterOverrides={}){
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    if(api?.createInjectedFaultPayload){
      return api.createInjectedFaultPayload(model,parameterOverrides);
    }
    return {
      modelId:model?.id||'',
      name:model?.name||'故障模型',
      layer:model?.layer||'electrical',
      tags:cloneDefaults(model?.tags||[]),
      desc:model?.desc||'',
      faultKind:model?.faultKind||model?.modelClass||'',
      faultCode:model?.faultCode||'',
      parameters:{...(model?.defaultParameters||{}),...parameterOverrides}
    };
  }

  function appendRuntimeFaultBinding(target,model,payload,targetKind){
    if(!target||!payload){return;}
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    if(api?.createFaultBinding&&api?.appendFaultBinding){
      const binding=api.createFaultBinding(model||payload,payload,{
        targetId:target.id||'',
        targetKind:targetKind||(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId?'edge':'node')
      });
      api.appendFaultBinding(target,binding);
      return;
    }
    const propagationMode=payload.layer==='protocol'?'protocolEdge':'signalTransform';
    const binding={
      bindingId:`${payload.modelId||payload.name||'fault'}::${target.id||''}`,
      faultModelId:payload.modelId||'',
      name:payload.name||'故障模型',
      layer:payload.layer||model?.layer||'electrical',
      runtimeBehavior:payload.runtimeBehavior||'',
      parameters:cloneDefaults(payload.parameters||{}),
      targetKind:targetKind||(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId?'edge':'node'),
      targetId:target.id||'',
      visualRole:'fault-source',
      propagationMode,
      canPropagate:propagationMode!=='localOnly',
      active:true,
      injectedFault:payload
    };
    target.faultBindings=Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)?target.faultBindings:[];
    const index=target.faultBindings.findIndex(item=>item.bindingId===binding.bindingId||item.faultModelId===binding.faultModelId);
    if(index>=0){target.faultBindings[index]=binding;}
    else{target.faultBindings.push(binding);}
  }

  function injectFaultIntoNode(target,model,parameterOverrides={}){
    if(!target||!model){return false;}
    const payload=getRuntimePayload(model,parameterOverrides);
    target.injectedFault=payload;
    appendRuntimeFaultBinding(target,model,payload,'node');
    if(!S.faultedBlks.includes(target.id)){
      S.faultedBlks.push(target.id);
    }
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
    return true;
  }

  function injectFaultIntoEdge(target,model,parameterOverrides={}){
    if(!target||!model){return false;}
    const payload=getRuntimePayload({...model,layer:'protocol'},parameterOverrides);
    target.injectedFault=payload;
    appendRuntimeFaultBinding(target,{...model,layer:'protocol'},payload,'edge');
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
    return true;
  }

  function cloneBridgeValue(value){
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value==null?null:value));
  }

  function ensureFaultInjectionLinks(){
    if(!Array.isArray(S.faultInjectionLinks)){
      S.faultInjectionLinks=[];
    }
    return S.faultInjectionLinks;
  }

  function removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts(faultId,options={}){
    if(!faultId){return false;}
    const removedNodeIds=new Set();
    const beforeNodes=S.modelNodes.length;
    S.modelNodes=S.modelNodes.filter(node=>{
      const remove=Boolean(node?.autoFaultInjection&&node.faultModelId===faultId);
      if(remove){removedNodeIds.add(node.id);}
      return !remove;
    });
    const beforeLinks=ensureFaultInjectionLinks().length;
    S.faultInjectionLinks=S.faultInjectionLinks.filter(link=>link.faultModelId!==faultId&&!removedNodeIds.has(link.sourceNodeId)&&!removedNodeIds.has(link.targetNodeId));
    if(Array.isArray(S.faultedBlks)&&removedNodeIds.size){
      S.faultedBlks=S.faultedBlks.filter(id=>!removedNodeIds.has(id));
    }
    const changed=beforeNodes!==S.modelNodes.length||beforeLinks!==S.faultInjectionLinks.length;
    if(changed&&!options.skipRender){
      renderModelNodes();
      renderEdges();
      updateUI();
    }
    return changed;
  }

  function getTargetVisualPoint(target){
    if(!target){return {x:CANVAS_STAGE.width/2,y:CANVAS_STAGE.height/2};}
    if(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId){
      const source=getNode(target.sourceNodeId);
      const targetNode=getNode(target.targetNodeId);
      const sourcePort=getPortInfo(source,'output',target.sourcePortIndex||0);
      const targetPort=getPortInfo(targetNode,'input',target.targetPortIndex||0);
      if(sourcePort&&targetPort){
        return {
          x:Math.round((sourcePort.x+targetPort.x)/2),
          y:Math.round((sourcePort.y+targetPort.y)/2)
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      x:Math.round((target.x||0)+(target.w||160)/2),
      y:Math.round((target.y||0)+(target.h||80)/2)
    };
  }

  function getVisualInjectionBlocks(model){
    const explicit=Array.isArray(model?.visualInjection?.blocks)?model.visualInjection.blocks:[];
    if(explicit.length){return explicit;}
    const behavior=model?.runtimeBehavior||'';
    if(behavior==='lock'){
      return [{type:'middle_var_assign',name:`${model.name||'故障'} 赋值覆盖`,props:{assignMode:'constant',constantValue:model.defaultParameters?.lock_value??model.defaultValue??0}}];
    }
    if(behavior==='tamper'){
      return [
        {type:'gain_block',name:`${model.name||'故障'} 缩放`,props:{gain:'scale'}},
        {type:'sum_block',name:`${model.name||'故障'} 偏置`,props:{inputCount:2,signs:['+','+']}}
      ];
    }
    if(behavior==='noise'||behavior==='colored_noise'){
      return [{type:'fault_noise',name:`${model.name||'故障'} 噪声注入`,props:{faultType:model.modelClass||'噪声注入',layer:getLayerLabel(model.layer),trigger:'持续'}}];
    }
    return [{type:'fault_bias',name:`${model.name||'故障'} 偏置注入`,props:{faultType:model.modelClass||'偏置叠加',layer:getLayerLabel(model.layer),trigger:behavior==='intermittent'?'周期启停':behavior==='parameter_drift'?'渐变':'持续',mode:behavior}}];
  }

  function createAutoFaultNode(block,index,total,targetPoint,model,payload){
    const type=block?.type||'fault_bias';
    const meta=COMPONENT_LIBRARY[type];
    if(!meta){return null;}
    const props=typeof cloneDefaults==='function'?cloneDefaults(meta.defaults):cloneBridgeValue(meta.defaults||{});
    Object.assign(props,cloneBridgeValue(block.props||{}));
    props.name=block.name||props.name||`${meta.label} ${getNodeTypeCount(type)+1}`;
    const size=type==='simulation_block'?getSimulationNodeSize(props):{width:meta.width,height:meta.height};
    const verticalOffset=(index-(total-1)/2)*92;
    const point={
      x:clamp(Math.round(targetPoint.x-size.width-140),CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding,CANVAS_STAGE.width-size.width-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding),
      y:clamp(Math.round(targetPoint.y-size.height/2+verticalOffset),CANVAS_STAGE.nodeMinY,CANVAS_STAGE.height-size.height-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding)
    };
    const node={
      id:`node-${++S.nodeSeq}`,
      type,
      x:point.x,
      y:point.y,
      w:size.width,
      h:size.height,
      props,
      pythonBinding:type==='simulation_block'?createDefaultPythonBinding():null,
      autoFaultInjection:true,
      faultModelId:model.id,
      faultModelName:model.name,
      injectedFault:cloneBridgeValue(payload)
    };
    S.modelNodes.push(node);
    if(!S.faultedBlks.includes(node.id)){
      S.faultedBlks.push(node.id);
    }
    return node;
  }

  function addVisualFaultInjectionLinks(model,target,visualNodes){
    const links=ensureFaultInjectionLinks();
    const internalRelations=Array.isArray(model?.visualInjection?.relations)?model.visualInjection.relations:[];
    internalRelations.forEach((relation,index)=>{
      const source=visualNodes[relation.from];
      const destination=visualNodes[relation.to];
      if(source&&destination){
        links.push({
          id:`fault-link-${model.id}-${links.length+1}-${index}`,
          faultModelId:model.id,
          sourceNodeId:source.id,
          targetNodeId:destination.id,
          role:'fault-injection-chain',
          label:model.name||'故障注入'
        });
      }
    });
    const terminal=visualNodes[visualNodes.length-1];
    if(terminal){
      links.push({
        id:`fault-link-${model.id}-${links.length+1}-target`,
        faultModelId:model.id,
        sourceNodeId:terminal.id,
        targetNodeId:target?.sourceNodeId?null:target?.id,
        targetEdgeId:target?.sourceNodeId?target.id:null,
        role:'fault-injection-target',
        label:model.name||'故障注入'
      });
    }
    if(!internalRelations.length&&visualNodes.length>1){
      visualNodes.slice(0,-1).forEach((node,index)=>{
        links.push({
          id:`fault-link-${model.id}-${links.length+1}-parallel-${index}`,
          faultModelId:model.id,
          sourceNodeId:node.id,
          targetNodeId:target?.sourceNodeId?null:target?.id,
          targetEdgeId:target?.sourceNodeId?target.id:null,
          role:'fault-injection-target',
          label:model.name||'故障注入'
        });
      });
    }
  }

  function createVisualFaultInjection(model,target,payload){
    if(!model||!target){return [];}
    removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts(model.id,{skipRender:true});
    const targetPoint=getTargetVisualPoint(target);
    const blocks=getVisualInjectionBlocks(model);
    const visualNodes=blocks
      .map((block,index)=>createAutoFaultNode(block,index,blocks.length,targetPoint,model,payload))
      .filter(Boolean);
    addVisualFaultInjectionLinks(model,target,visualNodes);
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
    return visualNodes;
  }

  function getVisualLinkPointForNode(node){
    return node?{x:Math.round((node.x||0)+(node.w||160)/2),y:Math.round((node.y||0)+(node.h||80)/2)}:null;
  }

  function getVisualLinkTargetPoint(link){
    if(link.targetNodeId){
      return getVisualLinkPointForNode(getNode(link.targetNodeId));
    }
    if(link.targetEdgeId){
      return getTargetVisualPoint(getEdge(link.targetEdgeId));
    }
    return null;
  }

  function renderVisualFaultInjectionLinks(){
    const edgeGroup=document.getElementById('edge-group');
    if(!edgeGroup){return;}
    const existing=document.getElementById('fault-injection-link-group');
    if(existing){existing.remove();}
    const links=ensureFaultInjectionLinks();
    if(!links.length){return;}
    const group=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
    group.id='fault-injection-link-group';
    links.forEach(link=>{
      const source=getVisualLinkPointForNode(getNode(link.sourceNodeId));
      const target=getVisualLinkTargetPoint(link);
      if(!source||!target){return;}
      const path=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
      const dx=Math.max(48,Math.abs(target.x-source.x)*0.38);
      path.setAttribute('d',`M ${source.x} ${source.y} C ${source.x+dx} ${source.y}, ${target.x-dx} ${target.y}, ${target.x} ${target.y}`);
      path.setAttribute('fill','none');
      path.setAttribute('stroke','#dc2626');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width','2.4');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','7 5');
      path.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#edge-arrow-fault)');
      path.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');
      path.dataset.faultModelId=link.faultModelId||'';
      path.dataset.faultInjectionLink=link.id||'';
      group.appendChild(path);
      const label=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      label.setAttribute('x',String(Math.round((source.x+target.x)/2)));
      label.setAttribute('y',String(Math.round((source.y+target.y)/2)-8));
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('fill','#b91c1c');
      label.setAttribute('font-size','12');
      label.setAttribute('font-weight','800');
      label.textContent='故障注入';
      group.appendChild(label);
    });
    edgeGroup.appendChild(group);
  }

  function ensureFaultTags(){
    if(!Array.isArray(S.faultTags)){
      S.faultTags=[];
    }
    return S.faultTags;
  }

  function safeFaultTagId(value){
    return String(value||'fault').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g,'-');
  }

  function getFaultTagBoxSize(tag={}){
    return {w:204,h:76};
  }

  function applyFaultTagBoxSize(tag){
    if(!tag){return null;}
    if(typeof tag.expanded!=='boolean'){
      tag.expanded=tag.collapsed===false;
    }
    const size=getFaultTagBoxSize(tag);
    tag.w=size.w;
    tag.h=size.h;
    return size;
  }

  function setFaultTagExpanded(tag,expanded){
    if(!tag){return;}
    tag.expanded=Boolean(expanded);
    tag.collapsed=!tag.expanded;
    applyFaultTagBoxSize(tag);
  }

  function getFaultTagHostNodeIdFromTarget(target){
    if(!target){return '';}
    if(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId){
      return target.sourceNodeId||target.targetNodeId||'';
    }
    return target.id||'';
  }

  function getFaultTagHostNodeId(tag){
    if(!tag){return '';}
    if(tag.hostNodeId){return tag.hostNodeId;}
    if(tag.targetKind==='edge'){
      return getFaultTagHostNodeIdFromTarget(getEdge(tag.targetId));
    }
    return tag.targetId||'';
  }

  function getFaultTagsForNode(nodeId){
    if(!nodeId){return [];}
    return ensureFaultTags().filter(tag=>tag.targetKind!=='edge'&&getFaultTagHostNodeId(tag)===nodeId);
  }

  function getFaultTagsForEdge(edgeId){
    if(!edgeId){return [];}
    return ensureFaultTags().filter(tag=>tag.targetKind==='edge'&&tag.targetId===edgeId);
  }

  function toggleFaultTagsForNode(nodeId){
    const tags=getFaultTagsForNode(nodeId);
    if(!tags.length){return 0;}
    const nextExpanded=!tags.some(tag=>tag.expanded);
    tags.forEach(tag=>setFaultTagExpanded(tag,nextExpanded));
    renderModelNodes();
    renderEdges();
    return tags.length;
  }

  function toggleFaultTagsForEdge(edgeId,options={}){
    const tags=getFaultTagsForEdge(edgeId);
    if(!tags.length){return 0;}
    const nextExpanded=!tags.some(tag=>tag.expanded);
    tags.forEach(tag=>setFaultTagExpanded(tag,nextExpanded));
    renderModelNodes();
    renderEdges();
    if(nextExpanded&&options.openPanel){
      selectFaultTag(tags[0].id);
    }
    return tags.length;
  }

  removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts=function(faultId,options={}){
    if(!faultId){return false;}
    const removedNodeIds=new Set();
    const beforeNodes=S.modelNodes.length;
    S.modelNodes=S.modelNodes.filter(node=>{
      const remove=Boolean(node?.autoFaultInjection&&node.faultModelId===faultId);
      if(remove){removedNodeIds.add(node.id);}
      return !remove;
    });
    const tags=ensureFaultTags();
    const removedTagIds=new Set(tags.filter(tag=>tag.faultModelId===faultId).map(tag=>tag.id));
    const beforeTags=tags.length;
    S.faultTags=tags.filter(tag=>tag.faultModelId!==faultId);
    const beforeLinks=ensureFaultInjectionLinks().length;
    S.faultInjectionLinks=S.faultInjectionLinks.filter(link=>
      link.faultModelId!==faultId
      &&!removedNodeIds.has(link.sourceNodeId)
      &&!removedNodeIds.has(link.targetNodeId)
      &&!removedTagIds.has(link.sourceTagId)
    );
    if(Array.isArray(S.faultedBlks)&&removedNodeIds.size){
      S.faultedBlks=S.faultedBlks.filter(id=>!removedNodeIds.has(id));
    }
    if(removedTagIds.has(S.selFaultTag)){
      S.selFaultTag=null;
    }
    const changed=beforeNodes!==S.modelNodes.length||beforeTags!==S.faultTags.length||beforeLinks!==S.faultInjectionLinks.length;
    if(changed&&!options.skipRender){
      renderModelNodes();
      renderEdges();
      updateUI();
    }
    return changed;
  };

  function getFaultTagTargetName(model,target){
    if(model?.visualInjection?.targetName){return model.visualInjection.targetName;}
    if(target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId){
      const source=getNode(target.sourceNodeId);
      const destination=getNode(target.targetNodeId);
      return `${source?.props?.name||target.sourceNodeId} -> ${destination?.props?.name||target.targetNodeId}`;
    }
    return target?.props?.name||target?.id||'目标对象';
  }

  function getFaultTagPosition(model,target,offsetIndex=null){
    const targetPoint=getTargetVisualPoint(target);
    const {w:width,h:height}=getFaultTagBoxSize(model);
    const targetId=target?.id||model?.visualInjection?.targetId||'';
    const sameTargetCount=offsetIndex ?? ensureFaultTags().filter(tag=>tag.targetId===targetId).length;
    const baseX=target?.sourceNodeId
      ?targetPoint.x-width/2
      :targetPoint.x+Math.round((target?.w||160)/2)+30;
    const baseY=target?.sourceNodeId
      ?targetPoint.y-height-72+(sameTargetCount%3)*88
      :targetPoint.y-height/2+(sameTargetCount%3)*88;
    return {
      x:clamp(Math.round(baseX),CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding,CANVAS_STAGE.width-width-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding),
      y:clamp(Math.round(baseY),CANVAS_STAGE.nodeMinY,CANVAS_STAGE.height-height-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding),
      w:width,
      h:height
    };
  }

  function getFaultTagById(tagId){
    return ensureFaultTags().find(tag=>tag.id===tagId)||null;
  }

  function getFaultTagTarget(tag){
    if(!tag){return null;}
    return tag.targetKind==='edge'?getEdge(tag.targetId):getNode(tag.targetId);
  }

  function syncFaultTagPositions(){
    const offsets=new Map();
    ensureFaultTags().forEach(tag=>{
      tag.positionMode=tag.positionMode||'manual';
      applyFaultTagBoxSize(tag);
      if(tag.positionMode==='manual'){
        return;
      }
      const target=getFaultTagTarget(tag);
      if(!target){return;}
      const key=tag.targetId||target.id;
      const offset=offsets.get(key)||0;
      offsets.set(key,offset+1);
      const box=getFaultTagPosition(tag,target,offset);
      tag.x=box.x;
      tag.y=box.y;
      tag.w=box.w;
      tag.h=box.h;
    });
  }

  createVisualFaultInjection=function(model,target,payload){
    if(!model||!target){return null;}
    removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts(model.id,{skipRender:true});
    const targetKind=target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId?'edge':'node';
    const targetId=target?.id||model?.visualInjection?.targetId||'';
    const hostNodeId=getFaultTagHostNodeIdFromTarget(target);
    const hostAlreadyExpanded=hostNodeId?getFaultTagsForNode(hostNodeId).some(tag=>tag.expanded):false;
    const expandedByDefault=targetKind==='edge'?false:hostAlreadyExpanded;
    const box=getFaultTagPosition(model,target);
    const tag={
      id:`fault-tag-${safeFaultTagId(model.id)}`,
      type:'fault_tag',
      faultModelId:model.id,
      faultModelName:model.name||'故障',
      name:model.name||'故障',
      layer:getLayerLabel(model.layer),
      modelClass:model.modelClass||model.faultKind||'故障',
      runtimeBehavior:model.runtimeBehavior||payload?.runtimeBehavior||'',
      targetKind,
      targetId,
      hostNodeId,
      targetName:getFaultTagTargetName(model,target),
      active:true,
      positionMode:'manual',
      expanded:expandedByDefault,
      collapsed:!expandedByDefault,
      parameters:cloneBridgeValue(payload?.parameters||model.defaultParameters||{}),
      injectedFault:cloneBridgeValue(payload),
      x:box.x,
      y:box.y,
      w:box.w,
      h:box.h
    };
    ensureFaultTags().push(tag);
    if(targetKind!=='edge'&&hostNodeId&&!S.faultedBlks.includes(hostNodeId)){
      S.faultedBlks.push(hostNodeId);
    }
    ensureFaultInjectionLinks().push({
      id:`fault-link-${safeFaultTagId(model.id)}-target`,
      faultModelId:model.id,
      sourceTagId:tag.id,
      targetNodeId:target?.sourceNodeId?null:target?.id,
      targetEdgeId:target?.sourceNodeId?target.id:null,
      role:'fault-tag-attachment',
      label:'故障注入'
    });
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
    return tag;
  };

  function createManualFaultTag({x,y,target}={}){
    const id=`manual-fault-tag-${Date.now()}-${Math.round(Math.random()*10000)}`;
    const targetKind=target?(target.sourceNodeId?'edge':'node'):'unbound';
    const box=target
      ?getFaultTagPosition({id,visualInjection:{}},target)
      :{
        x:clamp(Math.round((x||CANVAS_STAGE.width/2)-102),CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding,CANVAS_STAGE.width-204-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding),
        y:clamp(Math.round((y||CANVAS_STAGE.height/2)-38),CANVAS_STAGE.nodeMinY,CANVAS_STAGE.height-76-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding),
        w:204,
        h:76
      };
    const tag={
      id,
      type:'fault_tag',
      faultModelId:id,
      faultModelName:'故障注入',
      name:'故障注入',
      layer:'飞控故障库',
      modelClass:'故障标签',
      runtimeBehavior:'manual',
      targetKind,
      targetId:target?.id||'',
      hostNodeId:getFaultTagHostNodeIdFromTarget(target),
      targetName:target?getFaultTagTargetName({visualInjection:{}},target):'未绑定目标',
      active:false,
      positionMode:'manual',
      expanded:targetKind==='node',
      collapsed:targetKind!=='node',
      parameters:{},
      injectedFault:null,
      x:box.x,
      y:box.y,
      w:box.w,
      h:box.h
    };
    ensureFaultTags().push(tag);
    if(target){
      ensureFaultInjectionLinks().push({
        id:`fault-link-${safeFaultTagId(id)}-target`,
        faultModelId:id,
        sourceTagId:tag.id,
        targetNodeId:target.sourceNodeId?null:target.id,
        targetEdgeId:target.sourceNodeId?target.id:null,
        role:'fault-tag-attachment',
        label:'故障注入'
      });
    }
    renderModelNodes();
    renderEdges();
    selectFaultTag(tag.id);
    return tag;
  }

  function getVisualLinkPointForTag(tag){
    return tag?.expanded?{x:Math.round((tag.x||0)+(tag.w||204)/2),y:Math.round((tag.y||0)+(tag.h||76))}:null;
  }

  function faultTagRefMatches(value,faultId){
    if(!value||!faultId){return false;}
    return value.id===faultId
      || value.modelId===faultId
      || value.faultModelId===faultId
      || value.faultTypeId===faultId
      || value.injectedFault?.modelId===faultId
      || value.injectedFault?.faultModelId===faultId;
  }

  function normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(name){
    return String(name||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase();
  }

  function getFaultRecordName(value){
    return value?.name||value?.displayName||value?.faultModelName||value?.injectedFault?.name||value?.injectedFault?.displayName||'';
  }

  function faultRecordMatchesIdentity(value,identity={}){
    if(!value||!identity){return false;}
    return [
      value.id,
      value.instanceId,
      value.faultModelId,
      value.faultTypeId,
      value.modelId,
      value.faultId,
      value.injectedFault?.modelId,
      value.injectedFault?.faultModelId,
      value.injectedFault?.faultTypeId
    ].filter(Boolean).some(id=>[
      identity.id,
      identity.instanceId,
      identity.faultModelId,
      identity.faultTypeId,
      identity.modelId,
      identity.faultId
    ].filter(Boolean).includes(id));
  }

  function isFaultNameDuplicate(name,identity={}){
    const normalized=normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(name);
    if(!normalized){return false;}
    const asArray=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
    const records=[
      ...asArray(S.faultTags),
      ...asArray(S.faultInstances),
      ...asArray(S.injectedFaults),
      ...asArray(S.activeFaults),
      ...asArray(S.selectedFaults),
      ...asArray(S.appliedFaults)
    ];
    return records.some(record=>{
      if(record?.active===false||record?.enabled===false){return false;}
      if(faultRecordMatchesIdentity(record,identity)){return false;}
      return normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(getFaultRecordName(record))===normalized;
    });
  }

  function syncFaultTagParametersToRuntimeTarget(tag,nextParameters){
    if(!tag){return;}
    const parameters=cloneBridgeValue(nextParameters||{});
    tag.parameters=cloneBridgeValue(parameters);
    if(tag.injectedFault){
      tag.injectedFault={...tag.injectedFault,parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)};
    }
    const runtimeTarget=getFaultTagTarget(tag);
    if(runtimeTarget?.injectedFault&&faultTagRefMatches(runtimeTarget.injectedFault,tag.faultModelId)){
      runtimeTarget.injectedFault.parameters=cloneBridgeValue(parameters);
    }
    if(Array.isArray(runtimeTarget?.faultBindings)){
      runtimeTarget.faultBindings=runtimeTarget.faultBindings.map(binding=>{
        if(!faultTagRefMatches(binding,tag.faultModelId)){return binding;}
        const nextBinding={...binding,parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)};
        if(binding.injectedFault){
          nextBinding.injectedFault={...binding.injectedFault,parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)};
        }
        return nextBinding;
      });
    }
    ['injectedFaults','activeFaults','faultInstances','selectedFaults','appliedFaults'].forEach(key=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(S[key])){return;}
      S[key]=S[key].map(item=>{
        if(!faultTagRefMatches(item,tag.faultModelId)){return item;}
        const nextItem={...item,parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)};
        if(item.injectedFault){
          nextItem.injectedFault={...item.injectedFault,parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)};
        }
        return nextItem;
      });
    });
    if(S.injectedFaultMap&&typeof S.injectedFaultMap==='object'&&S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId]){
      S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId]={
        ...S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId],
        parameters:cloneBridgeValue(parameters)
      };
    }
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
  }

  function syncFaultTagNameToRuntimeTarget(tag,nextName){
    if(!tag){return;}
    const fallback=tag.name||tag.faultModelName||tag.faultModelId||tag.id||'Fault';
    const name=String(nextName||'').trim()||fallback;
    tag.name=name;
    tag.faultModelName=name;
    if(tag.injectedFault){
      tag.injectedFault={...tag.injectedFault,name,displayName:name,faultModelName:name};
    }
    const runtimeTarget=getFaultTagTarget(tag);
    if(runtimeTarget?.injectedFault&&faultTagRefMatches(runtimeTarget.injectedFault,tag.faultModelId)){
      runtimeTarget.injectedFault={
        ...runtimeTarget.injectedFault,
        name,
        displayName:name,
        faultModelName:name
      };
      if(runtimeTarget.status==='faulted'){
        runtimeTarget.faultSource=name;
      }
    }
    if(Array.isArray(runtimeTarget?.faultBindings)){
      runtimeTarget.faultBindings=runtimeTarget.faultBindings.map(binding=>{
        if(!faultTagRefMatches(binding,tag.faultModelId)){return binding;}
        const nextBinding={...binding,name,displayName:name,faultModelName:name};
        if(binding.injectedFault){
          nextBinding.injectedFault={
            ...binding.injectedFault,
            name,
            displayName:name,
            faultModelName:name
          };
        }
        return nextBinding;
      });
    }
    ['injectedFaults','activeFaults','faultInstances','selectedFaults','appliedFaults'].forEach(key=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(S[key])){return;}
      S[key]=S[key].map(item=>{
        if(!faultTagRefMatches(item,tag.faultModelId)){return item;}
        const nextItem={...item,name,displayName:name,faultModelName:name};
        if(item.injectedFault){
          nextItem.injectedFault={
            ...item.injectedFault,
            name,
            displayName:name,
            faultModelName:name
          };
        }
        return nextItem;
      });
    });
    if(S.injectedFaultMap&&typeof S.injectedFaultMap==='object'&&S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId]){
      S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId]={
        ...S.injectedFaultMap[tag.faultModelId],
        name,
        displayName:name,
        faultModelName:name
      };
    }
    if(S.activeModelPackage&&Array.isArray(S.faultInstances)){
      S.activeModelPackage.faultInstances=cloneBridgeValue(S.faultInstances);
    }
    markTopologyDirty('fault');
  }

  function displayText(value){
    return String(value??'').trim();
  }

  function displayList(value){
    return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
  }

  function faultTagTargetParameterKeys(tag){
    return [
      tag?.slotId,
      tag?.parameterKey,
      tag?.variableKey,
      tag?.bindingObject,
      tag?.targetVariable,
      tag?.targetField,
      tag?.injectedFault?.slotId,
      tag?.injectedFault?.parameterKey,
      tag?.injectedFault?.variableKey,
      tag?.injectedFault?.bindingObject,
      tag?.injectedFault?.targetVariable,
      tag?.injectedFault?.targetField
    ].map(displayText).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function directFaultTagTargetDisplayName(tag){
    return displayText(tag?.slotName)
      ||displayText(tag?.displayName)
      ||displayText(tag?.injectedFault?.slotName)
      ||displayText(tag?.injectedFault?.displayName);
  }

  function keyMatchesFaultTagParameter(key,candidates){
    const normalized=displayText(key);
    if(!normalized) return false;
    return candidates.some(candidate=>candidate===normalized||candidate.endsWith(`:${normalized}`)||normalized.endsWith(`:${candidate}`));
  }

  function findFaultTagSlotDisplayName(tag,target){
    const candidates=faultTagTargetParameterKeys(tag);
    const slots=[
      ...displayList(target?.faultSlots),
      ...displayList(target?.props?.faultSlots)
    ];
    const slot=slots.find(item=>{
      const keys=[
        item?.slotId,
        item?.id,
        item?.parameterKey,
        item?.variableKey,
        item?.bindingObject,
        item?.targetVariable,
        item?.targetField
      ];
      return keys.some(key=>keyMatchesFaultTagParameter(key,candidates));
    });
    return displayText(slot?.slotName)||displayText(slot?.displayName)||displayText(slot?.name)||displayText(slot?.label);
  }

  function findFaultTagParameterDisplayName(tag,target){
    const candidates=faultTagTargetParameterKeys(tag);
    const params=[
      ...displayList(target?.props?.modelParameters),
      ...displayList(target?.props?.physicalParameters),
      ...displayList(target?.parameters),
      ...displayList(target?.physicalParameters)
    ];
    const param=params.find(item=>{
      const keys=[item?.key,item?.id,item?.varName,item?.name,item?.targetField];
      return keys.some(key=>keyMatchesFaultTagParameter(key,candidates));
    });
    return displayText(param?.displayName)||displayText(param?.name)||displayText(param?.label);
  }

  function resolveFaultTagTargetParameter(tag,target){
    return directFaultTagTargetDisplayName(tag)
      ||findFaultTagSlotDisplayName(tag,target)
      ||findFaultTagParameterDisplayName(tag,target)
      ||displayText(tag?.bindingObject)
      ||displayText(tag?.targetVariable)
      ||displayText(tag?.targetField)
      ||displayText(tag?.injectedFault?.bindingObject)
      ||displayText(tag?.injectedFault?.targetVariable)
      ||displayText(tag?.injectedFault?.targetField)
      ||displayText(tag?.slotName)
      ||displayText(tag?.slotId)
      ||'\u672a\u5173\u8054';
  }

    const pe=document.getElementById('pe');
    const pd=document.getElementById('pd');

    const params=Object.entries(tag.parameters||{});
    const target=getFaultTagTarget(tag);
    const targetName=tag.targetName||target?.props?.name||tag.targetId||'\u76ee\u6807\u5bf9\u8c61';

    const layerLabelMap={
      physical:'\u7269\u7406\u5c42',

      bias:'\u504f\u5dee\u6545\u969c',

      delay:'\u5ef6\u8fdf\u6545\u969c',
      dropout:'\u4e22\u5305\u6545\u969c',
      stale:'\u65e7\u503c\u91cd\u653e',
      overwrite:'\u8986\u76d6\u5199\u5165'
    };
    const paramLabelMap={
      scale:'\u7be1\u6539\u500d\u7387',
      bias:'\u504f\u7f6e\u503c',
      value:'\u6545\u969c\u503c',
      start:'\u5f00\u59cb\u65f6\u95f4',
      duration:'\u6301\u7eed\u65f6\u95f4',
      mode:'\u5199\u5165\u65b9\u5f0f',
      drop_rate:'\u4e22\u5305\u7387',
      delay:'\u5ef6\u8fdf\u65f6\u95f4',

      offset:'\u504f\u7f6e\u503c',

      duty:'\u5360\u7a7a\u6bd4'
    };
    const layerLabel=layerLabelMap[tag.layer]||tag.layer||'\u672a\u6307\u5b9a\u5c42\u7ea7';
    const runtimeValue=tag.runtimeBehavior||tag.mathModel||tag.modelClass||'';
    const runtimeLabel=runtimeLabelMap[String(runtimeValue)]||runtimeValue||'\u6309\u6545\u969c\u5e93\u5b9a\u4e49';
    const paramName=(key)=>paramLabelMap[key]||key;
    const paramEmpty='\u8be5\u6545\u969c\u6ca1\u6709\u989d\u5916\u53c2\u6570\u3002';
    const faultTagPanelSchema=window.__GZ_FAULT_TAG_PANEL_SCHEMA__;
    const paramPreview=params.length?params.map(([key,value])=>`
      <div class="fault-tag-param-preview__row">
        <span>${escapeHtml(paramName(key))}</span>
        <strong>${escapeHtml(value)}</strong>
      </div>
    `).join(''):`<div class="props-empty-inline">${paramEmpty}</div>`;
    const paramEditor=params.length?params.map(([key,value])=>`
      <label class="fault-tag-param-row">
        <span>${escapeHtml(paramName(key))}</span>
        <input value="${escapeHtml(value)}" data-fault-tag-param="${escapeHtml(key)}">

    `).join(''):`<div class="props-empty-inline">${paramEmpty}</div>`;
    if(S.propertyPanelTab==='parameters'){

          <div class="pglbl">\u6545\u969c\u53c2\u6570</div>
          ${paramEditor}
          ${params.length?`
            <div class="fault-tag-param-actions">
              <span data-fault-tag-param-status>\u53c2\u6570\u672a\u4fee\u6539</span>
              <div>
                <button type="button" class="props-secondary fault-tag-param-reset" data-fault-tag-reset disabled>\u53d6\u6d88\u4fee\u6539</button>
                <button type="button" class="props-save fault-tag-param-apply" data-fault-tag-apply disabled>\u5e94\u7528\u4fee\u6539</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          `:''}
        </div>
      `;
    }else{
      pd.innerHTML=faultTagPanelSchema?.renderFaultTagOverviewPanel?faultTagPanelSchema.renderFaultTagOverviewPanel({
        tag,

        <div class="pgroup fault-tag-inspector fault-tag-overview-panel" data-fault-tag-inspector="${escapeHtml(tag.id)}">

          <div class="props-fault-card">
            <div class="props-fault-card__top">

            </div>

          </div>
          <div class="fault-tag-param-preview">
            <div class="fault-tag-param-preview__head">
              <div class="pglbl">\u6545\u969c\u53c2\u6570</div>
              <button type="button" class="props-secondary fault-tag-param-edit" data-fault-tag-edit-params>\u4fee\u6539\u53c2\u6570</button>
            </div>
            ${paramPreview}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
    const editParamsButton=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-edit-params]');
    editParamsButton?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(typeof window.setPropertyPanelTab==='function'){
        window.setPropertyPanelTab('parameters');
        return;
      }
      S.propertyPanelTab='parameters';
      renderFaultTagPropertyPanel(tag);
    });
    const nameInput=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-name]');
    const nameApplyButton=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-name-apply]');
    const nameResetButton=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-name-reset]');
    const nameStatusText=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-name-status]');
    let committedName=tag.name||tag.faultModelName||tag.faultModelId||tag.id||'Fault';
    const isNameDirty=()=>nameInput&&String(committedName)!==String(nameInput.value||'').trim();
    const setNameDirtyState=()=>{
      const dirty=Boolean(isNameDirty());
      if(nameApplyButton){nameApplyButton.disabled=!dirty;}
      if(nameResetButton){nameResetButton.disabled=!dirty;}
      if(nameStatusText){nameStatusText.textContent=dirty?'\u6709\u672a\u5e94\u7528\u7684\u540d\u79f0\u4fee\u6539':'\u540d\u79f0\u672a\u4fee\u6539';}
    };
    nameInput?.addEventListener('input',setNameDirtyState);
    nameApplyButton?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(nameApplyButton.disabled||!nameInput){return;}
      const nextName=String(nameInput.value||'').trim();
      if(isFaultNameDuplicate(nextName,tag)){
        if(nameStatusText){nameStatusText.textContent='名称已存在，请使用唯一故障名称';}
        return;
      }
      syncFaultTagNameToRuntimeTarget(tag,nameInput.value);
      committedName=tag.name||committedName;
      nameInput.value=committedName;
      setNameDirtyState();
      renderModelNodes();
      renderEdges();
      updateUI();
      renderFaultTagPropertyPanel(tag);
      toast('\u6545\u969c\u540d\u79f0\u4fee\u6539\u5df2\u5e94\u7528','s');
    });
    nameResetButton?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(!nameInput){return;}
      nameInput.value=committedName;
      setNameDirtyState();
    });
    const inputs=Array.from(pd.querySelectorAll('[data-fault-tag-param]'));
    const applyButton=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-apply]');
    const resetButton=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-reset]');
    const statusText=pd.querySelector('[data-fault-tag-param-status]');
    let committed=cloneBridgeValue(tag.parameters||{});
    const readDraft=()=>{
      if(faultTagPanelSchema?.readFaultTagParameterDraftFromPanel){
        return faultTagPanelSchema.readFaultTagParameterDraftFromPanel(pd);
      }
      const draft={};
      inputs.forEach(input=>{
        const key=input.getAttribute('data-fault-tag-param');
        if(key){draft[key]=input.value;}
      });
      return draft;
    };
    const isDirty=()=>inputs.some(input=>{
      const key=input.getAttribute('data-fault-tag-param');
      return key&&String(committed?.[key]??'')!==input.value;
    });
    const setDirtyState=()=>{
      const dirty=isDirty();
      if(applyButton){applyButton.disabled=!dirty;}
      if(resetButton){resetButton.disabled=!dirty;}
      if(statusText){statusText.textContent=dirty?'\u6709\u672a\u5e94\u7528\u4fee\u6539':'\u53c2\u6570\u672a\u4fee\u6539';}
    };
    inputs.forEach(input=>{
      input.addEventListener('input',setDirtyState);
    });
    applyButton?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(applyButton.disabled){return;}
      const draft=readDraft();
      syncFaultTagParametersToRuntimeTarget(tag,draft);
      committed=cloneBridgeValue(draft);
      setDirtyState();
      renderModelNodes();
      renderEdges();
      updateUI();
      toast('\u6545\u969c\u53c2\u6570\u4fee\u6539\u5df2\u5e94\u7528','s');
    });
    resetButton?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      inputs.forEach(input=>{
        const key=input.getAttribute('data-fault-tag-param');
        if(key){input.value=String(committed?.[key]??'');}
      });
      setDirtyState();
    });
    setDirtyState();
    if(typeof window.__GZ_SYNC_PROPERTY_TABS__==='function'){
      window.__GZ_SYNC_PROPERTY_TABS__();
    }else if(typeof syncPropertyTabs==='function'){
      syncPropertyTabs();
    }
    if(typeof window.__GZ_DECORATE_PROPERTY_PANEL__==='function'){
      window.__GZ_DECORATE_PROPERTY_PANEL__(null,{kind:'fault-tag',faultTag:tag,tab:S.propertyPanelTab});
    }
  }

  function selectFaultTag(tagId){
    const tag=getFaultTagById(tagId);
    if(!tag){return;}
    S.selFaultTag=tag.id;
    S.selBlk=null;
    S.selEdge=null;
    S.propertyPanelTab='overview';
    renderModelNodes();
    renderEdges();
    renderFaultTagPropertyPanel(tag);
    updateUI();
  }

  function deleteSelectedFaultTag(){
    const tag=getFaultTagById(S.selFaultTag);
    if(!tag){return false;}
    const faultId=tag.faultModelId||tag.faultTypeId||tag.modelId||tag.id||'';
    const targetKind=tag.targetKind==='edge'?'edge':'node';
    const targetId=tag.targetId||'';
    let removed=false;
    if(targetId&&faultId&&typeof window.removeFaultBinding==='function'){
      removed=window.removeFaultBinding(targetKind,targetId,faultId);
    }
    if(!removed&&faultId){
      removed=removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts(faultId,{skipRender:true});
    }
    S.selFaultTag=null;
    if(removed){
      renderModelNodes();
      renderEdges();
      renderPropertyPanel(null);
      updateUI();
      toast('\u6545\u969c\u6807\u7b7e\u5df2\u5220\u9664','s');
    }
    return removed;
  }

  window.__GZ_RENDER_FAULT_TAG_PANEL__=renderFaultTagPropertyPanel;

  const FAULT_TAG_DRAG={
    active:false,
    engaged:false,
    pointerId:null,
    tagId:'',
    startX:0,
    startY:0,
    originX:0,
    originY:0,
    suppressClick:false
  };

  function updateFaultTagElementPosition(el,tag){
    if(!el||!tag){return;}
    applyFaultTagBoxSize(tag);
    el.style.left=`${tag.x||0}px`;
    el.style.top=`${tag.y||0}px`;
    el.style.width=`${tag.w||204}px`;
    el.style.height=`${tag.h||76}px`;
  }

  function beginFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el){
    event.stopPropagation();
    if(event.button!==0){return;}
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.active=true;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.engaged=false;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.suppressClick=false;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.pointerId=event.pointerId;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.tagId=tag.id;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startX=event.clientX;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startY=event.clientY;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.originX=tag.x||0;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.originY=tag.y||0;
    if(el.setPointerCapture){
      el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    }
  }

  function moveFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el){
    if(!FAULT_TAG_DRAG.active||FAULT_TAG_DRAG.pointerId!==event.pointerId||FAULT_TAG_DRAG.tagId!==tag.id){return;}
    const dx=event.clientX-FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startX;
    const dy=event.clientY-FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startY;
    if(!FAULT_TAG_DRAG.engaged&&!movedBeyondPointerThreshold(FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startX,FAULT_TAG_DRAG.startY,event.clientX,event.clientY)){return;}
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.engaged=true;
    tag.positionMode='manual';
    tag.x=clamp(Math.round(FAULT_TAG_DRAG.originX+dx/(S.canvasScale||1)),CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding,CANVAS_STAGE.width-(tag.w||204)-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding);
    tag.y=clamp(Math.round(FAULT_TAG_DRAG.originY+dy/(S.canvasScale||1)),CANVAS_STAGE.nodeMinY,CANVAS_STAGE.height-(tag.h||76)-CANVAS_STAGE.nodePadding);
    updateFaultTagElementPosition(el,tag);
    renderVisualFaultInjectionLinks();
  }

  function endFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el){
    if(!FAULT_TAG_DRAG.active||FAULT_TAG_DRAG.pointerId!==event.pointerId||FAULT_TAG_DRAG.tagId!==tag.id){return;}
    event.stopPropagation();
    if(el.releasePointerCapture){
      try{el.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);}catch(error){}
    }
    const wasDragged=FAULT_TAG_DRAG.engaged;
    const shouldSelect=!wasDragged;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.active=false;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.engaged=false;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.pointerId=null;
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.tagId='';
    FAULT_TAG_DRAG.suppressClick=wasDragged;
    if(shouldSelect){
      selectFaultTag(tag.id);
    }
  }

  function renderFaultTags(){
    const layer=document.getElementById('node-layer');
    if(!layer){return;}
    syncFaultTagPositions();
    layer.querySelectorAll('.fault-tag-card').forEach(el=>el.remove());
    ensureFaultTags().forEach(tag=>{
      applyFaultTagBoxSize(tag);
      if(!tag.expanded){return;}
      const el=document.createElement('div');
      el.className=`fault-tag-card${S.selFaultTag===tag.id?' is-selected':''}`;
      el.id=`visual-${tag.id}`;
      el.dataset.faultTagId=tag.id;
      el.dataset.faultModelId=tag.faultModelId||'';
      el.style.left=`${tag.x||0}px`;
      el.style.top=`${tag.y||0}px`;
      el.style.width=`${tag.w||204}px`;
      el.style.height=`${tag.h||76}px`;
      el.innerHTML=`
        <div class="fault-tag-card__badge">F</div>
        <div class="fault-tag-card__kicker">故障</div>
        <div class="fault-tag-card__title">${escapeHtml(tag.name||'故障')}</div>
        <div class="fault-tag-card__meta">${escapeHtml(tag.modelClass||'故障')} / ${escapeHtml(tag.layer||'飞控故障库')}</div>
      `;
      el.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>beginFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el));
      el.addEventListener('pointermove',event=>moveFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el));
      el.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>endFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el));
      el.addEventListener('pointercancel',event=>endFaultTagDrag(event,tag,el));
      el.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        if(FAULT_TAG_DRAG.suppressClick){
          FAULT_TAG_DRAG.suppressClick=false;
          event.stopPropagation();
          return;
        }
        event.stopPropagation();
        selectFaultTag(tag.id);
      });
      el.addEventListener('dblclick',event=>{
        event.stopPropagation();
        selectFaultTag(tag.id);
        renderFaultTagPropertyPanel(tag);
      });
      layer.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function setAllFaultTagsCollapsed(collapsed){
    const tags=ensureFaultTags();
    tags.forEach(tag=>setFaultTagExpanded(tag,!collapsed));
    renderModelNodes();
    renderEdges();
    if(S.selFaultTag){
      const selected=getFaultTagById(S.selFaultTag);
      if(selected){
        renderFaultTagPropertyPanel(selected);
      }
    }
    return tags.length;
  }

  function renderFaultNodeToggles(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-fault-tags-toggle]').forEach(button=>button.remove());
    S.modelNodes.forEach(node=>{
      const tags=getFaultTagsForNode(node.id);
      if(!tags.length){return;}
      const el=document.getElementById(`b-${node.id}`);
      if(!el){return;}
      const expandedCount=tags.filter(tag=>tag.expanded).length;
      el.classList.add('faulted');
      const button=document.createElement('button');
      button.type='button';
      button.className=`fault-node-toggle${expandedCount?' is-open':''}`;
      button.dataset.faultTagsToggle=node.id;
      button.innerHTML=`<span>${expandedCount?'收起故障':'展开故障'}</span><b>${tags.length}</b>`;
      button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>event.stopPropagation());
      button.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        toggleFaultTagsForNode(node.id);
      });
      el.appendChild(button);
    });
  }

  function getFaultEdgeTogglePoint(edge){
    if(!edge){return null;}
    const path=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.edge-path[data-edge-id]'))
      .find(item=>item.dataset.edgeId===edge.id);
    if(path&&typeof path.getTotalLength==='function'&&typeof path.getPointAtLength==='function'){
      try{
        const point=path.getPointAtLength(path.getTotalLength()*0.5);
        if(Number.isFinite(point.x)&&Number.isFinite(point.y)){
          return {x:point.x,y:point.y-20};
        }
      }catch(error){}
    }
    const sourceNode=getNode(edge.sourceNodeId);
    const targetNode=getNode(edge.targetNodeId);
    const sourcePort=sourceNode?getPortInfo(sourceNode,'output',edge.sourcePortIndex||0):null;
    const targetPort=targetNode?getPortInfo(targetNode,'input',edge.targetPortIndex||0):null;
    if(isFiniteCanvasPoint(sourcePort)&&isFiniteCanvasPoint(targetPort)){
      return {
        x:Math.round((sourcePort.x+targetPort.x)/2),
        y:Math.round((sourcePort.y+targetPort.y)/2)-24
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  const edgeFaultToggleClickGuards=new Map();

  function ensureCanvasEdgeControlLayer(){
    const stage=document.getElementById('canvas-stage');
    if(!stage||!stage.ownerDocument||typeof stage.ownerDocument.createElementNS!=='function') return null;
    document.getElementById('fault-edge-toggle-layer')?.remove();
    let layer=document.getElementById('canvas-edge-control-layer');
    if(layer&&layer.parentNode!==stage){
      layer.remove();
      layer=null;
    }
    const nodeLayer=document.getElementById('node-layer');
    const scopeLayer=document.getElementById('scope-window-layer');
    if(!layer){
      layer=stage.ownerDocument.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
      layer.id='canvas-edge-control-layer';
      layer.setAttribute('class','canvas-edge-control-layer');
      layer.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 2400 1500');
      layer.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio','none');
      layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    }
    if(scopeLayer&&scopeLayer.parentNode===stage){
      if(layer.nextSibling!==scopeLayer){
        stage.insertBefore(layer,scopeLayer);
      }
    }else if(nodeLayer&&nodeLayer.parentNode===stage){
      if(nodeLayer.nextSibling!==layer){
        stage.insertBefore(layer,nodeLayer.nextSibling);
      }
    }else if(layer.parentNode!==stage){
      stage.appendChild(layer);
    }
    return layer;
  }
  if(typeof window!=='undefined'){
    window.ensureCanvasEdgeControlLayer=ensureCanvasEdgeControlLayer;
  }

  function renderFaultEdgeToggles(){
    document.getElementById('fault-edge-toggle-group')?.remove();
    const edgeIds=[...new Set(ensureFaultTags()
      .filter(tag=>tag.targetKind==='edge'&&tag.targetId)
      .map(tag=>tag.targetId))];
    if(!edgeIds.length){return;}
    const toggleLayer=ensureCanvasEdgeControlLayer();
    if(!toggleLayer){return;}
    const group=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
    group.id='fault-edge-toggle-group';
    edgeIds.forEach(edgeId=>{
      const edge=getEdge(edgeId);
      const tags=getFaultTagsForEdge(edgeId);
      const point=getFaultEdgeTogglePoint(edge);
      if(!edge||!tags.length||!point){return;}
      const expanded=tags.some(tag=>tag.expanded);
      const marker=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
      marker.setAttribute('class',`edge-fault-toggle${expanded?' is-open':''}`);
      marker.setAttribute('data-edge-fault-toggle','true');
      marker.setAttribute('data-edge-id',edgeId);
      marker.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${Math.round(point.x)} ${Math.round(point.y)})`);
      marker.dataset.edgeId=edgeId;

      const title=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','title');
      title.textContent=expanded?'收起连线故障':'打开连线故障';
      const hit=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
      hit.setAttribute('class','edge-fault-toggle__hit');
      hit.setAttribute('x',tags.length>1?'-26':'-23');
      hit.setAttribute('y','-18');
      hit.setAttribute('width',tags.length>1?'58':'46');
      hit.setAttribute('height','36');
      hit.setAttribute('rx','9');
      const pill=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','rect');
      pill.setAttribute('class','edge-fault-toggle__pill');
      pill.setAttribute('x','-18');
      pill.setAttribute('y','-11');
      pill.setAttribute('width',tags.length>1?'44':'34');
      pill.setAttribute('height','22');
      pill.setAttribute('rx','5');
      const label=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      label.setAttribute('class','edge-fault-toggle__label');
      label.setAttribute('x',tags.length>1?'-7':'0');
      label.setAttribute('y','1');
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','central');
      label.textContent='F';
      marker.append(title,hit,pill,label);
      if(tags.length>1){
        const count=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
        count.setAttribute('class','edge-fault-toggle__count');
        count.setAttribute('x','12');
        count.setAttribute('y','1');
        count.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
        count.setAttribute('dominant-baseline','central');
        count.textContent=String(tags.length);
        marker.appendChild(count);
      }
      const consumeEdgeFaultToggleEvent=event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
      };
      const activateEdgeFaultToggle=event=>{
        consumeEdgeFaultToggleEvent(event);
        toggleFaultTagsForEdge(edgeId,{openPanel:true});
      };
      marker.addEventListener('pointerdown',consumeEdgeFaultToggleEvent);
      marker.addEventListener('pointerup',event=>{
        edgeFaultToggleClickGuards.set(edgeId,Date.now()+350);
        activateEdgeFaultToggle(event);
      });
      marker.addEventListener('click',event=>{
        if(Date.now()<(edgeFaultToggleClickGuards.get(edgeId)||0)){
          consumeEdgeFaultToggleEvent(event);
          return;
        }
        activateEdgeFaultToggle(event);
      });
      group.appendChild(marker);
    });
    toggleLayer.appendChild(group);
  }

  renderVisualFaultInjectionLinks=function(){
    const edgeGroup=document.getElementById('edge-group');
    if(!edgeGroup){return;}
    syncFaultTagPositions();
    const existing=document.getElementById('fault-injection-link-group');
    if(existing){existing.remove();}
    const links=ensureFaultInjectionLinks();
    if(!links.length){return;}
    const group=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
    group.id='fault-injection-link-group';
    links.forEach(link=>{
      const source=getVisualLinkPointForTag(getFaultTagById(link.sourceTagId));
      const target=getVisualLinkTargetPoint(link);
      if(!source||!target){return;}
      const path=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
      const dx=Math.max(48,Math.abs(target.x-source.x)*0.38);
      path.setAttribute('d',`M ${source.x} ${source.y} C ${source.x+dx} ${source.y}, ${target.x-dx} ${target.y}, ${target.x} ${target.y}`);
      path.setAttribute('fill','none');
      path.setAttribute('stroke','#dc2626');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width','2.4');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','7 5');
      path.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#edge-arrow-fault)');
      path.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');
      path.dataset.faultModelId=link.faultModelId||'';
      path.dataset.faultInjectionLink=link.id||'';
      group.appendChild(path);
      const label=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
      label.setAttribute('x',String(Math.round((source.x+target.x)/2)));
      label.setAttribute('y',String(Math.round((source.y+target.y)/2)-8));
      label.setAttribute('text-anchor','middle');
      label.setAttribute('fill','#b91c1c');
      label.setAttribute('font-size','12');
      label.setAttribute('font-weight','800');
      label.textContent='故障注入';
      group.appendChild(label);
    });
    edgeGroup.appendChild(group);
  };

  const __visualInjectionRenderModelNodes=renderModelNodes;
  renderModelNodes=function(){
    const result=__visualInjectionRenderModelNodes();
    renderFaultNodeToggles();
    renderFaultTags();
    return result;
  };
  window.renderModelNodes=renderModelNodes;
  window.renderFaultTags=renderFaultTags;
  window.selectFaultTag=selectFaultTag;
  window.deleteSelectedFaultTag=deleteSelectedFaultTag;
  window.createManualFaultTag=createManualFaultTag;
  window.collapseAllFaultTags=()=>setAllFaultTagsCollapsed(true);
  window.expandAllFaultTags=()=>setAllFaultTagsCollapsed(false);

  const __visualInjectionRenderEdges=renderEdges;
  renderEdges=function(){
    const result=__visualInjectionRenderEdges();
    renderVisualFaultInjectionLinks();
    renderFaultEdgeToggles();
    return result;
  };
  window.renderEdges=renderEdges;

  const __visualInjectionRemoveInjectedFault=window.removeInjectedFault||(typeof removeInjectedFault!=='undefined'?removeInjectedFault:null);
  if(__visualInjectionRemoveInjectedFault&&!window.__visualInjectionRemoveWrapped){
    window.__visualInjectionRemoveWrapped=true;
    window.removeInjectedFault=function(faultId){
      const removed=__visualInjectionRemoveInjectedFault.apply(this,arguments);
      const visualRemoved=removeVisualFaultInjectionArtifacts(faultId,{skipRender:true});
      if(visualRemoved){
        renderModelNodes();
        renderEdges();
        updateUI();
      }
      return Boolean(removed||visualRemoved);
    };
    if(typeof removeInjectedFault!=='undefined') removeInjectedFault=window.removeInjectedFault;
  }

  function refreshAfterBridgeInjection(target){
    renderFaultCatalogList();
    renderModelNodes();
    if(target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId){
      renderEdges();
      if(S.selEdge===target.id){renderPropertyPanel(target);}
    }else if(target?.id&&S.selBlk===target.id){
      renderPropertyPanel(target);
    }
    updateUI();
  }

  const __bridgeRenderFaultCatalogList=renderFaultCatalogList;
  renderFaultCatalogList=function(){
    const result=__bridgeRenderFaultCatalogList();
    const selected=getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    appendParameterEditor('fault-type-detail',selected,'library',S.selBlk||S.selEdge||'');
    return result;
  };

  const __bridgeRenderElectricalInjectModal=renderElectricalInjectModal;
  renderElectricalInjectModal=function(){
    const result=__bridgeRenderElectricalInjectModal();
    appendParameterEditor('einj-detail-body',getCurrentElectricalSelection(),'electrical',S.injectTargetId||'');
    return result;
  };

  const __bridgeRenderProtocolInjectModal=renderProtocolInjectModal;
  renderProtocolInjectModal=function(){
    const result=__bridgeRenderProtocolInjectModal();
    appendParameterEditor('pinj-detail-body',getCurrentProtocolSelection(),'protocol',S.protocolInjectTargetId||'');
    return result;
  };

  const __bridgeConfirmElectricalFaultInjection=confirmElectricalFaultInjection;
  confirmElectricalFaultInjection=function(){
    const targetId=S.injectTargetId;
    const parameterOverrides=readFaultParameterValues('einj-detail-body');
    const result=__bridgeConfirmElectricalFaultInjection();
    const target=findNodeEverywhere(targetId);
    const model=getFaultModelForInjected(target?.injectedFault);
    if(target&&model){
      target.injectedFault=getRuntimePayload({...model,layer:'electrical'},parameterOverrides);
      appendRuntimeFaultBinding(target,{...model,layer:'electrical'},target.injectedFault,'node');
      refreshAfterBridgeInjection(target);
    }
    return result;
  };

  const __bridgeConfirmProtocolFaultInjection=confirmProtocolFaultInjection;
  confirmProtocolFaultInjection=function(){
    const targetId=S.protocolInjectTargetId;
    const parameterOverrides=readFaultParameterValues('pinj-detail-body');
    const result=__bridgeConfirmProtocolFaultInjection();
    const target=findEdgeEverywhere(targetId);
    const model=getFaultModelForInjected(target?.injectedFault);
    if(target&&model){
      target.injectedFault=getRuntimePayload({...model,layer:'protocol'},parameterOverrides);
      appendRuntimeFaultBinding(target,{...model,layer:'protocol'},target.injectedFault,'edge');
      refreshAfterBridgeInjection(target);
    }
    return result;
  };

  const __bridgeConfirmImportFault=confirmImportFault;
  confirmImportFault=function(){
    const selected=getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(!selected){
      return __bridgeConfirmImportFault();
    }
    const imported=ensureImportedFaultModel(selected);
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    const target=api?.findCompatibleFaultTarget?.(imported,{
      nodes:collectAllCanvasItems('nodes'),
      edges:collectAllCanvasItems('edges'),
      selectedNodeId:S.selBlk,
      selectedEdgeId:S.selEdge,
      faultCapabilityMap:S.activeModelPackage?.faultCapabilityMap||[]
    });
    const parameterOverrides=readFaultParameterValues('fault-type-detail');
    let injectedTarget=null;
    if(target?.kind==='edge'){
      const edge=findEdgeEverywhere(target.id);
      if(edge&&injectFaultIntoEdge(edge,imported,parameterOverrides)){
        injectedTarget=edge;
        createVisualFaultInjection(imported,edge,edge.injectedFault);
      }
    }else if(target?.kind==='node'){
      const node=findNodeEverywhere(target.id);
      if(node&&injectFaultIntoNode(node,imported,parameterOverrides)){
        injectedTarget=node;
        createVisualFaultInjection(imported,node,node.injectedFault);
      }
    }

    renderFaultCatalogList();
    if(injectedTarget){
      refreshAfterBridgeInjection(injectedTarget);
      const targetName=injectedTarget.sourceNodeId
        ?'当前 CAN 总线'
        :(injectedTarget.props?.name||injectedTarget.id);
      toast(`故障模型“${imported.name}”已导入并注入到 ${targetName}`,'s');
    }else{
      toast(`故障模型“${imported.name}”已导入工作区；请选择模块或 CAN 总线后可继续注入`,'s');
      updateUI();
    }
  };

  function renderInjectedFaultParameterSummary(target){
    const pd=document.getElementById('pd');
    if(!pd||!target?.injectedFault){return;}
    pd.querySelector('[data-fault-runtime-summary]')?.remove();
    const model=getFaultModelForInjected(target.injectedFault)||target.injectedFault;
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    const params=api?.resolveFaultParameters
      ?api.resolveFaultParameters(model,target.injectedFault)
      :{...(model?.defaultParameters||{}),...(target.injectedFault.parameters||{})};
    const entries=Object.entries(params);
    const behavior=api?.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(model)||target.injectedFault.runtimeBehavior||'';
    const html=`
      <div class="pgroup" data-fault-runtime-summary>
        <div class="pglbl">故障运行配置</div>
        <div class="prow"><span class="pk">故障名称</span><span class="pv pv-fault">${escapeHtml(target.injectedFault.name||model?.name||'故障模型')}</span></div>
        <div class="prow"><span class="pk">故障层级</span><span class="pv">${escapeHtml(getLayerLabel(target.injectedFault.layer||model?.layer))}</span></div>
        ${behavior?`<div class="prow"><span class="pk">运行行为</span><span class="pv">${escapeHtml(behavior)}</span></div>`:''}
        ${model?.platformImplementation?.recommendedModule?`<div class="prow"><span class="pk">推荐模块</span><span class="pv">${escapeHtml(model.platformImplementation.recommendedModule)}</span></div>`:''}
        ${model?.platformImplementation?.pythonFunction?`<div class="prow"><span class="pk">Python</span><span class="pv">${escapeHtml(model.platformImplementation.pythonFunction)}</span></div>`:''}
        ${entries.length?`<div class="ifm-param-grid" style="margin-top:8px">${entries.map(([key,value])=>`
          <div class="ifm-param"><span>${escapeHtml(key)}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(formatBridgeValue(value)||'持续')}</strong></div>
        `).join('')}</div>`:''}
      </div>`;
    const groups=pd.querySelectorAll('.pgroup');
    const anchor=groups[1]||groups[0];
    if(anchor){anchor.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',html);}
    else{pd.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',html);}
  }

  const __bridgeRenderPropertyPanel=renderPropertyPanel;
  renderPropertyPanel=function(node){
    const result=__bridgeRenderPropertyPanel(node);
    if(node?.injectedFault){
      renderInjectedFaultParameterSummary(node);
    }
    return result;
  };

  function getExecutableFaultBindings(target,api){
    const bindings=api?.getFaultBindings?.(target,{activeOnly:true})||[];
    return bindings.filter(binding=>{
      const model=getFaultModelForInjected(binding.injectedFault)||getImportedFaultModel(binding.faultModelId||'')||binding;
      return Boolean(binding.runtimeBehavior||api?.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(model)||api?.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(binding.injectedFault));
    });
  }

  const __bridgeApplyElectricalFault=applyElectricalFault;
  applyElectricalFault=function(node,inputValue,outputValue,time){
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    if(!api||(!node?.injectedFault&&!api.hasActiveFaultBinding?.(node))){
      return __bridgeApplyElectricalFault(node,inputValue,outputValue,time);
    }
    const executableBindings=getExecutableFaultBindings(node,api);
    if(api.applyScalarFaultBindings&&executableBindings.length){
      const state=SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]||(SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]={});
      return api.applyScalarFaultBindings(outputValue,{
        target:{...node,faultBindings:executableBindings},
        resolveFaultModel:(binding)=>getFaultModelForInjected(binding.injectedFault)||getImportedFaultModel(binding.faultModelId||'')||binding,
        stateBucket:state,
        time,
        dt:SIM.stepSize,
        stepIndex:SIM.stepIndex,
        seed:getNodeSeed(node.id)
      });
    }
    const model=getFaultModelForInjected(node.injectedFault);
    const behavior=api.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(model)||api.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(node.injectedFault);
    if(!behavior||behavior==='fixed_delay'||behavior==='packet_loss'||behavior==='jitter_delay'||behavior==='burst_loss'){
      return __bridgeApplyElectricalFault(node,inputValue,outputValue,time);
    }
    const state=SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]||(SIM.actual.nodeStates[node.id]={});
    return api.applyScalarFault(outputValue,{
      faultModel:model,
      injectedFault:node.injectedFault,
      behavior,
      state,
      time,
      dt:SIM.stepSize,
      stepIndex:SIM.stepIndex,
      seed:getNodeSeed(node.id)
    });
  };

  const __bridgeTransmitEdgeSignal=transmitEdgeSignal;
  transmitEdgeSignal=function(edge,value,modeKey,time){
    const api=getFaultRuntimeApi();
    const runtimeBucket=modeKey==='reference'?SIM.reference:SIM.actual;
    const runtimeEdgeState=ensureEdgeRuntime(runtimeBucket,edge);
    runtimeEdgeState.lastTransmissionDropped=false;
    runtimeEdgeState.lastTransmissionDropTime=null;
    const activeBindings=api?.getFaultBindings?.(edge,{activeOnly:true})||[];
    const executableBindings=getExecutableFaultBindings(edge,api);
    const hasProtocolFault=edge?.injectedFault?.layer==='protocol'||activeBindings.some(binding=>binding.layer==='protocol'||binding.propagationMode==='protocolEdge');
    if(api&&modeKey==='actual'&&hasProtocolFault&&!Array.isArray(value)){
      const bucket=SIM.actual;
      const edgeState=ensureEdgeRuntime(bucket,edge);
      const base=Number.isFinite(value)?value:0;
      if(api.applyScalarFaultBindings&&executableBindings.length){
        const nextValue=api.applyScalarFaultBindings(base,{
          target:{...edge,faultBindings:executableBindings},
          resolveFaultModel:(binding)=>getFaultModelForInjected(binding.injectedFault)||getImportedFaultModel(binding.faultModelId||'')||binding,
          stateBucket:edgeState,
          time,
          dt:SIM.stepSize,
          stepIndex:SIM.stepIndex,
          seed:getNodeSeed(edge.id)
        });
        edgeState.lastOutput=nextValue;
        edgeState.lastTransmissionDropped=Boolean(edgeState.lastDropout);
        edgeState.lastTransmissionDropTime=edgeState.lastTransmissionDropped?time:null;
        pushLimitedSample(edgeState.history,base,40);
        return nextValue;
      }
      const model=getFaultModelForInjected(edge.injectedFault);
      const behavior=api.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(model)||api.getFaultRuntimeBehavior?.(edge.injectedFault);
      if(behavior){
        const nextValue=api.applyScalarFault(base,{
          faultModel:model,
          injectedFault:edge.injectedFault,
          behavior,
          state:edgeState,
          time,
          dt:SIM.stepSize,
          stepIndex:SIM.stepIndex,
          seed:getNodeSeed(edge.id)
        });
        edgeState.lastOutput=nextValue;
