        edgeState.lastTransmissionDropped=Boolean(edgeState.lastDropout);
        edgeState.lastTransmissionDropTime=edgeState.lastTransmissionDropped?time:null;
        pushLimitedSample(edgeState.history,base,40);
        return nextValue;
      }
    }
    return __bridgeTransmitEdgeSignal(edge,value,modeKey,time);
  };

  Object.assign(window,{
    confirmElectricalFaultInjection,
    confirmImportFault,
    confirmProtocolFaultInjection,
    renderElectricalInjectModal,
    renderFaultCatalogList,
    renderPropertyPanel,
    renderProtocolInjectModal,
    updateFaultParameterDraft
  });
})();

// --- 最终故障注入入口收口：按当前系统过滤故障库 ---
(function(){
  const UAV_FAULT_LIBRARY_ID='uav-flight-control-faults';
  const UAV_SYSTEM_FAMILY='uav-flight-control';

  function getCompatibilityApi(){
    return window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__?.compatibility||null;
  }

  function html(value){
    if(typeof escapeHtml==='function'){
      return escapeHtml(String(value??''));
    }
    return String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,(ch)=>({
      '&':'&amp;',
      '<':'&lt;',
      '>':'&gt;',
      '"':'&quot;',
      "'":'&#39;'
    }[ch]));
  }

  function setTextById(id,value){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(el){el.textContent=String(value??'');}
  }

  function normalizeFaultInjectionCopy(){
    const btn=document.getElementById('btn-imp-flt');
    if(btn){btn.textContent='注入故障';}
    const title=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .mtitle');
    if(title){title.textContent='注入故障';}
    const sub=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .ifm-modal-sub');
    if(sub){
      sub.textContent='按当前系统模型筛选匹配的故障库，可选择一个或多个故障并配置参数后注入到画布组件或 CAN 边。';
    }
    const listHead=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .ifm-list-head span');
    if(listHead){listHead.textContent='可注入故障';}
    const buildHint=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .ifm-build-hint');
    if(buildHint){
      buildHint.textContent='当前库为无人机飞控系统故障库，仅在导入兼容飞控模型后可注入；其他系统需单独设计故障库。';
    }
    const ok=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .btn-ok-r');
    if(ok){ok.textContent='确认注入';}
  }

  function buildActiveFaultCatalog(models){
    return {
      libraryId:UAV_FAULT_LIBRARY_ID,
      systemFamily:UAV_SYSTEM_FAMILY,
      faultTypes:Array.isArray(models)?models:[]
    };
  }

  function collectCatalogCandidateModels(){
    if(typeof window.getFaultTypeCatalogModels==='function'){
      const catalogModels=window.getFaultTypeCatalogModels();
      if(Array.isArray(catalogModels)&&catalogModels.length>0){
        return catalogModels;
      }
    }
    const byId=new Map();
    const append=(items)=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(items)){return;}
      items.forEach((model)=>{
        if(!model||typeof model!=='object'){return;}
        const key=model.id||`${model.name||''}::${model.layer||''}`;
        if(key&&!byId.has(key)){
          byId.set(key,model);
        }
      });
    };
    append(S.availableFaultModels||[]);
    return Array.from(byId.values());
  }

  function getCompatibleFaultCatalogModels(){
    const api=getCompatibilityApi();
    const candidates=collectCatalogCandidateModels();
    if(!api||!S.activeModelPackage){
      return [];
    }
    return api.filterCompatibleFaultTypes?.(buildActiveFaultCatalog(candidates),S.activeModelPackage)||[];
  }

  function getVisibleCompatibleFaultModels(models){
    const layer=S.faultCatalogLayerFilter||'all';
    const query=String(S.faultCatalogSearch||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    return models.filter((model)=>{
      if(layer!=='all'&&model.layer!==layer){return false;}
      if(!query){return true;}
      return [
        model.id,
        model.name,
        model.layer,
        model.modelClass,
        model.desc,
        model.description,
        model.formula,
        model.platformImplementation?.recommendedModule,
        model.platformImplementation?.pythonFunction,
        ...(Array.isArray(model.typicalTargets)?model.typicalTargets:[]),
        ...(Array.isArray(model.observableSignals)?model.observableSignals:[])
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query);
    });
  }

  function updateFaultCatalogCompatibilitySummary(compatibleModels){
    const summary={total:0,physical:0,electrical:0,protocol:0};
    compatibleModels.forEach((model)=>{
      summary.total+=1;
      if(summary[model.layer]!==undefined){
        summary[model.layer]+=1;
      }
    });
    setTextById('ifm-total-count',summary.total);
    setTextById('ifm-physical-count',summary.physical);
    setTextById('ifm-electrical-count',summary.electrical);
    setTextById('ifm-protocol-count',summary.protocol);
    setTextById('ifm-visible-count',getVisibleCompatibleFaultModels(compatibleModels).length);
  }

  function countSystemNodes(){
    const seen=new Set();
    const append=(items)=>{
      if(!Array.isArray(items)){return;}
      items.forEach((node)=>{
        if(node?.id){seen.add(node.id);}
      });
    };
    append(S.modelNodes);
    if(S.canvases&&typeof S.canvases==='object'){
      Object.values(S.canvases).forEach((canvas)=>append(canvas?.nodes));
    }
    return seen.size;
  }

  function renderCompatibilityEmptyState(message){
    const container=document.getElementById('ifm-list-container');
    if(container){
      container.innerHTML=`<div class="ifm-empty">${html(message)}</div>`;
    }
    const detail=document.getElementById('fault-type-detail');
    if(detail){
      detail.innerHTML=`<div class="ifm-detail-empty">${html(message)}</div>`;
    }
    const hint=document.getElementById('ifm-sel-hint');
    if(hint){
      hint.textContent='已选：当前系统没有可注入的飞控故障';
    }
    const ok=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .btn-ok-r');
    if(ok){ok.disabled=true;}
  }

  const __finalScopedApplyFlightModelPackage=window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__;
  if(typeof __finalScopedApplyFlightModelPackage==='function'){
    window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__=function(pkg,prepared){
      const result=__finalScopedApplyFlightModelPackage(pkg,prepared);
      if(result?.ok!==false&&S.activeModelPackage){
        const descriptor=prepared?.descriptor||{};
        const systemFamily=pkg?.systemFamily??descriptor.systemFamily??null;
        const hasPackageLibraries=Array.isArray(pkg?.supportedFaultLibraries);
        const hasDescriptorLibraries=Array.isArray(descriptor.supportedFaultLibraries)&&descriptor.supportedFaultLibraries.length>0;
        const supportedFaultLibraries=hasPackageLibraries
          ? cloneDefaults(pkg.supportedFaultLibraries)
          : hasDescriptorLibraries
            ? cloneDefaults(descriptor.supportedFaultLibraries)
            : undefined;
        if(systemFamily){S.activeModelPackage.systemFamily=systemFamily;}
        if(supportedFaultLibraries){S.activeModelPackage.supportedFaultLibraries=supportedFaultLibraries;}
      }
      return result;
    };
  }

  const __finalScopedRenderFaultCatalogList=renderFaultCatalogList;
  renderFaultCatalogList=function(){
    normalizeFaultInjectionCopy();
    const compatibleModels=getCompatibleFaultCatalogModels();
    const visibleCompatible=getVisibleCompatibleFaultModels(compatibleModels);
    const compatibleIds=new Set(compatibleModels.map((model)=>model.id));

    if(!compatibleIds.has(S.selectedFaultCatalogId)&&!getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId)){
      S.selectedFaultCatalogId=visibleCompatible[0]?.id||compatibleModels[0]?.id||'';
    }

    const result=__finalScopedRenderFaultCatalogList();
    updateFaultCatalogCompatibilitySummary(compatibleModels);

    const ok=document.querySelector('#ov-ifm .btn-ok-r');
    if(ok){ok.disabled=false;}

    if(!S.activeModelPackage){
      S.availableFaultModels=[];
      renderCompatibilityEmptyState('当前系统没有模型包元数据，无法匹配无人机飞控故障库。');
      return result;
    }

    if(compatibleModels.length===0){
      S.availableFaultModels=[];
      S.selectedFaultCatalogId='';
      renderCompatibilityEmptyState('当前系统不支持无人机飞控故障库，请为该系统设计对应的故障库。');
      return result;
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('#ifm-list-container [data-fault-id]').forEach((item)=>{
      if(!compatibleIds.has(item.dataset.faultId)){
        item.remove();
      }
    });

    if(visibleCompatible.length===0){
      const container=document.getElementById('ifm-list-container');
      if(container){
        container.innerHTML='<div class="ifm-empty">当前筛选条件下没有可注入故障。</div>';
      }
    }

    const selected=compatibleModels.find((model)=>model.id===S.selectedFaultCatalogId)||getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(!selected){
      const detail=document.getElementById('fault-type-detail');
      if(detail){
        detail.innerHTML='<div class="ifm-detail-empty">请选择一个与当前飞控系统匹配的故障。</div>';
      }
    }

    return result;
  };

  const __finalScopedDoImportFault=doImportFault;
  doImportFault=function(){
    normalizeFaultInjectionCopy();
    if(!S.sysLoaded){
      toast('请先导入或新建系统模型','w');
      return;
    }
    if(countSystemNodes()===0){
      toast('请先在系统建模页拖入组件','w');
      return;
    }

    const compatibleModels=getCompatibleFaultCatalogModels();
    renderFaultCatalogList();
    openOv('ov-ifm');

    if(compatibleModels.length===0){
      toast('当前系统未绑定无人机飞控故障库，需为该系统单独设计故障。','w');
    }
  };

  const __finalScopedConfirmImportFault=confirmImportFault;
  confirmImportFault=function(){
    const compatibleModels=getCompatibleFaultCatalogModels();
    const selected=compatibleModels.find((model)=>model.id===S.selectedFaultCatalogId)||getFaultCatalogModel(S.selectedFaultCatalogId);
    if(!selected){
      toast('请先选择与当前系统匹配的故障','w');
      return;
    }
    return __finalScopedConfirmImportFault();
  };

  const __finalScopedUpdateUI=updateUI;
  updateUI=function(){
    const result=__finalScopedUpdateUI();
    normalizeFaultInjectionCopy();
    return result;
  };

  normalizeFaultInjectionCopy();
  Object.assign(window,{
    confirmImportFault,
    doImportFault,
    renderFaultCatalogList
  });
})();

;(function installDiagnosticModelPackageBridge(){
  if(typeof window==='undefined') return;

  function clone(value){
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value==null?null:value));
  }

  function arr(value){
    return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
  }

  function getState(){
    return window.__GZ_STATE__||(typeof S!=='undefined'?S:null);
  }

  function hasDiagnosticFaultLibrary(state){
    return Boolean(state?.diagnosticModel&&arr(state.faultLibrary).length);
  }

  function applyDiagnosticFaultCatalog(state=getState()){
    if(!hasDiagnosticFaultLibrary(state)) return [];
    const models=arr(state.faultLibrary).map(clone);
    state.availableFaultModels=models;
    if(!models.some(model=>model.id===state.selectedFaultCatalogId)){
      state.selectedFaultCatalogId=models[0]?.id||'';
    }
    return models;
  }

  function normalizeFaultCase(faultCase){
    if(!faultCase||typeof faultCase!=='object') return null;
    const id=faultCase.id||faultCase.faultId||faultCase.modelId||faultCase.faultModelId;
    if(!id) return null;
    return {
      ...faultCase,
      id,
      name:faultCase.name||faultCase.nameZh||faultCase.labelZh||id,
      category:faultCase.category||faultCase.categoryZh||faultCase.modelClass||faultCase.layer||'故障',
      detects:arr(faultCase.detects),
      moduleTargets:arr(faultCase.moduleTargets)
    };
  }

  function normalizeDiagnosticPoint(point,index){
    const pointId=point?.pointId||point?.id||`tp-${index+1}`;
    return {
      ...point,
      pointId,
      id:pointId,
      shortName:point?.shortName||point?.code||`M${index+1}`,
      name:point?.name||point?.nameZh||point?.labelZh||point?.positionNameZh||`测点 ${index+1}`,
      detects:arr(point?.detects)
    };
  }

  function clearDiagnosticPackageCaches(state){
    delete state.compactDiagnosticFixedPoints;
    delete state.compactDiagnosticFixedPointSignature;
    delete state.compactDiagnosticPointSignature;
    state.diagnosticTestPointModelSignature='';
    state.selectedDiagnosticTestPointId='';
    state.diagnosticScanResults=[];
    state.lastDiagnosticTestPointResult=null;
    state.testPointDiagnosis=null;
    state.confirmedDiagnosticFaults={};
    state.confirmedDiagnosticFaultIds=[];
    state.installedDiagnosticTestPointIds=[];
  }

  const previousGetFaultTypeCatalogModels=window.getFaultTypeCatalogModels;
  if(typeof previousGetFaultTypeCatalogModels==='function'&&!window.__GZ_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULT_CATALOG_SOURCE__){
    window.__GZ_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULT_CATALOG_SOURCE__=true;
    window.getFaultTypeCatalogModels=function(){
      const diagnosticModels=applyDiagnosticFaultCatalog();
      if(diagnosticModels.length) return diagnosticModels.map(clone);
      return previousGetFaultTypeCatalogModels.apply(this,arguments);
    };
  }

  if(typeof syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable==='function'&&!window.__GZ_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULT_CATALOG_SYNC__){
    const previousSyncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable=syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable;
    window.__GZ_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULT_CATALOG_SYNC__=true;
    syncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable=function(){
      if(applyDiagnosticFaultCatalog().length) return;
      return previousSyncFaultTypeCatalogIntoAvailable.apply(this,arguments);
    };
  }

  const previousApply=window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__;
  if(typeof previousApply==='function'){
    window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__=function(pkg,prepared){
      const result=previousApply(pkg,prepared);
      if(result?.ok===false) return result;
      const state=getState();
      const diagnosticModel=pkg?.diagnosticModel||prepared?.diagnosticModel||null;
      if(!state||!diagnosticModel) return result;
      const points=arr(diagnosticModel.testPoints).map(normalizeDiagnosticPoint);
      state.diagnosticModel=clone(diagnosticModel);
      state.diagnosticTestPoints=clone(points);
      state.testPoints=clone(points);
      state.faultLibrary=[];
      state.faults=state.faultLibrary;
      if(state.activeModelPackage){
        state.activeModelPackage.diagnosticModel=clone(diagnosticModel);
      }
      clearDiagnosticPackageCaches(state);
      if(typeof renderFaultCatalogList==='function'){
        try{renderFaultCatalogList();}catch(error){console.warn('[diagnostic-model] failed to render fault catalog',error);}
      }
      return result;
    };
  }
})();

// --- Property panel chrome: typed shells for component / fault / instrument / edge ---
(function(){
  function h(value,fallback=''){
    const raw=value===undefined||value===null||value===''?fallback:value;
    return typeof escapeHtml==='function'
      ?escapeHtml(String(raw))
      :String(raw);
  }

  function isEdgeLike(target){
    return Boolean(target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId&&!target?.type);
  }

  function getSelectedFaultTagForChrome(){
    if(!S?.selFaultTag||!Array.isArray(S?.faultTags)){return null;}
    return S.faultTags.find(tag=>tag&&tag.id===S.selFaultTag)||null;
  }

  function classifyPropertyPanelKind(target,options={}){
    if(options.kind){return options.kind;}
    if(getSelectedFaultTagForChrome()){return 'fault-tag';}
    if(!target){return 'empty';}
    if(isEdgeLike(target)){return 'edge';}
    if(target.type==='instrument_scope'){return 'scope';}
    if(['instrument_logger','instrument_spectrum','instrument_signal_flow'].includes(target.type)){return 'instrument';}
    if(['physical_fault_injector','electrical_fault_injector','protocol_fault_injector'].includes(target.type)){return 'fault-injector';}
    return 'component';
  }

  function getPanelHeader(kind){
    if(kind==='fault-tag'){return {title:'故障标签',sub:'当前选择 · 故障实例'};}
    if(kind==='scope'){return {title:'示波器面板',sub:'当前选择 · 观测与波形'};}
    if(kind==='instrument'){return {title:'测量仪器',sub:'当前选择 · 记录与分析'};}
    if(kind==='edge'){return {title:'连接属性',sub:'当前选择 · 连线与信号链路'};}
    if(kind==='fault-injector'){return {title:'故障注入器',sub:'当前选择 · 分层故障绑定'};}
    if(kind==='component'){return {title:'组件属性',sub:'当前选择 · 模块配置'};}
    return {title:'属性面板',sub:'当前选择 · 组件属性'};
  }

  function getComponentPortSummary(target){
    try{
      const ports=typeof getNodePorts==='function'?getNodePorts(target):null;
      return {
        inputs:(ports?.inputs||[]).length,
        outputs:(ports?.outputs||[]).length
      };
    }catch(error){
      return {
        inputs:Array.isArray(target?.props?.inputs)?target.props.inputs.length:0,
        outputs:Array.isArray(target?.props?.outputs)?target.props.outputs.length:0
      };
    }
  }

  function getNodeTypeLabel(target){
    return COMPONENT_LIBRARY?.[target?.type]?.label||target?.type||'组件';
  }

  function getNodeStatusLabel(target){
    const hasBindings=Array.isArray(target?.faultBindings)&&target.faultBindings.some(binding=>binding&&binding.active!==false);
    const isFaulted=Boolean(target?.injectedFault)||hasBindings||Boolean(Array.isArray(S?.faultedBlks)&&target?.id&&S.faultedBlks.includes(target.id));
    return isFaulted?'故障已注入':'正常';
  }

  function getEdgeSummary(target){
    const source=typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(target?.sourceNodeId):null;
    const dest=typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(target?.targetNodeId):null;
    const signal=Array.isArray(target?.signalChannels)&&target.signalChannels.length?target.signalChannels[0]:target||{};
    return {
      title:`${source?.props?.name||target?.sourceNodeId||'源'} → ${dest?.props?.name||target?.targetNodeId||'目标'}`,
      rows:[
        ['连接类型',target?.lineType==='can'?'CAN 总线':'普通连线'],
        ['信号标识',signal?.signalId||target?.signalId||'未声明'],
        ['通道 / 报文',`${signal?.channelId||target?.channelId||'--'} / ${signal?.messageId||target?.messageId||'--'}`]
      ]
    };
  }

  function getFaultLayerLabel(layer){
    return ({
      physical:'\u7269\u7406\u5c42',
      electrical:'\u7535\u6c14\u5c42',
      protocol:'\u534f\u8bae\u5c42'
    })[layer]||layer||'\u672a\u5b9a\u4e49';
  }

  function getFaultRuntimeLabel(value){
    return ({
      bias:'\u504f\u5dee\u6545\u969c',
      stuck:'\u5361\u6b7b\u6545\u969c',
      freeze:'\u5361\u6b7b\u6545\u969c',
      tamper:'\u6570\u636e\u7be1\u6539',
      delay:'\u5ef6\u8fdf\u6545\u969c',
      dropout:'\u4e22\u5305\u6545\u969c',
      stale:'\u65e7\u503c\u91cd\u653e',
      overwrite:'\u8986\u76d6\u5199\u5165'
    })[String(value)]||value||'\u6309\u6a21\u578b\u5b9a\u4e49';
  }

  function getFaultTagSummary(tag){
    return {
      title:tag?.name||'\u6545\u969c\u5b9e\u4f8b',
      rows:[
        ['\u6545\u969c\u5c42\u7ea7',getFaultLayerLabel(tag?.layer)],
        ['\u76ee\u6807\u5bf9\u8c61',tag?.targetName||tag?.targetId||'\u672a\u7ed1\u5b9a'],
        ['\u8fd0\u884c\u65b9\u5f0f',getFaultRuntimeLabel(tag?.runtimeBehavior||tag?.mathModel||tag?.modelClass)]
      ]
    };
  }
  function getInjectorSummary(target){
    const config=typeof getLayeredFaultInjectorConfig==='function'
      ?getLayeredFaultInjectorConfig(target?.type)
      :null;
    return {
      title:target?.props?.name||config?.label||'故障注入器',
      rows:[
        ['注入层级',config?.layerLabel||'未定义'],
        ['绑定目标',config?.layer==='protocol'?'连接线 / 总线数据':'模块变量 / 参数'],
        ['匹配规则',config?.faultType||'模型参数故障']
      ]
    };
  }

  function getScopeSummary(target){
    const ports=getComponentPortSummary(target);
    return {
      title:target?.props?.name||'示波器',
      rows:[
        ['输入通道',String(ports.inputs||0)],
        ['查看方式',target?.props?.openMode||'双击波形查看'],
        ['状态',getNodeStatusLabel(target)]
      ]
    };
  }

  function getInstrumentSummary(target){
    const ports=getComponentPortSummary(target);
    return {
      title:target?.props?.name||'测量仪器',
      rows:[
        ['仪器类型',getNodeTypeLabel(target)],
        ['输入通道',String(ports.inputs||0)],
        ['状态',getNodeStatusLabel(target)]
      ]
    };
  }

  function getComponentSummary(target){
    const ports=getComponentPortSummary(target);
    return {
      title:target?.props?.name||target?.id||'组件',
      rows:[
        ['组件类型',getNodeTypeLabel(target)],
        ['输入 / 输出',`${ports.inputs||0} / ${ports.outputs||0}`],
        ['运行状态',getNodeStatusLabel(target)]
      ]
    };
  }

  function getPanelSummary(kind,target,options={}){
    if(kind==='fault-tag'){return getFaultTagSummary(options.faultTag||getSelectedFaultTagForChrome());}
    if(kind==='scope'){return getScopeSummary(target);}
    if(kind==='instrument'){return getInstrumentSummary(target);}
    if(kind==='edge'){return getEdgeSummary(target);}
    if(kind==='fault-injector'){return getInjectorSummary(target);}
    return getComponentSummary(target);
  }

  function renderPanelHero(kind,target,options={}){
    const summary=getPanelSummary(kind,target,options);
    const faultTag=options.faultTag||getSelectedFaultTagForChrome();
    const heroRows=kind==='fault-tag'
      ?[
        ['\u72b6\u6001','\u5df2\u6ce8\u5165'],
        ['\u5c42\u7ea7',getFaultLayerLabel(faultTag?.layer)],
        ['\u53c2\u6570',String(Object.keys(faultTag?.parameters||{}).length)]
      ]
      :kind==='scope'
        ?[
          ['\u901a\u9053',(summary?.rows||[])[0]?.[1]||'0'],
          ['\u72b6\u6001',getNodeStatusLabel(target)]
        ]
        :(summary?.rows||[]);
    const badgeMap={
      component:'组件',
      scope:'示波器',
      instrument:'仪器',
      edge:'链路',
      'fault-tag':'故障',
      'fault-injector':'注入器'
    };
    return `
      <header class="props-panel-hero props-panel-hero--${h(kind)}">
        <div class="props-panel-hero__main">
          <div class="props-panel-hero__eyebrow">${h(badgeMap[kind]||'属性')}</div>
          <div class="props-panel-hero__title">${h(summary?.title||'属性面板')}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="props-panel-hero__meta">
          ${heroRows.map(([label,value])=>`
            <div class="props-panel-hero__pill">
              <span>${h(label)}</span>
              <strong>${h(value,'--')}</strong>
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      </header>
    `;
  }

  function decoratePropertyPanel(target,options={}){
    const pd=document.getElementById('pd');
    const pe=document.getElementById('pe');
    const panel=document.querySelector('.rpanel');
    const kind=classifyPropertyPanelKind(target,options);
    const header=getPanelHeader(kind);
    const titleEl=document.querySelector('.ph-title');
    const subEl=document.querySelector('.ph-sub');
    if(titleEl){titleEl.textContent=header.title;}
    if(subEl){subEl.textContent=header.sub;}
    if(panel){panel.dataset.propsPanelKind=kind;}
    if(!pd||pd.style.display==='none'||!pd.innerHTML.trim()||pe?.style.display==='block'){return;}
    if(pd.querySelector('[data-props-panel-shell="true"]')){return;}
    const shell=document.createElement('section');
    shell.className=`props-panel-shell props-panel-shell--${kind}`;
    shell.dataset.propsPanelShell='true';
    shell.dataset.propsPanelKind=kind;

    const heroHost=document.createElement('div');
    heroHost.innerHTML=renderPanelHero(kind,target,options).trim();
    if(heroHost.firstElementChild){
      shell.appendChild(heroHost.firstElementChild);
    }

    const content=document.createElement('div');
    content.className='props-panel-shell__content';
    while(pd.firstChild){
      content.appendChild(pd.firstChild);
    }
    shell.appendChild(content);
    pd.appendChild(shell);
  }

  window.__GZ_DECORATE_PROPERTY_PANEL__=decoratePropertyPanel;

  const __panelChromeRenderPropertyPanel=renderPropertyPanel;
  renderPropertyPanel=function(target){
    const result=__panelChromeRenderPropertyPanel(target);
    decoratePropertyPanel(target,{});
    return result;
  };
})();

;(function installComponentFaultCapabilityModel(){
  if(typeof window==='undefined') return;

  function cloneCapabilityValue(value){
    try{
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value==null?null:value));
    }catch(error){
      return value;
    }
  }

  function getState(){
    return window.__GZ_STATE__||(typeof S!=='undefined'?S:{});
  }

  function arr(value){
    return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
  }

  function getActiveFaultCapabilityMap(){
    const state=getState();
    const pkg=state.activeModelPackage||{};
    return arr(pkg.faultCapabilityMap);
  }

  function inferFaultTargetKind(target){
    return target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId?'edge':'node';
  }

  function getFaultCapabilityForTarget(target){
    if(!target?.id) return null;
    const kind=inferFaultTargetKind(target);
    return getActiveFaultCapabilityMap().find(entry=>(
      entry?.targetId===target.id&&(entry.targetKind||kind)===kind
    ))||null;
  }

  function getCapabilitySlots(entry){
    if(!entry) return [];
    if(arr(entry.faultSlots).length) return arr(entry.faultSlots);
    if(entry.slotId||arr(entry.allowedFaultIds).length||arr(entry.allowedFaultTypeIds).length){
      return [entry];
    }
    return [];
  }

  function getAllowedFaultIds(slot){
    return arr(slot?.allowedFaultIds).length
      ?arr(slot.allowedFaultIds)
      :arr(slot?.allowedFaultTypeIds);
  }

  function getCapabilitySlotId(slot,index=0){
    return String(slot?.slotId||slot?.id||`slot-${index+1}`).trim();
  }

  function getCapabilitySlotLayer(slot){
    const layer=String(slot?.layer||slot?.layerKey||'').trim();
    return layer||'electrical';
  }

  function normalizeFaultLayer(value){
    const raw=String(value||'').trim();
    if(raw==='physical'||raw==='electrical'||raw==='protocol') return raw;
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeFaultTargetKindFilter(value){
    const raw=String(value||'').trim();
    if(raw==='edge'||raw==='line') return 'edge';
    if(raw==='node'||raw==='module'||raw==='component') return 'node';
    return raw==='any'?'any':'';
  }

  function normalizeFaultOptionFilters(filters={}){
    const source=typeof filters==='string'?{layer:filters}:(filters||{});
    return {
      layer:normalizeFaultLayer(source.layer||source.layerKey||source.injectorLayer||source.faultLayer),
      targetKind:normalizeFaultTargetKindFilter(source.targetKind||source.kind||source.targetKindFilter)
    };
  }

  function faultOptionMatchesFilters(option,target,filters={}){
    const normalized=normalizeFaultOptionFilters(filters);
    if(normalized.targetKind&&normalized.targetKind!=='any'&&inferFaultTargetKind(target)!==normalized.targetKind){
      return false;
    }
    if(normalized.layer){
      const slotLayer=normalizeFaultLayer(getCapabilitySlotLayer(option?.slot));
      const modelLayer=normalizeFaultLayer(option?.model?.layer||option?.model?.layerKey||slotLayer);
      return slotLayer===normalized.layer&&(!modelLayer||modelLayer===normalized.layer);
    }
    return true;
  }

  function getFaultInjectionForm(target,layer){
    const targetKind=inferFaultTargetKind(target);
    const normalizedLayer=normalizeFaultLayer(layer);
    if(targetKind==='edge'&&normalizedLayer==='protocol') return 'protocol-bus';
    if(targetKind==='edge') return 'signal-edge';
    return 'module-variable';
  }

  function normalizedFaultText(value){
    return String(value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  function getCapabilitySlotModelTokens(slot){
    return [
      ...arr(slot?.allowedModels),
      ...arr(slot?.allowedFaultModels),
      ...arr(slot?.runtimeBehaviors)
    ].map(normalizedFaultText).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function getFaultModelTokens(model){
    const tokens=[
      model?.id,
      model?.faultTypeId,
      model?.runtimeBehavior,
      model?.modelClass,
      model?.faultClass,
      model?.faultKind
    ].map(normalizedFaultText).filter(Boolean);
    if(tokens.includes('additive_bias')||tokens.includes('parameter_bias')) tokens.push('bias');
    if(tokens.includes('packet_loss')) tokens.push('dropout');
    if(tokens.includes('fixed_delay')||tokens.includes('jitter_delay')) tokens.push('delay');
    if(tokens.includes('freeze')) tokens.push('stale');
    if(tokens.includes('tamper')) tokens.push('tamper');
    return [...new Set(tokens)];
  }

  function capabilitySlotAllowsModel(slot,model){
    const modelId=model?.id||model?.faultTypeId||'';
    const allowedIds=getAllowedFaultIds(slot);
    if(allowedIds.length) return allowedIds.includes(modelId);
    const slotLayer=getCapabilitySlotLayer(slot);
    const modelLayer=model?.layer||model?.layerKey||'electrical';
    if(slotLayer!==modelLayer) return false;
    const allowedModelTokens=getCapabilitySlotModelTokens(slot);
    if(!allowedModelTokens.length) return true;
    const modelTokens=getFaultModelTokens(model);
    return allowedModelTokens.some(token=>modelTokens.includes(token));
  }

  function getFaultSlotBindingObject(slot){
    const value=slot?.bindingObject
      || slot?.targetVariable
      || slot?.variableKey
      || slot?.parameterKey
      || slot?.varName
      || slot?.key
      || '';
    return String(value||'').trim();
  }

  function getActiveFaultTypeCatalog(){
    const state=getState();
    const pkg=state.activeModelPackage||{};
    if(arr(pkg.faultTypeCatalog).length) return arr(pkg.faultTypeCatalog);
    return arr(state.availableFaultModels);
  }

  function defaultsFromParameterSchema(parameters){
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(parameters||{}).map(([key,value])=>[
      key,
      value&&typeof value==='object'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value,'default')?value.default:value
    ]));
  }

  function normalizeCapabilityFaultModel(model){
    if(!model) return null;
    const id=model.id||model.faultTypeId||'';
    const defaultParameters=Object.keys(model.defaultParameters||{}).length
      ?model.defaultParameters
      :defaultsFromParameterSchema(model.parameters);
    return {
      ...model,
      id,
      name:model.name||model.displayName||id,
      displayName:model.displayName||model.name||id,
      defaultParameters:cloneCapabilityValue(defaultParameters||{})
    };
  }

  function getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget(target,filters={}){
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget){
      return runtimeService.getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget(target,{
        capabilityMap:getActiveFaultCapabilityMap(),
        faultModels:getActiveFaultTypeCatalog(),
        filters
      });
    }
    const capability=getFaultCapabilityForTarget(target);
    if(!capability) return [];
    const slots=getCapabilitySlots(capability);
    const models=getActiveFaultTypeCatalog()
      .map(normalizeCapabilityFaultModel)
      .filter(Boolean);
    const seen=new Set();
    return slots.flatMap((slot,index)=>{
      const slotId=getCapabilitySlotId(slot,index);
      return models
        .filter(model=>capabilitySlotAllowsModel(slot,model))
        .map(model=>{
          const key=`${model.id}::${slotId}`;
          if(seen.has(key)) return null;
          seen.add(key);
          return {model,slot,slotId};
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
    }).filter(option=>faultOptionMatchesFilters(option,target,filters));
  }

  function getCompatibleFaultModelsForTarget(target,filters={}){
    const seen=new Set();
    return getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget(target,filters)
      .map(option=>option.model)
      .filter(model=>{
        if(!model?.id||seen.has(model.id)) return false;
        seen.add(model.id);
        return true;
      });
  }

  function ensureFaultInstances(){
    const state=getState();
    if(!Array.isArray(state.faultInstances)) state.faultInstances=[];
    return state.faultInstances;
  }

  function normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(name){
    return String(name||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').toLowerCase();
  }

  function getFaultRecordName(value){
    return value?.name||value?.displayName||value?.faultModelName||value?.injectedFault?.name||value?.injectedFault?.displayName||'';
  }

  function faultRecordMatchesIdentity(value,identity={}){
    if(!value||!identity){return false;}
    return [
      value.id,
      value.instanceId,
      value.faultModelId,
      value.faultTypeId,
      value.modelId,
      value.faultId,
      value.injectedFault?.modelId,
      value.injectedFault?.faultModelId,
      value.injectedFault?.faultTypeId
    ].filter(Boolean).some(id=>[
      identity.id,
      identity.instanceId,
      identity.faultModelId,
      identity.faultTypeId,
      identity.modelId,
      identity.faultId
    ].filter(Boolean).includes(id));
  }

  function isFaultNameDuplicate(name,identity={}){
    const normalized=normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(name);
    if(!normalized){return false;}
    const asArray=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
    const state=getState();
    const records=[
      ...asArray(state.faultTags),
      ...asArray(state.faultInstances),
      ...asArray(state.injectedFaults),
      ...asArray(state.activeFaults),
      ...asArray(state.selectedFaults),
      ...asArray(state.appliedFaults)
    ];
    return records.some(record=>{
      if(record?.active===false||record?.enabled===false){return false;}
      if(faultRecordMatchesIdentity(record,identity)){return false;}
      return normalizeFaultNameForUniqueness(getFaultRecordName(record))===normalized;
    });
  }

  function getCompatibleSlotForFault(target,faultTypeId,slotId='',filters={}){
    const options=getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget(target,filters)
      .filter(option=>option.model?.id===faultTypeId);
    if(slotId){
      return options.find(option=>option.slotId===slotId)?.slot||null;
    }
    return options[0]?.slot||null;
  }

  function getFirstCompatibleSlotForFault(target,faultTypeId,filters={}){
    return getCompatibleSlotForFault(target,faultTypeId,'',filters);
  }

  function getCapabilityFaultModel(faultTypeId){
    return getActiveFaultTypeCatalog()
      .map(normalizeCapabilityFaultModel)
      .find(model=>model?.id===faultTypeId)||null;
  }

  function findExistingFaultInstanceForTarget(target,faultTypeId,slot=null){
    if(!target?.id||!faultTypeId) return null;
    const targetKind=inferFaultTargetKind(target);
    const fallbackSlot=getFirstCompatibleSlotForFault(target,faultTypeId);
    const slotId=slot?getCapabilitySlotId(slot):(fallbackSlot?getCapabilitySlotId(fallbackSlot):'');
    return ensureFaultInstances().find(instance=>(
      instance?.active!==false
      && instance.targetKind===targetKind
      && instance.targetId===target.id
      && instance.faultTypeId===faultTypeId
      && (!slotId||instance.slotId===slotId)
    ))||null;
  }

  function createFaultInstanceForTarget(target,faultTypeId,parameterOverrides={},options={}){
    const model=getCapabilityFaultModel(faultTypeId);
    const optionFilters=normalizeFaultOptionFilters(options);
    const slot=options.slot||getCompatibleSlotForFault(target,faultTypeId,options.slotId||'',optionFilters);
    if(!target||!model||!slot){
      return {ok:false,error:'incompatible-target'};
    }
    const targetKind=inferFaultTargetKind(target);
    const slotId=getCapabilitySlotId(slot);
    const parameters={
      ...(model.defaultParameters||{}),
      ...(parameterOverrides||{})
    };
    const bindingObject=getFaultSlotBindingObject(slot);
    const injectionForm=getFaultInjectionForm(target,model.layer||slot.layer||optionFilters.layer);
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    const displayName=model.displayName||model.name||model.id;
    if(isFaultNameDuplicate(displayName,{faultTypeId:model.id,targetId:target.id,slotId})){
      return {ok:false,error:'duplicate-fault-name',name:displayName,model,slot};
    }
    if(runtimeService?.createFaultInstancePlan){
      const plan=runtimeService.createFaultInstancePlan({
        target,
        model,
        slot,
        existingInstances:ensureFaultInstances(),
        parameterOverrides,
        targetKind,
        slotId,
        bindingObject,
        injectionForm
      });
      if(!plan.ok){
        return plan;
      }
      const state=getState();
      state.faultInstances=runtimeService.upsertFaultInstanceRecord
        ?runtimeService.upsertFaultInstanceRecord(state.faultInstances,plan.instance)
        :[...ensureFaultInstances(),plan.instance];
      if(state.activeModelPackage){
        state.activeModelPackage.faultInstances=cloneCapabilityValue(state.faultInstances);
      }
      return {ok:true,instance:plan.instance,model,slot};
    }
    const duplicate=findExistingFaultInstanceForTarget(target,model.id,slot);
    if(duplicate){
      return {ok:false,error:'duplicate-fault-instance',instance:duplicate,model,slot};
    }
    const instance=runtimeService?.createFaultInstanceRecord?runtimeService.createFaultInstanceRecord({
      target,
      model,
      slot,
      targetKind,
      slotId,
      parameters,
      bindingObject,
      injectionForm
    }):{
      instanceId:`fault-inst-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2,8)}`,
      faultTypeId:model.id,
      targetKind,
      targetId:target.id,
      slotId,
      slotName:slot.slotName||slot.name||'',
      layer:model.layer||slot.layer||'electrical',
      injectionForm,
      bindingObject,
      targetVariable:bindingObject,
      targetField:slot.targetField||'',
      displayName:model.displayName||model.name||model.id,
      parameters:cloneCapabilityValue(parameters),
      active:true,
      visual:{expanded:false}
    };
    const state=getState();
    if(window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__?.upsertFaultInstanceRecord){
      state.faultInstances=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__.upsertFaultInstanceRecord(state.faultInstances,instance);
    }else{
      ensureFaultInstances().push(instance);
    }
    if(state.activeModelPackage){
      state.activeModelPackage.faultInstances=cloneCapabilityValue(state.faultInstances);
    }
    return {ok:true,instance,model,slot};
  }

  function pushFaultRuntimeRecord(key,payload){
    const state=getState();
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.upsertFaultRuntimeRecord){
      state[key]=runtimeService.upsertFaultRuntimeRecord(state[key],payload);
      return;
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(state[key])) state[key]=[];
    state[key]=state[key].filter(item=>(
      item?.instanceId!==payload.instanceId
      && item?.modelId!==payload.modelId
      && item?.faultModelId!==payload.modelId
      && item?.faultTypeId!==payload.modelId
    ));
    state[key].push({...cloneCapabilityValue(payload),faultId:payload.modelId,faultTypeId:payload.modelId,status:'active'});
  }

  function createCapabilityRuntimePayload(model,parameters={}){
    const api=window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__||null;
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.createRuntimePayloadWithAdapter){
      return runtimeService.createRuntimePayloadWithAdapter({
        adapter:api,
        model,
        parameters,
        instance:{faultTypeId:model?.id||'',displayName:model?.displayName||model?.name||model?.id||''}
      });
    }
    if(api?.createInjectedFaultPayload){
      const payload=api.createInjectedFaultPayload(model,parameters);
      const fallback={
        ...payload,
        parameters:cloneCapabilityValue(parameters)
      };
      return runtimeService?.createRuntimePayloadFromInstance?runtimeService.createRuntimePayloadFromInstance({
        model,
        instance:{faultTypeId:model?.id||'',displayName:model?.displayName||model?.name||model?.id||''},
        parameters,
        basePayload:fallback
      }):fallback;
    }
    const fallback={
      modelId:model?.id||'',
      faultTypeId:model?.id||'',
      name:model?.displayName||model?.name||model?.id||'故障模型',
      layer:model?.layer||'electrical',
      runtimeBehavior:model?.runtimeBehavior||'',
      faultKind:model?.faultClass||model?.modelClass||'',
      modelClass:model?.modelClass||model?.faultClass||'',
      parameters:cloneCapabilityValue(parameters)
    };
    return runtimeService?.createRuntimePayloadFromInstance?runtimeService.createRuntimePayloadFromInstance({
      model,
      instance:{faultTypeId:model?.id||'',displayName:fallback.name},
      parameters,
      basePayload:fallback
    }):fallback;
  }

  function appendCapabilityRuntimeBinding(target,model,payload,targetKind){
    const api=window.__GZ_FAULT_INJECTION_RUNTIME__||null;
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    if(runtimeService?.createRuntimeFaultBindingWithAdapter){
      runtimeService.createRuntimeFaultBindingWithAdapter({
        adapter:api,
        target,
        model,
        payload,
        targetKind
      });
      return;
    }
    if(api?.createFaultBinding&&api?.appendFaultBinding){
      const binding=api.createFaultBinding(model||payload,payload,{
        targetId:target.id||'',
        targetKind
      });
      binding.slotId=payload.slotId||binding.slotId||'';
      binding.slotName=payload.slotName||binding.slotName||'';
      binding.bindingObject=payload.bindingObject||binding.bindingObject||'';
      binding.targetVariable=payload.targetVariable||binding.targetVariable||binding.bindingObject||'';
      binding.targetField=payload.targetField||binding.targetField||'';
      binding.injectionForm=payload.injectionForm||binding.injectionForm||'';
      api.appendFaultBinding(target,binding);
      return;
    }
    const propagationMode=payload.layer==='protocol'?'protocolEdge':'signalTransform';
    const binding={
      bindingId:`${payload.instanceId||payload.modelId||payload.name||'fault'}::${target.id||''}`,
      faultModelId:payload.modelId||'',
      faultTypeId:payload.faultTypeId||payload.modelId||'',
      name:payload.name||'故障模型',
      layer:payload.layer||model?.layer||'electrical',
      runtimeBehavior:payload.runtimeBehavior||'',
      parameters:cloneCapabilityValue(payload.parameters||{}),
      targetKind,
      targetId:target.id||'',
      slotId:payload.slotId||'',
      slotName:payload.slotName||'',
      bindingObject:payload.bindingObject||'',
      targetVariable:payload.targetVariable||payload.bindingObject||'',
      targetField:payload.targetField||'',
      injectionForm:payload.injectionForm||getFaultInjectionForm(target,payload.layer||model?.layer),
      visualRole:'fault-source',
      propagationMode,
      canPropagate:propagationMode!=='localOnly',
      active:true,
      injectedFault:payload
    };
    target.faultBindings=Array.isArray(target.faultBindings)?target.faultBindings:[];
    const index=target.faultBindings.findIndex(item=>item.bindingId===binding.bindingId||item.faultModelId===binding.faultModelId);
    if(index>=0) target.faultBindings[index]=binding;
    else target.faultBindings.push(binding);
  }

  function ensureCapabilityFaultTags(){
    const state=getState();
    if(!Array.isArray(state.faultTags)) state.faultTags=[];
    return state.faultTags;
  }

  function safeCapabilityId(value){
    return String(value||'fault').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g,'-');
  }

  function getCapabilityHostNodeId(target){
    if(!target) return '';
    if(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId) return target.sourceNodeId||target.targetNodeId||'';
    return target.id||'';
  }

  function getCapabilityTargetName(target){
    if(!target) return '目标对象';
    if(target.sourceNodeId&&target.targetNodeId){
      const source=typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(target.sourceNodeId):null;
      const destination=typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(target.targetNodeId):null;
      return `${source?.props?.name||target.sourceNodeId} -> ${destination?.props?.name||target.targetNodeId}`;
    }
    return target.props?.name||target.name||target.id||'目标对象';
  }

  function getCapabilityTagPosition(target){
    const width=204;
    const height=76;
    if(target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId&&typeof getNode==='function'&&typeof getPortInfo==='function'){
      const source=getNode(target.sourceNodeId);
      const destination=getNode(target.targetNodeId);
      const sourcePort=getPortInfo(source,'output',target.sourcePortIndex||0);
      const targetPort=getPortInfo(destination,'input',target.targetPortIndex||0);
      if(sourcePort&&targetPort){
        return {
          x:Math.round((sourcePort.x+targetPort.x)/2-width/2),
          y:Math.round((sourcePort.y+targetPort.y)/2-height-72),
          w:width,
          h:height
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      x:Math.round((target?.x||0)+(target?.w||160)+30),
      y:Math.round((target?.y||0)-height/2),
      w:width,
      h:height
    };
  }

  function createCapabilityFaultTag(instance,model,target,payload){
    const state=getState();
    const tags=ensureCapabilityFaultTags();
    const faultModelId=instance.faultTypeId;
    state.faultTags=tags.filter(tag=>tag.faultModelId!==faultModelId);
    const box=getCapabilityTagPosition(target);
    const hostNodeId=getCapabilityHostNodeId(target);
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    const targetName=getCapabilityTargetName(target);
    const layerLabel=typeof getLayerLabel==='function'?getLayerLabel(model.layer):model.layer;
    const tag=runtimeService?.createFaultTagRecord?runtimeService.createFaultTagRecord({
      instance,
      model,
      target,
      payload,
      box,
      hostNodeId,
      targetName,
      layerLabel
    }):{
      id:`fault-tag-${safeCapabilityId(faultModelId)}`,
      type:'fault_tag',
      faultModelId,
      faultModelName:instance.displayName||model.displayName||model.name||faultModelId,
      name:instance.displayName||model.displayName||model.name||faultModelId,
      layer:layerLabel,
      modelClass:model.modelClass||model.faultClass||'故障',
      runtimeBehavior:model.runtimeBehavior||payload?.runtimeBehavior||'',
      targetKind:instance.targetKind,
      targetId:instance.targetId,
      hostNodeId,
      targetName,
      slotId:instance.slotId||'',
      slotName:instance.slotName||'',
      bindingObject:instance.bindingObject||'',
      targetVariable:instance.targetVariable||instance.bindingObject||'',
      targetField:instance.targetField||'',
      injectionForm:instance.injectionForm||getFaultInjectionForm(target,instance.layer),
      active:true,
      positionMode:'manual',
      expanded:false,
      collapsed:true,
      parameters:cloneCapabilityValue(instance.parameters||{}),
      injectedFault:cloneCapabilityValue(payload),
      x:box.x,
      y:box.y,
      w:box.w,
      h:box.h
    };
    if(runtimeService?.upsertFaultTagRecord){
      state.faultTags=runtimeService.upsertFaultTagRecord(state.faultTags,tag);
    }else{
      state.faultTags.push(tag);
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(state.faultInjectionLinks)) state.faultInjectionLinks=[];
    const link=runtimeService?.createFaultTagLinkRecord?runtimeService.createFaultTagLinkRecord({
      instance,
      tag,
      label:'故障注入'
    }):{
      id:`fault-link-${safeCapabilityId(faultModelId)}-target`,
      faultModelId,
      sourceTagId:tag.id,
      targetNodeId:instance.targetKind==='edge'?null:instance.targetId,
      targetEdgeId:instance.targetKind==='edge'?instance.targetId:null,
      role:'fault-tag-attachment',
      label:'故障注入'
    };
    if(runtimeService?.upsertFaultTagLinkRecord){
      state.faultInjectionLinks=runtimeService.upsertFaultTagLinkRecord(state.faultInjectionLinks,link);
    }else{
      state.faultInjectionLinks=state.faultInjectionLinks.filter(item=>item.faultModelId!==faultModelId);
      state.faultInjectionLinks.push(link);
    }
    if(instance.targetKind!=='edge'&&hostNodeId&&!state.faultedBlks.includes(hostNodeId)){
      state.faultedBlks.push(hostNodeId);
    }
    return tag;
  }

  function mirrorFaultInstanceToRuntimeTarget(instance,model,target){
    if(!instance||!model||!target) return null;
    const runtimeService=window.__GZ_FAULT_BINDING_RUNTIME__;
    const payload=createCapabilityRuntimePayload(model,instance.parameters||{});
    payload.modelId=instance.faultTypeId;
    payload.faultTypeId=instance.faultTypeId;
    payload.instanceId=instance.instanceId;
    payload.name=instance.displayName||model.displayName||model.name||model.id;
    payload.parameters=cloneCapabilityValue(instance.parameters||{});
    payload.slotId=instance.slotId||'';
    payload.slotName=instance.slotName||'';
    payload.bindingObject=instance.bindingObject||'';
    payload.targetVariable=instance.targetVariable||instance.bindingObject||'';
    payload.targetField=instance.targetField||'';
    payload.injectionForm=instance.injectionForm||getFaultInjectionForm(target,payload.layer);
    if(runtimeService?.applyFaultBindingToState){
      const state=getState();
      const result=runtimeService.applyFaultBindingToState(state,target,{
        model,
        instance,
        payload,
        tag:{
          box:getCapabilityTagPosition(target),
          hostNodeId:getCapabilityHostNodeId(target),
          targetName:getCapabilityTargetName(target),
          layerLabel:typeof getLayerLabel==='function'?getLayerLabel(model.layer):model.layer
        },
        link:{label:'鏁呴殰娉ㄥ叆'}
      });
      if(result?.target){
        Object.keys(target).forEach(key=>{
          if(!(key in result.target)){
            delete target[key];
          }
        });
        Object.assign(target,result.target);
      }
      if(result?.state){
        Object.assign(state,result.state);
      }
      return result?.payload||payload;
    }
    target.injectedFault=payload;
    appendCapabilityRuntimeBinding(target,model,payload,instance.targetKind);
    if(instance.targetKind==='node'&&!S.faultedBlks.includes(target.id)){
      S.faultedBlks.push(target.id);
    }
    pushFaultRuntimeRecord('injectedFaults',payload);
    pushFaultRuntimeRecord('activeFaults',payload);
    pushFaultRuntimeRecord('appliedFaults',payload);
    const state=getState();
    if(runtimeService?.upsertInjectedFaultMap){
      state.injectedFaultMap=runtimeService.upsertInjectedFaultMap(state.injectedFaultMap,payload);
    }else{
      if(!state.injectedFaultMap||typeof state.injectedFaultMap!=='object') state.injectedFaultMap={};
      state.injectedFaultMap[payload.modelId]={...cloneCapabilityValue(payload),status:'active'};
    }
    createCapabilityFaultTag(instance,model,target,payload);
    return payload;
  }

  function activateFaultForTarget(target,faultTypeId,parameterOverrides={},options={}){
    const created=createFaultInstanceForTarget(target,faultTypeId,parameterOverrides,options);
    if(!created.ok) return created;
    mirrorFaultInstanceToRuntimeTarget(created.instance,created.model,target);
    refreshFaultUiAfterChange(null,{renderPanel:false});
    return created;
  }

  function capabilityHtml(value){
    const raw=value==null?'':String(value);
    if(typeof escapeHtml==='function') return escapeHtml(raw);
    return raw.replace(/[&<>"']/g,match=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[match]));
  }

  function getSelectedFaultActivationTarget(){
    const state=getState();
    if(state.selBlk&&typeof getNode==='function') return getNode(state.selBlk);
    if(state.selEdge&&typeof getEdge==='function') return getEdge(state.selEdge);
    return null;
  }

  function renderTargetFaultParameterInputs(model){
    const entries=Object.entries(model?.defaultParameters||{});
    if(!entries.length){
      return '<div class="target-fault-param-empty">该故障没有额外参数，可直接确认注入。</div>';
    }
    return entries.map(([key,value])=>`
      <label class="target-fault-param-row">
        <span>${capabilityHtml(getFaultParameterLabel(key))}</span>
        ${renderFaultParameterControl(key,value,'data-target-fault-param')}
      </label>
    `).join('');
  }

  function readTargetFaultParameterDraft(panel){
    const draft={};
    panel?.querySelectorAll?.('[data-target-fault-param]')?.forEach(input=>{
      const key=input.getAttribute('data-target-fault-param');
      if(key) draft[key]=input.value;
    });
    return draft;
  }

  function getFaultSlotDisplayName(slot){
    return slot?.slotName||slot?.name||slot?.label||getCapabilitySlotId(slot);
  }

  function getFaultSlotVariableName(slot){
    return getFaultSlotBindingObject(slot)||slot?.variableKey||slot?.targetVariable||getCapabilitySlotId(slot);
  }

  function markSelectedTargetFaultChoice(box,modelId,slotId=''){
    box.querySelectorAll('.target-fault-choice.is-selected').forEach(choice=>choice.classList.remove('is-selected'));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-activate-compatible-fault]').forEach(choice=>{
      const matchesModel=choice.getAttribute('data-activate-compatible-fault')===modelId;
      const matchesSlot=!slotId||choice.getAttribute('data-activate-fault-slot')===slotId;
      if(matchesModel&&matchesSlot){
        choice.classList.add('is-selected');
      }
    });
  }

  function showTargetFaultParameterPanel(box,target,model,slot=null,filters={}){
    if(!box||!target||!model) return;
    const slotId=slot?getCapabilitySlotId(slot):'';
    const slotName=slot?getFaultSlotDisplayName(slot):'';
    const bindingObject=slot?getFaultSlotVariableName(slot):'';
    markSelectedTargetFaultChoice(box,model.id,slotId);
    box.querySelector('[data-target-fault-parameters]')?.remove();
    const panel=document.createElement('form');
    panel.className='target-fault-parameters';
    panel.dataset.targetFaultParameters='true';
    panel.innerHTML=`
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__head">
        <span>参数确认</span>
        <strong>${capabilityHtml(model.displayName||model.name||model.id)}</strong>
        ${slot?`<small>${capabilityHtml(slotName)} 路 ${capabilityHtml(bindingObject)}</small>`:''}
        <small>${capabilityHtml(typeof getLayerLabel==='function'?getLayerLabel(model.layer):model.layer)} · ${capabilityHtml(model.runtimeBehavior||model.faultClass||model.modelClass||'故障')}</small>
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__grid">
        ${renderTargetFaultParameterInputs(model)}
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-parameters__actions">
        <button type="button" data-cancel-target-fault>取消</button>
        <button type="submit" data-confirm-target-fault>确认注入</button>
      </div>
    `;
    panel.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
      event.preventDefault();
      const result=activateFaultForTarget(target,model.id,readTargetFaultParameterDraft(panel),{
        ...normalizeFaultOptionFilters(filters),
        slotId,
        slot
      });
      if(result?.ok){
        box.remove();
      }else if(result?.error==='duplicate-fault-instance'){
        toast('该目标已经注入过这个具体故障','w');
      }else{
        toast('该目标无法注入所选故障','w');
      }
    });
    panel.querySelector('[data-cancel-target-fault]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>panel.remove());
    box.querySelector('.target-fault-dialog__body')?.appendChild(panel);
  }

  function renderTargetFaultActivationDialog(target,filters={}){
    document.querySelector('[data-target-fault-dialog]')?.remove();
    const optionFilters=normalizeFaultOptionFilters(filters);
    const options=getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget(target,optionFilters);
    const box=document.createElement('div');
    box.className='target-fault-dialog';
    box.dataset.targetFaultDialog='true';
    box.innerHTML=`
      <div class="target-fault-dialog__head">
        <strong>${capabilityHtml(getCapabilityTargetName(target))}</strong>
        <button type="button" data-close-target-fault-dialog>关闭</button>
      </div>
      <div class="target-fault-dialog__body">
        ${options.length?options.map(option=>{
          const {model,slot,slotId}=option;
          const injected=Boolean(findExistingFaultInstanceForTarget(target,model.id,slot));
          const bindingObject=getFaultSlotVariableName(slot);
          return `
          <button type="button" class="target-fault-choice${injected?' is-injected':''}" data-activate-compatible-fault="${capabilityHtml(model.id)}" data-activate-fault-slot="${capabilityHtml(slotId)}" ${injected?'disabled aria-disabled="true"':''}>
            <span>${capabilityHtml(model.displayName||model.name)}</span>
            <small class="target-fault-choice__slot">${capabilityHtml(getFaultSlotDisplayName(slot))} 路 ${capabilityHtml(bindingObject)}</small>
            <small>${capabilityHtml(typeof getLayerLabel==='function'?getLayerLabel(model.layer):model.layer)} · ${capabilityHtml(model.faultClass||model.modelClass||model.runtimeBehavior||'故障')}</small>
            ${injected?'<em>已注入</em>':''}
          </button>
        `;}).join(''):'<div class="target-fault-empty">该对象没有可添加的故障</div>'}
      </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.querySelector('[data-close-target-fault-dialog]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>box.remove());
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-activate-compatible-fault]').forEach(button=>{
      button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        const faultId=button.dataset.activateCompatibleFault||'';
        const slotId=button.dataset.activateFaultSlot||'';
        const option=options.find(item=>item.model?.id===faultId&&item.slotId===slotId);
        if(option) showTargetFaultParameterPanel(box,target,option.model,option.slot,optionFilters);
      });
    });
    return box;
  }

  function openTargetFaultActivationDialog(filters={}){
    const target=getSelectedFaultActivationTarget();
    if(!target){
      toast('请先选择可添加故障的组件或连线','w');
      return false;
    }
    renderTargetFaultActivationDialog(target,filters);
    return true;
  }

  function hasAuthoredSystemModel(pkg){
    return arr(pkg?.systemModel?.nodes).length>0||arr(pkg?.systemModel?.edges).length>0;
  }

  function getAuthoredModelId(pkg,prepared){
    return pkg?.modelInfo?.modelId??pkg?.modelId??prepared?.descriptor?.modelId??null;
  }

  function getAuthoredModelName(pkg,prepared){
    return pkg?.modelInfo?.modelName??pkg?.modelName??prepared?.descriptor?.modelName??null;
  }

  function normalizeAuthoredNode(node){
    const props={...(node?.props||{})};
    props.name=props.name||node?.name||node?.label||node?.id||'组件';
    props.inputs=arr(props.inputs).length?props.inputs:arr(node?.inputs);
    props.outputs=arr(props.outputs).length?props.outputs:arr(node?.outputs);
    props.middleVars=arr(props.middleVars).length?props.middleVars:arr(node?.middleVars);
    return {
      ...cloneCapabilityValue(node),
      type:node?.type||node?.nodeType||'simulation_block',
      x:Number.isFinite(node?.x)?node.x:0,
      y:Number.isFinite(node?.y)?node.y:0,
      props
    };
  }

  function normalizeAuthoredEdge(edge){
    return {
      ...cloneCapabilityValue(edge),
      sourceNodeId:edge?.sourceNodeId||edge?.source||edge?.from||'',
      targetNodeId:edge?.targetNodeId||edge?.target||edge?.to||'',
      sourcePortIndex:Number.isFinite(edge?.sourcePortIndex)?edge.sourcePortIndex:0,
      targetPortIndex:Number.isFinite(edge?.targetPortIndex)?edge.targetPortIndex:0,
      lineType:edge?.lineType||edge?.type||'normal'
    };
  }

  function applyAuthoredSystemModelToRuntime(pkg){
    if(!hasAuthoredSystemModel(pkg)) return false;
    const state=getState();
    const nodes=arr(pkg.systemModel.nodes).map(normalizeAuthoredNode);
    const edges=arr(pkg.systemModel.edges).map(normalizeAuthoredEdge);
    state.modelNodes=cloneCapabilityValue(nodes);
    state.modelEdges=cloneCapabilityValue(edges);
    state.nodes=state.modelNodes;
    state.edges=state.modelEdges;
    state.nodeSeq=Math.max(Number(state.nodeSeq)||0,nodes.length);
    state.edgeSeq=Math.max(Number(state.edgeSeq)||0,edges.length);
    state.selBlk=null;
    state.selEdge=null;
    state.sysLoaded=true;
    state.systemSaved=true;
    state.step=nodes.length?2:1;
    state.faultedBlks=[];
    state.faultTags=[];
    state.faultInjectionLinks=[];
    state.injectedFaults=[];
    state.activeFaults=[];
    state.appliedFaults=[];
    state.injectedFaultMap={};
    if(typeof renderModelNodes==='function') renderModelNodes();
    if(typeof renderEdges==='function') renderEdges();
    if(typeof updateUI==='function') updateUI();
    return true;
  }

  function buildAuthoredActiveModelPackage(pkg,prepared,current={}){
    const modelInfo=cloneCapabilityValue(pkg?.modelInfo||{
      modelId:getAuthoredModelId(pkg,prepared),
      modelName:getAuthoredModelName(pkg,prepared)
    });
    return {
      ...current,
      schemaVersion:pkg?.schemaVersion,
      modelInfo,
      modelId:modelInfo?.modelId??getAuthoredModelId(pkg,prepared),
      modelName:modelInfo?.modelName??getAuthoredModelName(pkg,prepared),
      componentTemplates:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.componentTemplates)),
      systemModel:cloneCapabilityValue(pkg?.systemModel||{nodes:[],edges:[]}),
      faultTypeCatalog:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultTypeCatalog)),
      faultCapabilityMap:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultCapabilityMap)),
      faultInstances:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultInstances)),
      diagnosticModel:cloneCapabilityValue(pkg?.diagnosticModel||null),
      pythonModules:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.pythonModules))
    };
  }

  const previousApply=window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__;
  if(typeof previousApply==='function'){
    window.__GZ_APPLY_FLIGHT_MODEL_PACKAGE__=function(pkg,prepared){
      const result=previousApply(pkg,prepared);
      if(result?.ok===false) return result;
      const state=getState();
      const authoredSystemApplied=applyAuthoredSystemModelToRuntime(pkg);
      const hasAuthoredPackage=authoredSystemApplied||String(pkg?.schemaVersion||'')==='3.0';
      if(hasAuthoredPackage){
        state.faultInstances=cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultInstances));
      }
      if(state.activeModelPackage){
        state.activeModelPackage=hasAuthoredPackage
          ?buildAuthoredActiveModelPackage(pkg,prepared,state.activeModelPackage)
          :{
            ...state.activeModelPackage,
            faultTypeCatalog:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultTypeCatalog)),
            faultCapabilityMap:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultCapabilityMap)),
            faultInstances:cloneCapabilityValue(arr(pkg?.faultInstances))
          };
      }
      return result;
    };
  }

  Object.assign(window,{
    getFaultCapabilityForTarget,
    getCompatibleFaultOptionsForTarget,
    getCompatibleFaultModelsForTarget,
    activateFaultForTarget,
    openTargetFaultActivationDialog
  });
})();

;(function installFaultComponentDropTargets(){
  if(typeof window==='undefined') return;

  function getState(){
    return window.__GZ_STATE__||(typeof S!=='undefined'?S:{});
  }

  function arr(value){
    return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
  }

  function getRuntimeNodes(){
    const state=getState();
    return arr(state.modelNodes).length?arr(state.modelNodes):arr(state.nodes);
  }

  function getRuntimeEdges(){
    const state=getState();
    return arr(state.modelEdges).length?arr(state.modelEdges):arr(state.edges);
  }

  function targetKind(target){
    return target?.sourceNodeId&&target?.targetNodeId?'edge':'node';
  }

  function normalizeFaultDropTargetKind(value){
    const raw=typeof value==='string'
      ?value
      :(value?.targetKind||value?.kind||value?.targetKindFilter||'any');
    if(raw==='edge'||raw==='line') return 'edge';
    if(raw==='node'||raw==='module'||raw==='component') return 'node';
    return 'any';
  }

  function normalizeFaultDropLayer(value){
    const raw=typeof value==='string'
      ?value
      :(value?.layer||value?.layerKey||value?.injectorLayer||value?.faultLayer||'');
    if(raw==='physical'||raw==='electrical'||raw==='protocol') return raw;
    return '';
  }

  function getFaultDropFilters(options={},expectedKind='any'){
    return {
      targetKind:normalizeFaultDropTargetKind(options?.targetKind?options:expectedKind),
      layer:normalizeFaultDropLayer(options)
    };
  }

  function targetAcceptsFaultComponent(target,expectedKind='any',filters={}){
    if(!target?.id||typeof window.getCompatibleFaultModelsForTarget!=='function') return false;
    const normalized=normalizeFaultDropTargetKind(expectedKind);
    if(normalized!=='any'&&targetKind(target)!==normalized) return false;
    return window.getCompatibleFaultModelsForTarget(target,filters).length>0;
  }

  function clearCompatibleFaultDropTargets(){
    const diagram=document.getElementById('diagram');
    diagram?.classList.remove('fault-drop-preview','fault-drop-preview--node','fault-drop-preview--edge');
    document.querySelectorAll('.fault-drop-compatible,.fault-drop-incompatible').forEach(el=>{
      el.classList.remove('fault-drop-compatible','fault-drop-incompatible');
      delete el.dataset.faultDropState;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.is-fault-drop-compatible,.is-fault-drop-incompatible').forEach(el=>{
      el.classList.remove('is-fault-drop-compatible','is-fault-drop-incompatible');
      delete el.dataset.faultDropState;
    });
  }

  function showCompatibleFaultDropTargets(options={targetKind:'node'}){
    const expectedKind=normalizeFaultDropTargetKind(options);
    const filters=getFaultDropFilters(options,expectedKind);
    const diagram=document.getElementById('diagram');
    diagram?.classList.add('fault-drop-preview');
    diagram?.classList.toggle('fault-drop-preview--node',expectedKind==='node');
    diagram?.classList.toggle('fault-drop-preview--edge',expectedKind==='edge');
    getRuntimeNodes().forEach(node=>{
      const el=document.getElementById(`b-${node.id}`);
      if(!el) return;
      const compatible=expectedKind!=='edge'&&targetAcceptsFaultComponent(node,expectedKind,filters);
      el.classList.toggle('fault-drop-compatible',compatible);
      el.classList.toggle('fault-drop-incompatible',!compatible);
      el.dataset.faultDropState=compatible?'compatible':'incompatible';
    });
    getRuntimeEdges().forEach(edge=>{
      const compatible=expectedKind!=='node'&&targetAcceptsFaultComponent(edge,expectedKind,filters);
      document.querySelectorAll(`[data-edge-id="${edge.id}"]`).forEach(el=>{
        el.classList.toggle('is-fault-drop-compatible',compatible);
        el.classList.toggle('is-fault-drop-incompatible',!compatible);
        el.dataset.faultDropState=compatible?'compatible':'incompatible';
      });
    });
  }

  function getFaultComponentDropTargetFromElement(element){
    const nodeEl=element?.closest?.('.blk');
    if(nodeEl?.id){
      const nodeId=nodeEl.id.replace(/^b-/,'');
      const node=(typeof getNode==='function'?getNode(nodeId):null)||getRuntimeNodes().find(item=>item.id===nodeId);
      if(node) return node;
    }
    const edgeEl=element?.closest?.('.edge-hit,.edge-path,.edge-label,[data-edge-id]');
    const edgeId=edgeEl?.dataset?.edgeId||edgeEl?.getAttribute?.('data-edge-id')||'';
    if(edgeId){
      const edge=(typeof getEdge==='function'?getEdge(edgeId):null)||getRuntimeEdges().find(item=>item.id===edgeId);
      if(edge) return edge;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function getFaultComponentDropTargetFromClientPoint(clientX,clientY,options={}){
    const expectedKind=normalizeFaultDropTargetKind(options);
    const element=document.elementFromPoint?.(clientX,clientY);
    if(expectedKind==='edge'){
      const edgeElementTarget=getFaultComponentDropTargetFromElement(element);
      if(edgeElementTarget&&targetKind(edgeElementTarget)==='edge') return edgeElementTarget;
      const edgeId=typeof findNearestEdgeIdByClientPoint==='function'
        ?findNearestEdgeIdByClientPoint(clientX,clientY)
        :'';
      return edgeId?((typeof getEdge==='function'?getEdge(edgeId):null)||getRuntimeEdges().find(item=>item.id===edgeId)||null):null;
    }
    const target=getFaultComponentDropTargetFromElement(element);
    if(target) return target;
    const edgeId=typeof findNearestEdgeIdByClientPoint==='function'
      ?findNearestEdgeIdByClientPoint(clientX,clientY)
      :'';
    return edgeId?((typeof getEdge==='function'?getEdge(edgeId):null)||getRuntimeEdges().find(item=>item.id===edgeId)||null):null;
  }

  function selectFaultDropTarget(target){
    if(!target?.id) return;
    if(targetKind(target)==='edge'){
      if(typeof selectEdge==='function') selectEdge(target.id);
      return;
    }
    if(typeof selectNode==='function') selectNode(target.id);
  }

  function isDirectFaultLibraryInjectionEnabled(){
    return window.__GZ_ENABLE_FAULT_LIBRARY_DIRECT_INJECTION===true;
  }

  function blockFaultLibraryDrop(expectedKind='node'){
    clearCompatibleFaultDropTargets();
    document.querySelector('[data-target-fault-dialog]')?.remove();
    toast('当前版本已关闭故障库拖拽注入，请先放置故障注入组件，再点击“绑定目标”完成绑定。','w');
    return {ok:false,reason:'fault-library-disabled',targetKind:expectedKind};
  }

  function handleFaultDropForKind(options={},expectedKind='node'){
    const filters=getFaultDropFilters(options,expectedKind);
    const target=options.target||(
      Number.isFinite(options.clientX)&&Number.isFinite(options.clientY)
        ?getFaultComponentDropTargetFromClientPoint(options.clientX,options.clientY,{targetKind:expectedKind})
        :null
    );
    clearCompatibleFaultDropTargets();
    if(!target){
      toast(expectedKind==='edge'?'请将连线故障组件拖到高亮的可注入连线上':'请将故障组件拖到高亮的可注入模块上','w');
      return {ok:false,reason:'missing-target'};
    }
    const kind=targetKind(target);
    if(expectedKind!=='any'&&kind!==expectedKind){
      toast(expectedKind==='edge'?'该对象不是可注入故障的连线':'该对象不是可注入故障的模块','w');
      return {ok:false,reason:'incompatible-target-kind',targetId:target.id,targetKind:kind,expectedKind};
    }
    if(!targetAcceptsFaultComponent(target,expectedKind,filters)){
      toast('该对象没有匹配的故障形式','w');
      return {ok:false,reason:'incompatible-target',targetId:target.id};
    }
    selectFaultDropTarget(target);
    const opened=typeof window.openTargetFaultActivationDialog==='function'
      ?window.openTargetFaultActivationDialog(filters)
      :false;
    return {
      ok:opened!==false,
      mode:'target-fault-dialog',
      targetId:target.id,
      targetKind:kind
    };
  }

  function handleFaultComponentDrop(options={}){
    if(!isDirectFaultLibraryInjectionEnabled()){
      return blockFaultLibraryDrop('node');
    }
    return handleFaultDropForKind(options,'node');
  }

  function handleLineFaultComponentDrop(options={}){
    if(!isDirectFaultLibraryInjectionEnabled()){
      return blockFaultLibraryDrop('edge');
    }
    return handleFaultDropForKind(options,'edge');
  }

  Object.assign(window,{
    showCompatibleFaultDropTargets,
    clearCompatibleFaultDropTargets,
    getFaultComponentDropTargetFromClientPoint,
    handleFaultComponentDrop,
    handleLineFaultComponentDrop
  });
})();

;(function installCompactFaultDiagnosisConsole(){
  if(typeof window==='undefined') return;

  function getState(){
    return window.__GZ_STATE__||(typeof S!=='undefined'?S:{});
  }

  function arr(value){
    return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];
  }

  function text(value,fallback=''){
    return value==null?fallback:String(value);
  }

  function html(value){
    const raw=text(value);
    if(typeof escapeHtml==='function') return escapeHtml(raw);
    return raw.replace(/[&<>"']/g,match=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[match]));
  }

  function getRuntimeNodes(){
    const state=getState();
    return arr(state.nodes).length?arr(state.nodes):arr(state.modelNodes);
  }

  function getRuntimeEdges(){
    const state=getState();
    return arr(state.edges).length?arr(state.edges):arr(state.modelEdges);
  }

  function getVisualFaultTagModels(){
    const state=getState();
    return arr(state.faultTags).filter(tag=>tag?.active!==false&&tag?.enabled!==false).map(tag=>{
      const targetKind=tag.targetKind||tag.target?.kind||'';
      const targetId=tag.targetId||tag.target?.id||'';
      return {
        ...tag,
        id:tag.faultModelId||tag.faultTypeId||tag.modelId||tag.faultId||tag.id,
        name:tag.faultModelName||tag.name||tag.label||tag.faultModelId||tag.id,
        layer:tag.layer||tag.layerKey||tag.injectedFault?.layer,
        category:tag.category||tag.modelClass||tag.injectedFault?.category,
        targetNodeId:tag.targetNodeId||(targetKind==='node'?targetId:''),
        targetEdgeId:tag.targetEdgeId||(targetKind==='edge'?targetId:''),
        affectedEdges:arr(tag.affectedEdges).concat(tag.targetEdgeId||(targetKind==='edge'?targetId:'')||[])
      };
    }).filter(model=>model.id);
  }

  function getActiveRuntimeFaultModels(){
    const activeFaults=typeof getInjectedFaults==='function'?getInjectedFaults():[];
    return activeFaults.concat(getVisualFaultTagModels());
  }

  function getRootDiagnosticCanvasId(){
    const state=getState();
    return state.rootCanvasId||'canvas-root';
  }

  function getActiveDiagnosticCanvasId(){
    const state=getState();
    return state.activeCanvasId||getRootDiagnosticCanvasId();
  }

  function getDiagnosticCanvasRecord(canvasId=getActiveDiagnosticCanvasId()){
    const state=getState();
    return state.canvases?.[canvasId]||null;
  }

  function getActiveDiagnosticEdges(){
    const canvas=getDiagnosticCanvasRecord();
    return canvas?arr(canvas.edges):getRuntimeEdges();
  }

  function getActiveDiagnosticNodes(){
    const canvas=getDiagnosticCanvasRecord();
    return canvas?arr(canvas.nodes):getRuntimeNodes();
  }

  function findDiagnosticPointCanvasId(point){
    const state=getState();
    const explicit=point?.canvasId||point?.scopeCanvasId||point?.targetCanvasId||point?.workbenchCanvasId;
    if(explicit) return explicit;
    const edgeId=point?.edgeId||point?.edgeID||point?.targetEdgeId;
    const nodeId=point?.nodeId||point?.targetNodeId;
    const canvases=state.canvases&&typeof state.canvases==='object'?state.canvases:{};
    for(const [canvasId,canvas] of Object.entries(canvases)){
      if(edgeId&&arr(canvas.edges).some(edge=>edge.id===edgeId)) return canvasId;
      if(nodeId&&arr(canvas.nodes).some(node=>node.id===nodeId)) return canvasId;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function diagnosticPointBelongsToActiveCanvas(point,activeEdges=getActiveDiagnosticEdges(),activeNodes=getActiveDiagnosticNodes()){
    const activeCanvasId=getActiveDiagnosticCanvasId();
    const pointCanvasId=findDiagnosticPointCanvasId(point);
    if(pointCanvasId) return pointCanvasId===activeCanvasId;
    const edgeId=point?.edgeId||point?.edgeID||point?.targetEdgeId;
    if(edgeId) return activeEdges.some(edge=>edge.id===edgeId);
    const nodeId=point?.nodeId||point?.targetNodeId;
    if(nodeId) return activeNodes.some(node=>node.id===nodeId);
    return activeCanvasId===getRootDiagnosticCanvasId();
  }

  const NODE_NAME_ZH={
    'node-command':'姿态指令',
    'node-command-shaper':'指令整形',
    'node-shaper':'指令整形',

    'node-error':'误差求和',
    'node-controller':'姿态控制器',
    'node-allocator':'控制分配',
    'node-motor':'电机混控',
    'node-dynamics':'飞行器动力学',
    'node-imu':'IMU 测量反馈',
    'node-command-scope':'指令示波器',
    'node-imu-scope':'IMU 示波器',
    'node-logger':'残差记录仪',
    'node-spectrum':'频谱分析仪'
  };

  const EDGE_NAME_ZH={
    'edge-command-shaper':'姿态指令',
    'edge-shaper-error':'整形指令',
    'edge-imu-error':'IMU 测量反馈',
    'edge-error-controller':'俯仰误差',
    'edge-controller-allocator':'控制量',
    'edge-allocator-motor':'电机指令',
    'edge-motor-dynamics':'执行推力',
    'edge-dynamics-imu':'机体角速度反馈',
    'edge-dynamics-imu-can':'机体角速度反馈',
    'edge-command-scope':'指令观测',
    'edge-imu-scope':'测量观测',
    'edge-error-logger':'残差诊断',
    'edge-error-spectrum':'频谱诊断'
  };

  const DEMO_FAULT_LIBRARY=[
    {id:'imu_rate_bias',name:'IMU 角速度偏置',category:'传感器故障',type:'propagating',targetNodeId:'node-imu',targetEdgeId:'edge-imu-error',affectedEdges:['edge-imu-error','edge-error-controller','edge-controller-allocator','edge-allocator-motor','edge-motor-dynamics','edge-dynamics-imu-can','edge-imu-scope','edge-error-logger','edge-error-spectrum']},
